He read the details about the enhancing potions and found that they had the capability to enhance his speed and strength respectively by over twenty percent for over an twenty minutes.
He quickly stored the bottles in his inventory, his mind calculating their potential utility.
'These might be useful though I can get better ones from the goddess or the king.' he thought, but still feeling satisfied at finding something in this wretched place.
BUZZZZZZ!!
Just as he was about to turn, a jolt of electricity struck him from behind and surged through his body.
His muscles seized, and his vision blurred.
A searing pain shot through his limbs, and he felt himself falling to his knees, his body trembling as the current crackled through his nerves.
His breath hitched, and his vision darkened at the edges, but he fought to stay conscious.
His body refused to move no matter how much he tried.
He heard a faint voice in the distance that he could never fail to recognize, the sound was so low that he almost didn't hear it along with the sound of over a dozen footsteps.
"Whoa!
It really hit him, don't tell me he died just from that.
I was just planning to stun him, g- go ahead and take care of him." Max's voice, laced with surprise and satisfaction along with some fear, cut through his dazed senses.
"It is fine, I needed you to be a part of this too you will get used to such things soon, remember this is not your home.
That is the only way I can trust you and don't worry he is still breathing; his body is surprisingly strong and sturdy for just a deadweight.
Anyway, just stay here while I finish the task." a heavy voice sounded next, mixed with the silent murmurs.
Using all the strength he could muster, Vritra pushed his body forward, pushing himself into the endless darkness, into the hole that still seemed better than certain death.
Who knows, there might actually be a chance to survive.

Seeing this, the commander rushed forward with all his might, his body becoming a blur as he appeared at the spot where Vritra was just moments ago, but it was too late and now he could only see Vritra plummet into the pit, the darkness swallowing him whole.
"Fuck!!" The commander cursed at the pitiful failure.

Vritra heard an angry roar of the commander that soon became distant, making him understand that just killing him wasn't their only motive; it seems the commander planned to take his dead body for some reason.
As he got away from one dangerous situation, Vritra found himself facing another life threatening event, as his body continued to fall, his senses had already started to return.

Vritra tried to slow himself down by grabbing something but it only resulted in injuries in his palms and fingers, within few seconds almost all his nails were ripped away and deep cuts appeared over his palms.
But still, he managed to rotate his body so as not to hit the floor with his head.

Finally, after a long fall, he landed with a sickening thud, his body aching and his vision swimming as pain coursed through his entire body, he could taste something metallic in his mouth and couldn't sense his legs.
His legs had borne most of the impact of the fall, so he was more than sure that both his legs were in extremely bad shape right now.
He attempted to get up, but his limbs felt heavy and unresponsive.
He lay there for a moment, trying to regain his senses.
His body was completely numb, the aftereffects of the electric shock lingering.

After taking few deep breaths he raised his head and look down at his feet and just as he had expected, his feet were a mess, up to his thighs the bones had completely shattered and had torn out of his skin, it was such a blood mess.
There were many other injuries all over his body but at least he succeeded in avoiding a certain death, if the pit wasn't slightly slanted then he would have definitely become a stain on the ground.
Once he could move his right hand, Vritra pulled one intermediate potion out of his inventory and gulped over half of it before putting it back.

Almost instantly, the pain was replaced by a warm feeling that swept across his entire body, he heard the sound of his bones crackling and within a few minutes, none of the previous injuries remained on his body.
The process was slightly painful but wonderous.
"This thing is truly magical, if it was back on earth there was no way my legs could ever be healed and here, I am completely fine within just a few minutes."

Vritra mumbled as he sat up and look down at his body, his clothes still remained bloodied and torn but his skin looked as smooth as ever without even a single scratch, even a couple of injuries in his arms he had from his fight in the arena disappeared.
"Fuck!!" he cursed, his jaw clenched.
"Those assholes, all of them were a part of it.
But why did they try to kill me?
Even if I have a shitty ability, that still won't explain it or maybe there is something they could obtain by killing the people who had come from the different world."
Vritra frowned at this thought, yet it made sense because of the commander's angry roar, which showed that they needed to get his body after killing him.
"So they picked me out since I have a shitty ability, is mom safe?

She said she had an ability related to cooking right?" Vritra felt worry increase in his heart, but after thinking for a moment he realized that the people with the most useless abilities were either in group three or group four.
'So there is a high chance that she is safe and her ability isn't as simple as she made it seem.' He could only hope for now.
Vritra stood up and felt no pain in his body, then he decided to look around; the light in this place were dimmer than the first floor, so it took him a few seconds to see clearly.
As Vritra's vision cleared, he found himself gazing up at a towering wall—the very place he had plummeted from.
Turning to his left, he spotted another wall just a few meters away, its presence adding to the eerie vastness of the space.
Glancing right, he was met with the same sight.
The realization settled in—he was trapped within an immense hall, its true scale yet unknown.
"Heh, so this fall killed so many people?
This trap was certainly better than getting killed by that group..." Vritra mumbled to himself while stretching his body slightly.
Just then, a faint noise echoed from behind him.
He turned around and froze, Vritra's eyes opened wide and his heart beat increased like inflation in market.
In front of him, the space seemed to be endlessly stretching without any end in sight but that wasn't the cause of his surprise.
In the dim light, he saw countless eyes glowing and staring at him, it was an endless horde of goblins.
Their height was a little more than a meter tall, all of them were carrying heavy wooden staves or knives made of bones, the goblins growled as they glared at him.
[You have entered the Death Canopy.]
[A sealed extermination zone designed for absolute annihilation.
A space present below the tenth floor of the labyrinth.
Once inside, there is no exit, and an endless horde of demons will spawn, increasing in strength over time.
The attack will begin with demons from the 1st floor of the labyrinth, escalating in strength with each passing interval.
If the current wave fails to eliminate the intruder, demons from the next floor will be summoned after a certain period of time— progressing relentlessly up to the 10th floor.
There is no limit to their numbers, the onslaught will only stop with the death of the intruder.]
[Survival chance: None]
[Difficulty level: Impossible]
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Cursed Hunter
paragraphs: [Survival chance: None]
[Difficulty level: Impossible]
Vritra stared at this message in disbelief as his gaze moved from the ethereal message towards the endless horde of goblins that was being held for now by some kind of invisible wall.
"FUCK!! W- What is this? Endless horde? Holy shit, why is there such a trap just at the first floor?" Vritra took a step back, feeling his heart beating wildly.
He was just rejoicing surviving the deadly fall but that wasn't even the part of the trap, the true terror was yet to come.
Then more messages appeared in front of his eyes, giving him a very bad feeling.
[Quest: Survive the first wave.]
[Reward: 10 Allocation points and the title: The Cursed Hunter (Level 1)!!]
[Penalty: None]
"Whoa so generous, no penalty. Like hell, I would be alive if I fail." Vritra spoke as he pulled out his sword, biting his lip hard to throw away any fear he felt.

The air was thick with bloodlust, each and every goblin looked wild and dangerous; they were hitting the invisible wall with madness, their sharp teeth and ugly bodies made them look more dangerous despite their small size.

'From what I have heard about the goblins of 1st floor of the labyrinth, they should be from level one to level fifteen? I am not sure though, even if my stat might be higher than most of them but there are just too many of them, if they surround me then my fate will be none other than death.

And my abilities, I don't think they will of much use, at least I have lots of healing and mana regeneration potion...' Vritra pondered in his mind, calculating to increase his chance of survival even by a little bit.
The damned goblins looked much more dangerous than in any of the anime, they were acting so wildly, as if they had gone mad.
But Vritra didn't have much time to think as the invisible wall disappeared and the endless wave of goblins ran towards him, reminding Vritra of a zombie movie scene he had seen back on earth.
But their sheer numbers were daunting. They were small, but relentless, with a savage glee in their eyes, and extremely ugly.
The message vanished.
The invisible wall dropped.
And the horde rushed forward like a flood.

A tidal wave of green flesh surged toward Vritra; their snarling faces illuminated by the faint glow of the labyrinth's ominous glowing stones. The ground trembled beneath the sheer volume of their small feet, and their bloodthirsty screams melded into a single guttural roar, making the walls shudder.

Vritra's grip on his sword tightened, for a moment he felt his body frozen with the death looming over his head the killing intent was too thick, but death would come faster if he didn't fight back, even if it is useless he wasn't planning to go down without putting up a fight.

Vritra didn't wait. He charged into them, sword gripped tight. Despite the fear and repulsion in his heart, he didn't hesitate on the thought of killing them, there was just no time for such useless thougths.
With all his strength he swung the sword at the approaching goblins as the blade cleaved through the first goblin's skull, splitting it like a ripe fruit. Warm blood sprayed on his face.
For a moment Vritra was surprised since he didn't expect that strike to deal so much damage, to the dangerous green demon.

But now that he thougth about it Vritra had never really gone all out before in fear of hurting others too much, even here in the labyrinth his specs alone put him above most of the low levelled goblins since they are naturally weaker and born with low stats.
[You have killed a Level 3 Goblin.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[All Stats Increased by 1.]
[ You have gained 1 Allocation Point.]
There was no time to think. No time to feel. Another goblin lunged, and Vritra kicked it in the gut, sending it crashing into two others.
"Shit!" he cursed as a dagger carved a shallow gash across his forearm. He gritted his teeth, blood dripping from his arm and the pain making it feel numb yet he didn't let go of the sword.
Ignoring the slight pain for the time being, he focussed all his mind at the large crowd of demons; thankfully he possessed the skill that lessened his pain.
But the number was just too large, and it was impossible to defend against all attacks, he could only try to avoid the sharp weapons or attacks aimed at his vitals.

Vritra sidestepped another goblin, putting all his strength in his legs and decapitated it with a sharp turn of his blade, as a wave of blood rushed out, drenching him completely before his kick crushed the skull of another.
[You have killed a Level 4 Goblin.]
[You have killed a Level 2 Goblin.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[All Stats Increased by 1.]
[ You have gained 1 Allocation Point.]

Vritra didn't stop for a moment, he ignored the wounds piling up on his body but with each swing of his sword, with each slice the rage and hatred in his heart kept building up, anger at these demons whose sole goal was to kill him and anger at the people responsible for putting him in this situation.
[Activating Dust Attunement.]

As he used his skill, Vritra effortlessly moved dust particles around him and even the mana consumption was very low; although he couldn't use that to directly kill the goblins but he struck the eyes of the goblins with the dust, blinding them momentarily before his sword tore their bodies apart.

His blade danced— slashing, stabbing, slicing throats, opening guts; killing the goblins in a frenzy, his adrenaline surging like wildfire through his veins. Each kill fed the storm inside him changing him with each passing moment, completely stripping him of any lingering fear, mercy and pain.
Blood sprayed across his face, warm and sticky, but he didn't stop—couldn't stop.

They kept coming. Dozens. Hundreds. Thousands upon thousands. The corpses began piling up around him. The floor beneath his feet turned slick with blood and pulped organs. A severed goblin hand clung to his shoe.

While slaughtering the goblins he noticed that after their deaths, they seemed to be dropping various items like weapons or armours, but they all seemed very weak and he had no time to examine them or even pick them as he felt the little demons charging at him from all directions.

Vritra kept moving forward, knowing that if the space around him got too littered with corpses, then it would be more difficult to fight and move, he kept pushing into the endless swarm of green creatures moving further away from the wall; getting more efficient the more he killed.
[You have killed a Level 1 Goblin.]
[You have killed a Level 2 Goblin.]
[You have killed a Level 2 Goblin.]
[+EXP Earned.]
Vritra was panting already, his arms screaming from the effort. His body trembled, not just from exhaustion, but also from all the injuries, He was completely drenched in green and red blood.
This was the first time he had ever killed anything. But he had no time to process that as another wave of goblins came.

He screamed—not in fear, but in pure, blood-boiling rage, appearing more like a demon, fury drowning out all reason as he stabbed another goblin through its neck, watching it gurgle and twitch for an instant before pulling his sword. Another leapt at him from the side, and he barely managed to duck, rolling in the blood-drenched ground.
He came up covered in gore. A goblin's intestine clung to his leg.
Vritra kicked hard, crushing its head against a wall. Bone fragments flew.
His grip tightened on the sword, knuckles white.
Dust particles kept swirling around him, as he blinded any goblin within range, at this time he was finding this skill more helpful than any other skill he might have received.
It also improved his senses in short range since he could feel the movement of goblins through the particles, allowing him to dodge most of the attacks.

He was using the skill continuously, yet the mana meter was down only by a bit. His only way to survival was killing as many of them as possible to increase his strength, otherwise in the next phase when the tide of stronger demons come, he won't be able to do anything.
Khrrrkkk—sssssshh

He saw a slightly taller and heavier goblin pouncing at him, carrying heavy staffs in his hands. Vritra knew if that struck him, it would at the very least injure him critically, throwing the dust into its eyes he pushed weaker goblin at it, watching as their bodies turned into minced meat as they got struck.

As the blinded goblin aimlessly waved its heavy staff while roaring, Vritra wasted no time as he thrust his sword into one of its socket with as much strength as he could muster, but while focussing on the bigger goblin he wasn't able to react as another goblin slashed at his back with a sharpened bone, leaving a big gash as blood seeped out.

"Ahhh" a groan escaped his lips as he jumped away; despite the pain resistance skill that he possessed he still felt some level of the pain, his body finally slowing down because of exhaustion and injuries.
[You have killed a Level 4 Goblin.]
[You have killed a Level 6 Goblin.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[You have levelled up!]
[All Stats Increased by 2.]
[ You have gained 2 Allocation Points.]

With a flick of his fingers, a thin cloud of dust swirled toward an approaching goblin's eyes. It shrieked, dropping its weapon, and Vritra didn't hesitate as he tore its body into two symmetrical pieces.
Time became irrelevant.
One hour. Then another. Then another.
His legs burned. His arms ached. But the goblins didn't stop. If anything, they increased.

Hours had passed of mindless killing, each time the system messages popped in front of him Vritra felt his strength and speed increase, allowing him to continue his massacre despite his weakening condition.
Suddenly another message popped in front of him.
[Your skill have Levelled Up]
[Dust Manipulation has advanced to Level 2.]
[Dust Attunement have now transformed into 'Dust Convergence'.]
Vritra had no time to read the message, but he felt that something had changed; he could sense that his control over the dust had grown.
GRRIIIIIIIIK-KAAAAAH
But before he could delve further into this feeling, all his senses tingled as a goblin stabbed him in the side.

Vritra roared in pain and cut its arm off, then sliced its face open. He dropped to one knee, clutching the wound while slicing through another goblin. Blood soaked his entire body, some of his own while most belonging to the goblins.
But the endless horde of goblins wasn't going to wait for him, Vritra jumped behind one of the small mountain of corpses and used it to stop the attacks for a moment.

With trembling hands, he pulled out an intermediate healing potion, his eyes never leaving the approaching swarm. He drank more than a quarter of it, then sent the rest back in his inventory, and stood again.

All his wounds disappeared within moments, even the pain he felt in his muscles due to fatigue was gone and although he was still slightly out of breath but once again he was ready to go on a rampage, his stamina seemed to have grown quite a bit as he levelled up.

He swung wildly now, losing any resemblance of grace, but not precision. Not completely. The more he killed the less wasteful his swung became, this was the first time he was using a sword but his movement had already started to resemble someone who had been using a sword for more than a year.

Guts spilled across the floor, as he walked forward a river of green blood was created. Corpses were lying all over the place in bits and pieces, the Death canopy was filled with thick killing intent.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Gulp
paragraphs: Vritra was swinging the sword at all the surrounding goblins, making sure to avoid or block as many attacks as possible, still countless wounds began to appear over his body.
One goblin's intestines hung from Vritra's sword as he turned to face the next. He kicked the corpse away and moved further ahead, not wanting to get trapped.
Klik- kik- kreeeeh
Another leapt. He caught it midair and slammed it to the ground, then crushed its windpipe with his foot.
His face was a mask of blood, cold and emotionless yet filled with only brutality.
Vritra decided to test dust manipulation as his right hand became a blur, cutting goblins down one after another while using the other hand to crush their throats or deflect the approaching attacks.
Kiiiiik- kliiik- kreeeeeeeeh
In his left hand he held a blade made of bone; now swinging with both hands, creating a thick mist of blood in the air.
[Activating Dust Convergence.]
Just as he activated his skill, unlike before a cloud of thick dust rose around him, blinding all the goblins within a range of around fifteen to twenty meters.

Although his own vision was obstructed yet within the dust he do not really need his sight or hearing to sense the presence of the goblins, inside that range he could sense everything through the dust particles itself.

Not only the dust blinded them, but it also made them choke as it flew into their mouths, all the goblins became disoriented inside the cloud of dust, Vritra even sensed that he could now concentrate the dust into a single place, killing goblins by blocking their windpipes but he couldn't shape the dust yet.
Still, it was a big improvement.
More than a day of slaughter inside the Death Canopy had passed, Vritra was now feeling incredibly hungry and thirsty, his body aching all over that not even the healing potion could fix.
Plus he felt exhausted physically and mentally, making his eye lids heavy.
[You have killed a Level 3 Goblin.]
[You have killed a Level 1 Goblin.]
[You have killed a Level 8 Goblin.]
[You have killed a Level 7 Goblin.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[All Stats Increased by 1.]
[All Stats Increased by 1.]
[ You have gained 1 Allocation Point.]
[ You have gained 1 Allocation Point.]
As more time passed his breathing grew heavier and heavier.
SWOOSH SWOOSH
BANG!!
SccccrrrrrreeeeeeEEEEEEE
He was hungry. Starving. His stomach growled, and his mouth was dry.
But he didn't stop.
He couldn't, after all time was a luxury he couldn't afford.

Although the dust cloud allowed him to kill goblins far easily while getting very little injuries, but he had more pressing problem now, he have to do something about his hunger and thirst otherwise he would soon be too weak to even move his arms, but it didn't seem there was any food or water in this space.
This trap was meant to kill everyone who is unfortunate enough to fall down, so the chances of finding food or water was non existent, Vritra couldn't find an answer to his problem.

Hours bled into days, as messages kept popping in front of him; declaring his kills or level ups or maybe some other things but he didn't had the time to even glance at it, one mistake and his body would be crushed and torn to death.
Vritra's eyes were sunken. His clothes had turned completely ragged barely doing their job, his skin appearing green, painted with the blood.
He had only been relying on the healing potion but it couldn't replace the need of food or water though it did just enough to keep him moving.
At least his sword was good enough to not chip away no matter how many attacks it defended against.

His movements became more brutal without any hint of hesitance, the scene was becoming more and more gruesome, as Vritra plunged his hand into the belly of one goblin and pulled out its intestine, his increased strength allowed him to rip apart their bodies with his bare hands.
A goblin tried to flank him.

He turned, grabbed it by the jaw, and crushed its face with a sharp twist of his wrist, Vritra didn't even flinch as more blood spurted onto him; even his black hair now drenched and dripping with the goblin's blood.

Another stabbed him in the thigh. Vritra gritted his teeth as not even a scream was released, he was already getting used to the pain, then he retaliated by plunging his fingers into its chest and yanking out its heart.
His hands dripped green.
He didn't even look as he threw the heart away and moved to the next.

Despite all the pain and adrenaline rush, his exhaustion was catching up to him; Vritra hadn't even slept at all in the past few days, so despite the large cloud of dust he was starting to get more and more injuries on his body.
[You have killed a Level 11 Goblin.]
[You have killed a Level 8 Goblin.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[All Stats Increased by 1.]
[ You have gained 1 Allocation Point.]
He saw the notifications, but had no time to check.
More came. Always more, the number was endless.
The goblins howled, leaping over the corpses of their kin. A wall of flesh that didn't hinder their movement in the least.
As Vritra kept moving forward, he had already walked quite far away from his starting point, leaving behind a large amount of corpses lying all over the way.
Just then another notification flashed, Vritra instantly felt the changes as he sensed the power of his skill increasing but he couldn't feel happy at this moment.
[Your skill has Levelled Up]
[Dust Manipulation has advanced to Level 3.]
[Dust Convergence have now transformed into Dust Weaving.]
No matter how many he sliced down or tore apart, more goblins replaced them getting stronger with time but Vritra didn't break.
Not yet.
His sword flashed like lightning, each swing cutting apart at least two goblins. His eyes, bloodshot and glowing with exhaustion and fury, lack of sleep made his mind and body slightly slow.

The bone blade he had picked earlier had long since broken, instead he picked a long sword that dropped after he killed a relatively strong goblin but he had no time to read the description of this new sword, both his hands were moving at full speed killing with madness.

Just as he swung the two sword and took the life of over six goblins, he sensed two goblins charging straight at him their body was much more muscular and their height twice as the other goblins, they were clearly much stronger than the other ones and several levels higher than even himself.

Even their speed was much faster than him, one of the goblins charged ahead into the dust and swung its heavy staff towards Vritra's head with a loud roar; Vritra barely had any time to react as he hastily pulled the two sword in front of his face, crossing them.
BANG

As the staff collided with the swords, they shattered into pieces almost instantly. Vritra was thrown back with a loud explosive sound, crashing into a mountain of corpses. Both his hands were shaking badly, almost broken, with faint cracks running along his bones.
He gritted his teeth and just as he was about to stand, Vritra's gaze finally landed on a message that shimmered in front of his eyes.
[You have survived for a total of three days and eleven hours twenty nine minutes.]
[Quest Progress: 26 days 12 hours 31 minutes remaining. (11.6%)]

The messages had been flashing in front of his eyes since the moment he had started this slaughter but he ignored them all, yet now this message completely shook his mind, seemingly taking away any hope of survival.

'I fought all that time, without stopping, without any sleep, food or water and I have to continue t- this for over a month?' Vritra was filled with a sense of hopelessness and despair; there was no way he could survive in this wretched place without eating or drinking or even sleeping for an entire month.

This place truly was meant to kill anyone who ends up trapped, all struggles are useless; with each hour and each day stronger demons kept appearing and after one month ends, demons much stronger than any of them will emerge, an infinitely large horde of them.
Vritra finally felt it—true dread and despair.

His chest heaved as panic twisted his insides. All hope was gone. Whatever sanity he had left began to crumble like a fragile shell cracking under pressure. Hunger gnawed at his thoughts, thirst scorched his throat like acid, and the lack of sleep hollowed out every last trace of reason.
He had nothing left—not strength, not strategy, not luck. Only death awaited.

The dust that had once cloaked him, a frail barrier that held back dozens upon dozens of demons, slowly dispersed as he lost all control. His limbs trembled. The skill he had clung to like a lifeline slipped from his grasp both his mind and body stopped reacting, there really was no hope of survival.

The two towering goblins advanced, hulking forms smeared with dried blood, their green skin marred with scars and brutality. Their cruel grins stretched unnaturally wide, as if they already knew how this would end.
And for a moment—so did he.
GrrrrrrrRRRRRRRR
But as they drew closer, as the stench of their bloodlust filled his lungs, something broke. Not with weakness. Not with fear.
But with rage.
The despair and fear transformed into beastly instincts and unquenchable rage.
The fear twisted and reshaped into pure, unfiltered hatred. His eyes, bloodshot and wild, locked onto the nearest large goblin.

Without thinking, Vritra's hand darted out and gripped the hilt of a hammer lying beside the fallen corpse of a goblin. The metal was producing a faint light, its weight heavy but manageable, but what he held right now didn't matter. Nothing mattered.

He lunged forward, the air splitting from the force of his movement. Dirt exploded beneath his feet increasing his speed further as his body became a blur. With both hands clenched tight around the hammer's grip, he swung with everything he had. The weapon whistled through the air and slammed into the goblin's skull with a sickening crunch.
But it didn't die.

The creature stumbled, dazed but alive, thick blood dripping from its split forehead. It roared and grabbed the hammer mid-swing as Vritra tried to hit it once again, yanking it away with monstrous strength, its claws tearing into Vritra's arms as it dragged him forward, ready to rip him apart.
And Vritra... bit!!
He bit down hard!!
He opened his mouth wide like a starved animal and sank his teeth deep into the goblin's shoulder with all his might, no emotion or reason visible in his hollow eyes.
SPLUTTER
Flesh was torn. Hot blood poured.

The goblin shrieked in confusion and pain as Vritra ripped out a chunk of its meat and still held it tightly in his mouth, not out of hunger—but madness; as the goblin stumbled back letting him go roaring in agony.
There was no thought. Only instinct, and at this moment he could be considered anything but human.
He bit harder, tearing a big chunk of the hard raw meat of the goblin into his mouth.
GULP
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Mutamorphis
paragraphs: Vritra bit harder, tearing the hard raw meat of the goblin into his mouth, and swallowed the demonic flesh, its blood spilling over his lips. He didn't care that it could kill him. He welcomed it.
The hunger and thirst forcing him to just swallow something, anything.
As the piece of the goblin meat was forced down his dry throat Vritra began to feel a burning pain in his throat and clearly felt how the piece moved painfully down to his belly.

The second goblin moved to strike, but Vritra twisted, barely managing to avoid the strike; as he slammed his fist into the wounded one's throat with haste, then drove the hammer straight through its jaw with a spine-snapping force.
Bones shattered. The first goblin collapsed as message after message began to pop but he had not time to read them under the pressure of the endless wave and the churning feeling in his belly.
several goblins instantly lunged at him, aiming to stab different parts of his body.

Vritra was in no state to fight, he picked up whatever weapons were lying on the ground and threw them at the approaching goblins with full strength, though the pain almost made him lose consciouness.
[You have killed a Level 19 Hobgoblin.]
[You have killed a Level 10 Goblin.]
[You have killed a Level 12 Goblin.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[All Stats Increased by 2.]
[ You have gained 2 Allocation Points.]

Demonic energy began to flood his belly, making him feel as if sharp daggers were cutting him from inside, he spat out blood and his mind buzzed as he failed to dodge the strike of a low level goblin who managed to leave a long cut on his waist, making him stumble back.
Blood was oozing out of his wounds uncontrollably at this moment, he pushed his body back with whatever strength he could muster.
Then another notification flashed in his vision.
[All the conditions have been met.]
[Unique Skill "Mutamorphis" has awakened.]
[Activating Mutamorphis...]
But the pain made it impossible to see anything, he was barely managing to dodge the attacks, feeling no strength in his body.
The pain was gut-wrenching, beyond agonizing

Vritra dropped to his knees, clutching his stomach. His veins glowed a sickly green. His insides churned violently like something alive was ripping through him. His muscles spasmed as if his body rejected itself. He screamed as his bones cracked, tendons twisted, and his entire form seemed on the brink of implosion.
Even the pain resistant skill couldn't decrease that amount of pain.

It was common knowledge how deadly was the blood and meat of demons for the humans, consuming even a small amount would lead to a slow, painful death. Those trapped with nothing else to eat often chose starvation over touching that cursed meat.
It was like a lethal poison.

He reached out with his fading will. Dust coiled around him. But this time, it moved with deadly strength as he used the upgraded version of the dust manipulation, clearly feeling the large jump in its power.
[Activating Dust Weaving.]
Threads of particles converged and hardened into the air, forming razor-sharp needles—hundreds upon hundreds of them.

They hovered in the air, humming with tension; a dangerous aura flickering around them. With one flick of his hand, they surged outward like a swarm of death, stabbing wildly into every direction. Screams echoed as goblins were pierced, shredded apart.
He burned through almost all of his MP, slaughtering until every goblin around him lay dead, creating some space and a brief moment of respite.
Messages popped like crazy in front of him.

Panting, Vritra stumbled back, taking cover behind a corpse mound slick with blood and entrails. He pulled a crimson potion from his inventory and chugged it, followed by a bitter mana elixir. His health and mana ticked up slowly—but the pain didn't stop, only pausing momentarily.
But then something changed.
[Demonic Energy had been detected in the body.]
[Mutamorphis: Adapting to Demonic Energy...]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Adaptation Complete. Partial Absorption Initiated.]
[Your body is now compatible with the demonic energy; too much consumption might lead to unknown changes.]

His skin burned as dark energy seeped into his body from the goblin flesh he consumed. The veins on his arms pulsed violently turning black, his eyes flaring red for a second as his heartbeat slammed like a war drum.
Finally the meat in his belly melted and spreading a warm and soothing feeling, a complete contrast to the agony he had just endured
[Mutamorphis: Analysing Body Conditions...]
[Analysing the environment...]
[Analysing Threat Levels and nearby lifeforms...]
[Triggering Automatic Morphological Adaptation...]
[Adaptation in Progress.]
[Acquiring necessary skills...]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Danger Sense]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Night Vision]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Stamina Recovery Boost]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Mana Recovery Boost]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Tranquil Mind]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Poison Resistance (Level 1)]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Death Aura]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Weapon Mastery]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Appraisal]
[You have acquired the active skill: Quick Step (Level 1)]
He sucked in air as the pain began to lessen, a comforting feeling spread all across his body but the message kept popping.
[Activating Tranquil Mind.]
[Activating Stamina Recovering Boost.]
[Activating Mana Recovering Boost.]

The headache and sleepiness instantly began to disappear, as Vritra's eyes became clearer than ever; a rare feeling of peace spreading in his mind despite the bloody surrounding, his stamina and mana began to recover at a speed at least three times faster than before as all exhaustion slowly began to fade.
Vritra sat with his back pressed against the small mountain of corpses, the weapons dropped after the death of goblins lying all over the place.

As Vritra finally saw the long chain of messages, his eyes widened in surprise and confusion; his seemingly useless skill that was supposed to allow him to adapt to his surrounding was pouring him with one skill after another, all of them very useful, necessary and great.
'Mutamorphis, just what kind of skill is it, what rank of skill is it, this is far from normal and even the top grade skill would pale in comparison.
Tranquil Mind, mana regeneration, stamina regeneration, quick step, they are all so special and would be great in battle; I should get used to them. And even dust manipulation seemed to have-'

Just as Vritra was pondering about the changes he recalled what he had just done, instantly a feeling of disgust filled him he coughed and wanted to vomit but nothing came out as if the goblin flesh that he had just devoured had already been digested.

"So that's why I am not feeling hungry or thirsty right now... I can't believe I- I really ate the flesh of a goblin and drank its blood, can I still be considered a human?" Vritra mumbled as he sensed the presence of the approaching wave of goblins, new ones were already coming to replace the dead.

Sighing, he stood up; picking different weapons in both his hands from the ground and readied himself for another round of bloodbath, but now with new abilities in his arsenal, and his body almost at the peak condition without hunger, thirst or lack of sleep.
RAAAAAAAAGGHHHHHHHHH!!

Vritra's thunderous and deadly roar cut through the screeches and howls of the goblins, as he charged forward with a renewed madness, cutting them apart with even more ferocity as messages kept popping.
[Activating skill: Night Vision]
[Activating skill: Weapon Mastery]
[Activating skill: Quick Step(Level 1)]
[Activating skill: Death Aura]

His vision became sharper and clearer than ever even in the darkness, weapons dancing in his hand with near perfection, sudden burst of speed allowed him to cover several meters in an instant and a deadly aura filled with his killing intent spread around him that slowed the movements of the goblins, making them hesitate.

While a storm of dust brewed around him, obscuring the vision of all the goblins over a couple dozen meters around him; many even died by getting their windpipe blocked or by the deadly blade made of hardened dust flying in the sand storm, taking lives of one goblin after another.
[You have killed a Level 4 Goblin.]
[You have killed a Level 6 Goblin.]
[You have killed a Level 9 Goblin.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up.]
[All stats grows by...]

Vritra seemed more of a demon than the goblins who ran towards him like moths to flames, only giving him experience points and helping him level up, as he steered further away from humanity with each passing hour in this damned place.
As his stat point kept increasing with each level up even without the addition of the allocation points to any of the attribute, the speed at which he was slaughtering the demons kept increasing.

With each swing of his weapons, he tore apart several goblins, breaking their bones and slashing through their flesh; creating an extremely bloody scene, he didn't care about the blood and organs that would hit his body and just continue to cut them apart.
[You have survived for a total of twenty nine days and twenty three hours forty minutes.]
[Quest Progress: 20 minutes remaining. (99.95%)]

Vritra sat calmly over a tall mountain made entirely of corpses of Goblin Warriors, their bodies even rigged and larger than the Hobgoblins, but now all of them lay broken and battered as Vritra calmly stared at his status window.

A large army of different types of high level goblins kept pouring towards him, but just as they arrived within his proximity, they were turned into minced meat by the large number of sharp blades or thick tentacles made of hardened dust that flew freely around him with deadly precision.

Vritra chewed on a piece of raw green meat as blood dripped down his chin, his body still bathed in warm and fresh blood, his eyes scanning the ethereal window while ignoring the countless messages pouring with each passing moment.
Thanks for reading...

His muscles spasmed as if his body rejected itself.
He screamed as his bones cracked, tendons twisted, and his entire form seemed on the brink of implosion.
Even the pain resistant skill couldn't decrease that amount of pain.
It was common knowledge how deadly was the blood and meat of demons for the humans, consuming even a small amount would lead to a slow, painful death.
Those trapped with nothing else to eat often chose starvation over touching that cursed meat.
It was like a lethal poison.
He reached out with his fading will.
Dust coiled around him.
But this time, it moved with deadly strength as he used the upgraded version of the dust manipulation, clearly feeling the large jump in its power.
[Activating Dust Weaving.]
Threads of particles converged and hardened into the air, forming razor-sharp needles—hundreds upon hundreds of them.
They hovered in the air, humming with tension; a dangerous aura flickering around them.
With one flick of his hand, they surged outward like a swarm of death, stabbing wildly into every direction.
Screams echoed as goblins were pierced, shredded apart.
He burned through almost all of his MP, slaughtering until every goblin around him lay dead, creating some space and a brief moment of respite.
Messages popped like crazy in front of him.
Panting, Vritra stumbled back, taking cover behind a corpse mound slick with blood and entrails.
He pulled a crimson potion from his inventory and chugged it, followed by a bitter mana elixir.
His health and mana ticked up slowly—but the pain didn't stop, only pausing momentarily.
But then something changed.
[Demonic Energy had been detected in the body.]
[Mutamorphis: Adapting to Demonic Energy...]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Adaptation Complete.
Partial Absorption Initiated.]
[Your body is now compatible with the demonic energy; too much consumption might lead to unknown changes.]
His skin burned as dark energy seeped into his body from the goblin flesh he consumed.
The veins on his arms pulsed violently turning black, his eyes flaring red for a second as his heartbeat slammed like a war drum.
Finally the meat in his belly melted and spreading a warm and soothing feeling, a complete contrast to the agony he had just endured
[Mutamorphis: Analysing Body Conditions...]
[Analysing the environment...]
[Analysing Threat Levels and nearby lifeforms...]
[Triggering Automatic Morphological Adaptation...]
[Adaptation in Progress.]
[Acquiring necessary skills...]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Danger Sense]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Night Vision]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Stamina Recovery Boost]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Mana Recovery Boost]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Tranquil Mind]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Poison Resistance (Level 1)]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Death Aura]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Weapon Mastery]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Appraisal]
[You have acquired the active skill: Quick Step (Level 1)]
He sucked in air as the pain began to lessen, a comforting feeling spread all across his body but the message kept popping.
[Activating Tranquil Mind.]
[Activating Stamina Recovering Boost.]
[Activating Mana Recovering Boost.]

The headache and sleepiness instantly began to disappear, as Vritra's eyes became clearer than ever; a rare feeling of peace spreading in his mind despite the bloody surrounding, his stamina and mana began to recover at a speed at least three times faster than before as all exhaustion slowly began to fade.
Vritra sat with his back pressed against the small mountain of corpses, the weapons dropped after the death of goblins lying all over the place.

As Vritra finally saw the long chain of messages, his eyes widened in surprise and confusion; his seemingly useless skill that was supposed to allow him to adapt to his surrounding was pouring him with one skill after another, all of them very useful, necessary and great.
'Mutamorphis, just what kind of skill is it, what rank of skill is it, this is far from normal and even the top grade skill would pale in comparison.
Tranquil Mind, mana regeneration, stamina regeneration, quick step, they are all so special and would be great in battle; I should get used to them.
And even dust manipulation seemed to have-'

Just as Vritra was pondering about the changes he recalled what he had just done, instantly a feeling of disgust filled him he coughed and wanted to vomit but nothing came out as if the goblin flesh that he had just devoured had already been digested.
"So that's why I am not feeling hungry or thirsty right now...

I can't believe I- I really ate the flesh of a goblin and drank its blood, can I still be considered a human?" Vritra mumbled as he sensed the presence of the approaching wave of goblins, new ones were already coming to replace the dead.

Sighing, he stood up; picking different weapons in both his hands from the ground and readied himself for another round of bloodbath, but now with new abilities in his arsenal, and his body almost at the peak condition without hunger, thirst or lack of sleep.
RAAAAAAAAGGHHHHHHHHH!!

Vritra's thunderous and deadly roar cut through the screeches and howls of the goblins, as he charged forward with a renewed madness, cutting them apart with even more ferocity as messages kept popping.
[Activating skill: Night Vision]
[Activating skill: Weapon Mastery]
[Activating skill: Quick Step(Level 1)]
[Activating skill: Death Aura]

His vision became sharper and clearer than ever even in the darkness, weapons dancing in his hand with near perfection, sudden burst of speed allowed him to cover several meters in an instant and a deadly aura filled with his killing intent spread around him that slowed the movements of the goblins, making them hesitate.

While a storm of dust brewed around him, obscuring the vision of all the goblins over a couple dozen meters around him; many even died by getting their windpipe blocked or by the deadly blade made of hardened dust flying in the sand storm, taking lives of one goblin after another.
[You have killed a Level 4 Goblin.]
[You have killed a Level 6 Goblin.]
[You have killed a Level 9 Goblin.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up.]
[All stats grows by...]

Vritra seemed more of a demon than the goblins who ran towards him like moths to flames, only giving him experience points and helping him level up, as he steered further away from humanity with each passing hour in this damned place.
As his stat point kept increasing with each level up even without the addition of the allocation points to any of the attribute, the speed at which he was slaughtering the demons kept increasing.

With each swing of his weapons, he tore apart several goblins, breaking their bones and slashing through their flesh; creating an extremely bloody scene, he didn't care about the blood and organs that would hit his body and just continue to cut them apart.
[You have survived for a total of twenty nine days and twenty three hours forty minutes.]
[Quest Progress: 20 minutes remaining. (99.95%)]

Vritra sat calmly over a tall mountain made entirely of corpses of Goblin Warriors, their bodies even rigged and larger than the Hobgoblins, but now all of them lay broken and battered as Vritra calmly stared at his status window.

A large army of different types of high level goblins kept pouring towards him, but just as they arrived within his proximity, they were turned into minced meat by the large number of sharp blades or thick tentacles made of hardened dust that flew freely around him with deadly precision.

Vritra chewed on a piece of raw green meat as blood dripped down his chin, his body still bathed in warm and fresh blood, his eyes scanning the ethereal window while ignoring the countless messages pouring with each passing moment.
Thanks for reading...

These constructs can shift forms mid-action, turning into spikes, chains, or walls instantly. The user can also create dust puppets—rough humanoid figures controlled directly by thought—used for offense, defence or distraction.

Active Skills:
Quick Step(Level 3):Grants the ability to instantly dash a short distance,allowing a sudden burst of speed to swiftly reposition or evade attacks.
Appraisal:Allows the user to instantly analyze the properties, details, and value of items, beings, or skills.
Inventory:
Healing potion (Rank- Advanced): 95
Healing potion (Rank- Intermediate): 3
Mana regeneration potion (Rank- Advanced): 99
Mana regeneration potion (Rank- Intermediate): 4
Agility Enhancement potion (Rank- Basic): 10
Strength Enhancement potion (Rank- Basic): 10
Goblin Warrior Corpses: 500
Goblin Champion corpses:500
Goblin knight corpses: 500
Goblin corpses: 500
Resistances:
[Pain Resistance] (Level 5)
[Poison Resistance] (Level 3)
Vritra chewed on the piece of juicy and tough meat of a demon, a drop of green blood sliding down his chin as he focused over different sections of his status.

He had collected quite a lot of corpses, they were his emergency ration; he had noticed that after his initial disgust vanished, the more of the meat he ate, the more his hunger grew—twisting into a craving that demanded even more before he could finally feel satisfied.

The bloodied meat was satiating his hunger and the blood was quenching his thirst, so he had been able to go for an entire month without any rest at all; also because of the help of several passive skills he received from Mutamorphic skill.

Later he received another passive skill, Battle Tenacity, which reduced his mana and stamina consumption by more than half coupled with the mana and stamina boosts he received; he didn't feel exhausted even for a moment.

He was also quite satisfied with his level and stat, the strongest goblin that he faced were at most of level 30 or 31; and he noticed that it became increasingly difficult to level up as his level became higher but that also meant the power difference between each level also became significant.
Dust Manipulation also levelled up just on the 28th day, and now it had become a whole lot stronger yet there was so much space for growth, this skill unlike what other believed was quite broken.

Vritra also noticed that something strange had happened to the species section probably since he had been eating demon flesh and drinking demon blood constantly, but he wasn't concerned about that not that he has a choice.

Just as he finished eating the fresh meat of a goblin Knight, Vritra noticed that it was almost time for the first month to end he jumped off the corpse mountain and walked forward while using dust whips to kill all the goblins without much effort, he was much stronger than any of them.

"These goblins have dropped quite a lot of weapons, I don't even know how many I have killed; but the number should be very large. Let's see what they are going to throw at me next..." Vritra mumbled as more messages popped in front of him.
[You have survived for a total of thirty days.]
[Quest Progress: 0 days remaining. (100%)]
[Quest: Survive the First Wave Completed.]
[You have received 10 Allocation Points.]
[You have received the title: The Cursed Hunter (Level 1)!!]
[All stats have increased by 2.]
Name:Vritra Arclis
Titles:The Cursed Hunter (Level 1)
Stats:
Strength:69
Agility:70
Endurance:68
Intelligence:69
Mana:67
Luck:32
[Allocation points: 57]
Before he could even see the changes, another message popped in front of his eyes.
[Quest: Survive the Second wave.]
[Reward: 15 Allocation points and the title: The Cursed Hunter(Level 2)!!]
[Penalty: None]

"Sigh I wonder what is coming this time now." Vritra yawned as he jumped off the corpse mountain, despite the usage of 'Tranquil Mind' he still felt a little exhausted after not sleeping or even taking a proper rest in the last one month.

Soon the goblins that were not dead and were charging towards Vritra were pushed back until they disappeared completely from sight then the ground began to rumble, the walls shook as a distant guttural roar resounded.
The changes were much more significant than the last time, just the roar alone made his ear hurt.
"It seems something big is coming..." Vritra mumbled as two long swords made of hardened dust particles appeared in his hand, turning very sharp and durable.

Finally, he saw it. Creatures several times bigger than the goblins were rushing forward madly, carrying large hammers, axes and even stones; there were countless of them, the sight alone could dread in the heart of most.

They were towering brutes with thick green skin and bulging muscles, their faces were twisted with tusks jutting from their snarling mouths. Large pieces of ragged clothes barely covered their scarred body. Their eyes glowed with a maddening glint, and they gripped ominous looking weapons in their hands.
[Activating Appraisal.]
Race: Orc
Level: 33
Class: Ordinary Warrior
Vitality: 100%
Stats:
• Strength: 59
• Agility: 38
• Endurance: 58
• Intelligence: 7
• Mana: 0

"Oh, such a strong demon right from the start, looks like I will be grinding like crazy again." Vritra spoke as he activated all his and dashed straight into the endless swarm of Orcs, the sickening looking creature who bulging bodies.
[Activating skill: Danger Sense]
[Activating skill: Night Vision]
[Activating skill: Stamina Recovery Boost]
[Activating skill: Mana Recovery Boost]
[Activating skill: Death Aura]
[Activating skill: Battle Tenacity]
[Activating skill: Quick Step (Level 3)]
[Activating skill: Granular Solidification (Level 4)]

Instantly Vritra's body flashed and appeared several meters away from his original position as he plunged the long sword into the belly of an Orc before slicing upwards as it was torn into two; just then a tingly sensation ran across his body, telling him about the threat.

He used quick step once again to barely dodge the deadly strike from behind, a large storm of dust suddenly formed around him engulfing more than fifty orcs, blades made of dust began to swing around dangerous, while large spiders and puppets formed around Vritra not to kill but to defend and distract.

Since the current orcs were mostly at lower level than Vritra so the deathly aura that emanated out from his body froze them instantly, letting Vritra cut through them without any efforts, message after message appeared in front of Vritra, but he didn't stop for a moment as he relished in the feeling of tearing apart the giant demons.
The dust swords were instantly painted by their blood, heads of the orcs rolled as Vritra killed a least of couple of them with a single swing of his swords.

There was now an advantage, since the bodies of the orcs were large it was relatively slower so the number of attacks that landed on his body reduced but the ones that landed were much more deadly than the ones that goblins delivered.
BANG
SWOOSH
Internal organs splattered as the swords cut open the bellies of two orcs, but he was suddenly struck by the hammer like weapon of an orc as his shoulder almost shattered.
Vritra was only pushed a step back, without waiting he lunged forward and began grinding for exp.

As the fighting continued, whenever he felt hungry Vritra would allow his dust army to engage for a while as he either ate the flesh of the goblins or picked fresh meat of the orcs, eating it up raw he had already gotten used to it; although their blood couldn't completely replace water but it was doing the job for now.
[You have consumed demon flesh.]
[Demonic energy detected.]
[Absorption initiated...]
[Absorption complete!!]

Such messages appeared whenever he consumed the demonic meat or blood, but he couldn't care less about it; all that mattered was that it was helping him survive for now, the only problem now was the lack of sleep even with tranquil mind.

As days passed, Vritra's levelling up speed increased once again as he faced stronger Orcs, he still got injured several times even with danger sense and all his other abilities but none of it was life threatening, he slaughtered one Orc after another, using whatever weapon he found lying around.
[You have killed a Level 39 Orc.]
[You have killed a Level 44 Berserker Orc.]
[You have killed a Level 40 Berserker Orc.]
[You have killed a Level 50 Orc Lord.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up.]
[All stats grows by 1]
[You have obtained 1 Allocation Point.]
[You have acquired the skill: Lesser Healing.]
With each passing day, the floor was covered by the red blood of the orcs and the path was lithered by their corpses, lying in pieces.

Days were filled with nothing but massacre; Vritra killed all the demons as if slaughtering them was the only reason of his life, he faced Orc demons from level 30 to level 60 and his level soared with each kill.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 10: Cursed hunter
paragraphs: Finally as Vritra tore apart three mountain like Orcs, much stronger than the previous ones several messages popped in front of him.
[You have survived for a total of thirty one days.]
[Quest Progress: 0 days remaining. (100%)]
[Quest: Survive the Second Wave Completed.]
[You have received 15 Allocation Points.]
[You have received the title: The Cursed Hunter (Level 2)!!]
[All stats have increased by 2.]
Vritra panted as he sat down, his entire body painted dark red in blood; his body had gone through a significant change, his hair had grown long and his physique was becoming more and more perfect.

"Huff Finally another month ended, this was a little tougher than the previous ones; I had to use a few healing and mana regeneration potions, but there are still a lot... sigh how am I going to do this for eight more months?"

Vritra sighed, smelling the stench of blood from his own body, before adding: "But it's a good thing the demons' blood and flesh just disappear in my belly somehow, otherwise how would I look if I died while shitting in a corner."
Recently he had started to talk to himself quite a bit, maybe to cling onto whatever sanity was left of him or maybe losing his sanity was the reason behind it.
Uninterestedly he gazed at his status panel.
Name:Vritra Arclis
Level:85 [3%]
Titles:The Cursed Hunter (Level 2)
Vitality:88%
Stats:
Strength: 108Agility: 109Endurance: 107Intelligence: 108Mana: 106Luck: 34
[Allocation points: 109]

There were several other changes in his status window, like levelling up of a couple of his skills and a new collection of rations had been added to his inventory along with all the goblin corpses; now there were more than 500 of each, Orc Lord, Orc Warrior, Orc hunter.

"The goblins and orcs dropped so many weapons after their death, it's a pity most of them are too weak and quite unusable; it would have been great if I had a way to use them somehow." Vritra mumbled to himself as he turned back to look at the countless weapons lying all over the place.
[Mutamorphis activated.]
[Scanning the surrounding...]
[You have acquired the skill: Weapon Fusion.]

"Wow so now I just need to say and I can get a new skill? Well whatever, I guess I will be combining all these weapons then." He spoke and then tested: "Give me a god tier skill that can instantly increase my level to the Max."
But nothing happened, sighing Vritra shook his head; he expected something like that.

Then a big smile appeared on Vritra's face as he gazed at all the different ranks weapons lying across the large space. "I have accumulated quite a lot of allocation points, whichever stat I add them to will receive a huge improvement but I will add them based on the situation."
In the future when he faces opponents stronger than him than based on the opponent's abilities he could invest into certain attribute, that will certainly increase his winning probability.
But just as the orcs had disappeared, another message popped.
[Quest: Survive the third wave.]
[Reward: 20 Allocation points and the title: The Cursed Hunter(Level 3)!!]
[Penalty: None]
Sighing again he created two long swords of dust, sharpening them to the extreme as he got ready for another round.
Once again the ground rumbled but with even more intensity, Vritra waited patiently through the same repeated process and soon he got to see his next targets.
He once again saw countless demons charging forward before they were stopped by the invisible wall, they looked much more dangerous and ferocious than any of the previous demons.
after a few minutes, the invisible wall disappeared and the wave of demons flooded towards Vritra with a single goal of killing him.
"So trolls huh, looks like I will be eating some regenerative meat next... they are quite troublesome though."

Right after speaking he began cutting through the endless horde, as more time passed more messed up his mind became, all his thoughts disappeared and he only remembered that he had to kill these creature as many as possible.

As his swords began to slice the trolls bodies into small pieces, two ethereal eyes observed him from the space beyond the walls of the cave; present there from the start but the more it observed Vritra the more awed it became.

In the start, the ethereal eyes had only glanced at him believing him to be just another person who had fallen into this deadly trap. Just based on his strength at the first level nothing was expected from Vritra, the figure was sure that he would die within a couple of minutes of the first wave.
But time and time again, Vritra proved himself resilient than most; appearing more ruthless and psychotic than even the demons themselves.
The ethereal figure waited to see, when would he finally break down under the dangerous barrage of demons, but even without any food, water or sleep he went on and one.
Even going as far as devouring the meat and blood of those demons, how was he even a human? He was anything but ordinary.
[You have killed a level 79 Armoured Troll.]
[You have killed a level 69 Mountain Troll.]
[You have killed a level 73 Mountain Troll.]
[You have levelled up.]

It was the eighteenth day when Vritra was walking forward carrying a large dust storm along with him when he suddenly noticed a change, for some reason an invisible wall had appeared in front of the trolls stopping them.

"What is happening? The time shouldn't be up just yet, why have they stopped? This trap is meant to send the demons endlessly until I am dead so why is it stopping now?" Vritra wondered as he allowed the dust blades to disperse.

But after thinking for a few minutes and observing the invisible wall, he couldn't find any answer and it seemed the wall was not going to disappear any time soon, using this perfect chance Vritra finally decided to get some rest.

He used Quick steps and dashed towards the start of the cave, to the very spot where he had started; this spot was quite far from the invisible wall and even if the wall disappear at some point he would have enough time to react.
Without wasting a moment, his body slumped down as exhaustion caught up to him and within a few breaths he was deep in sleep.

Vritra didn't wake up for three whole days and surprisingly the invisible wall held them back for that long, after waking up he took out a troll's headless body and began to eat his fill; he ate the raw meat and finished most of the meat of the troll's large body.

"Haa I feel completely refreshed now, my mind feels relaxed and my belly is full, there is none feeling better than this..." Vritra rubbed his belly and sighed in contentedness, still looking like a red alien.
Just as he finished the wall disappeared and the round continued.

"Oh! It is as if this wall was just waiting for me to finish, is someone controlling this all or something?" Vritra pondered to himself as he charged forward with even greater speed and began to rip apart the trolls with a new motivation and power.
"COOMEEEEEEEEE!!" Vritra released a loud war cry that shook the approaching demons, mixed with a deathly aura.
[You have killed a level 87 Armoured Troll.]
[You have killed a level 80 Mountain Troll.]
[You have killed a level 93 Troll Warlord.]
[You have killed a level 94 Troll Warlord.]
[You have levelled up.]
[You have levelled up.]

Just like that, another month passed as he annihilated different levels of Trolls for 30 days straight, the days he rested weren't counted but he was still happy to finally have some time to refresh, he got a couple more breaks after that, allowing him to sleep peacefully amidst the chaotic space.

The trolls he faced this time ranged from level 60 to somewhere around 94 or 95, the difference between each level grows the stronger one becomes, there were times when Vritra found fighting so many trolls at once quite troublesome.

They had great healing skills so unless they were killed with a single attack, they would be back to their peak in the next moment, so they were much more dangerous than goblins and orcs even their intelligence was higher.
Vritra drank half the bottle of Advance healing potion, as a warm feeling spread across his body and all the injuries disappeared almost instantly, then he drank the mana regeneration potion.
[Quest: Survive the Third Wave Completed.]
[You have received 20 Allocation Points.]
[You have received the title: The Cursed Hunter (Level 3)!!]
[All stats have increased by 2.]
Just as this message had appeared, all the trolls were pushed back into the darkness as Vritra once again had a moment of peace all for himself, he sat down panting and began to munch on meat.

"Sigh Orc hunter's blood sprinkled over the tender flesh of a Troll Warlord, Mmmm just so perfect." Vritra smacked his lips in satisfaction as he silently ate a large piece of meat while ignoring the messages that always appeared whenever he ate his food.

The size of the piece of flesh was so big that several men wouldn't have been able to finish it easily, Vritra himself would never had imaged that he could eat so much but now he wouldn't be satisfied with a small amount.

His teeth sank into the bloody and fresh meat, as a thin trail of blood dripped down his chin but he didn't really care since he was always bathed in blood, the ragged cloth that he wore was taken away from a troll, it was just enough to hide his body.

Vritra himself hadn't sensed much difference in his body but if others were to see him now even his mother, they would be quite shocked; not only has his height increased slightly but his body looked so perfect now, lean and slender yet still packed with perfectly carved muscles, but his face was always hidden under his long hair and blood.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Weapon fusion
paragraphs: After finishing his meal, Vritra stood up; thankfully the next wave hadn't come yet. He was quite sure that someone or something was controlling this trap from behind the scenes. But so far it didn't seem that person was trying to harm him on the contrary Vritra was being helped.
Stretching his body, Vritra spoke: "Now shall we test our new skill, weapon fusion? There are just so many weapons lying all over the place, it'll take quite some time."

The Weapon Fusion skill did just as its name suggested, it fused two or more weapons into one weapons stronger than all the originals ones, it could acquire any skill from the three of them or maybe even more than one skill, it was quite random.
Picking up a sword and a knife, Vritra used the skill.
[Activating Weapon Fusion.]
[Two weapons detected...]
[Fusion of Goblin's knife and Thin sword started...]
[Fusion Complete!!]
A blinding light flashed out of the two weapons as Vritra felt them disappearing from his hand, soon just one sword was left there, but its quality and durability seemed better.
Satisfied with the result Vritra got to work, fusing one weapon after another; doing different experiments to understand the skill better.

While he was picking the weapons and fusing them, Vritra even found a new friend; it was a strange fist shaped silver stone with the shape of eyes and mouth carved on it, it was a drop from some troll.

"You will be called Zengis from now on, sigh we are both covered in blood; let's get out of here together and get a really nice bath." Vritra spoke, as he used the dust to make Zengis float beside him and follow around while he continued to fuse weapons.
Vritra felt a bit better to not talk to himself for once in several months even if it was just a stone, it was still nice company, then he took a glance at his stats.
Name: Vritra Arclis
Titles: The Cursed Hunter (Level 3)
Vitality: 100%
Stats:
Strength: 136
Agility: 137
Endurance: 135
Intelligence: 136
Mana: 134
Luck: 36
[Allocation points: 155]
"Although the levelling up had slowed down just a bit but the increase in strength is higher than both the previous rounds.

And the allocation points, I have gathered a lot of them if I find myself unable to continue against certain demons, I can give a boost to my stats then based on the abilities of the demons." Vritra pondered to himself, and then he continued to fuse weapons.
As he fused more and more weapons, he was even able to decide which shape to choose among the fused weapons.
[Quest: Survive the fourth wave.]
[Reward: 25 Allocation points and the title: The Cursed Hunter (Level 4)!!]
[Penalty: None]
Another message and another round began.

"Whoa Lava Hounds?!!" Vritra exclaimed as he saw several large dogs covered in lava appear on the other side of the invisible wall, the starting level itself was more than 90 so this wave was going to be several times more dangerous than the previous one but Vritra wasn't worried about that, a big smile appeared on his face as he shouted:

"Finally I am going to get cooked meat, oh how long I have waited. Zengis, it'll be dangerous here so you should hide for now." Before even the invisible wall had disappeared, Vritra charged forward swinging around his dust swords not using his unfinished fusion weapon just yet, while putting Zengis away into inventory.

As the wall disappeared the temperature of the space became very high, just breathing was burning Vritra's body from inside and hundreds of fire pillars were shot towards him, even if the level of demons at the start was lower than him but their number was endless, it was still very difficult for him to kill them.
[Mutamorphis: Analysing the surrounding...]
[You have acquired the skill: Fire Resistance(Level 1)]

As he disappeared into the endless horde of the lava hounds, sounds of explosions continued to rang out along with the painful wails of the demons as limbs and heads were thrown around, another bloodbath began, his skin was burned several times very badly even receiving severe injuries a few times.
Of course, he received several one or two days gaps between his battles over the course of the month, even though the demons got stronger that also made his speed of levelling up faster.
[You have killed a Level 112 Lava Hound.]
[You have killed a Level 119 Lava Hound.]
[You have killed a Level 122 Lava Hound.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up.]
[You have Levelled Up.]
[All stats grows by 1]
[All stats grows by 1]
[You have obtained 1 Allocation Point.]
[You have obtained 1 Allocation Point.]

"Chomp chomp Zengis gulp the meat of lava hound is just chef's kiss, anyway when we go out I will let you meet other beautiful stones. But after you get a girlfriend don't forget chew chew about me, okay?" Vritra spoke, while chewing on the lava hound's meat as messages kept popping.

It was the 28th day and again the invisible wall had appeared giving him some time to relax and talk to his first and the only friend, Zengis. Vritra found his company quite comforting, Zengis would always listen to him and even sometimes motivated him.

"What? Me? No I don't have any girlfriend either, it's too troublesome and I don't like other's company- of course you and my mom are the only exceptions, rather than playing house with girls I prefer fighting, I was quite a fighter back on earth too."
Vritra spoke, flashing a smile but if someone were to see him right now they would be scared shitless, he was completely covered in the blood of countless creatures.

"Sigh you are wondering how I ended up here? Well, I have to jump down or I might already be a corpse by now or maybe something worse, anyway I just hope mom is fine..." Vritra said in a worried tone, as Zengis's shiny surface flashed a comforting light.
"Thanks buddy, we are definitely going to go out."
[Quest: Survive the Fourth Wave Completed.]
[You have received 25 Allocation Points.]
[You have received the title: The Cursed Hunter (Level 4)!!]
[All stats have increased by 2.]

"Huff Huff You can come out now Zengis, it is safe and we have finally survived yet another month." Vritra panted, several burns all over his body; he drank healing potion and lay back as Zengis came out of the inventory and floated around him.

"I can't believe we have been in this hellhole for whole four months, Fuck I am going to kill those bastards- sigh sorry for that Zengis, this just makes me so angry, damn it." He cursed and after a large meal, even bigger than what he ate just a few days ago Vritra went to sleep.
After waking up he took a quick glance at his stats, checking his progress so he can be better prepared for the upcoming carnage.
Name: Vritra Arclis
Titles: The Cursed Hunter (Level 4)
Vitality: 100%
Stats:
Strength: 167
Agility: 168
Endurance: 166
Intelligence: 167
Mana: 165
Luck: 38
[Allocation points: 209]
In the fifth wave the difficulty level rose significantly, the demons this time were much more stronger and terrifying than any of the previous ones.
The cave shook as if it might really shatter as the horde of the next demons approached and soon and endless army of giant Minotaurs came rushing, looking quite scary and wild.
"Oh bull meat this time, well this is going to be very difficult. The starting level is already 130, damn this try hard son of a- hell, the stats of each of them are so high."

Vritra readied himself for all the countless injuries he knew he would be getting soon, this battle was going to be very dangerous and he wasn't sure if he could really survive against such deadly creatures.
'Well if it really becomes too dangerous I can use those allocation points, they will give a huge boost.' He thought, preparing for the fifth round.
"Oh well, here goes nothing..."
[Activating skill: Danger Sense]
[Activating skill: Night Vision]
[Activating skill: Stamina Recovery Boost]
[Activating skill: Mana Recovery Boost]
[Activating skill: Death Aura]
[Activating skill: Battle Tenacity]
[Activating skill: Quick Step (Level 6)]
[Activating skill: Pain resistance (Level 6)]
[Activating skill: Lesser Healing]
[Activating skill: Granular Solidification (Level 4)]

Without holding back, Vritra struck the first Minotaur as he changed the shape of his long sword made of dust at the last second, twisted the blade into minotaur's eye, before pushing forward and destroying its brain in a single attack.

Without wasting a moment or reading the message, he dodged the dozens of attacks that rained down at him and created a large dust storm and sent out various creatures to keep a few minotaurs busy for a while.
Using quick step, his body became a blur as he sliced at the body of another demon at its belly, aiming to cut it into two.
CLANG
Vritra was pushed back as other minotaur saved the one he aimed for, it seemed a few of them even possessed higher intelligence, but he wasn't deterred.
Turning the dust long swords into whips, he jumped high and wrapped them around the necks of the two demons before pulling them towards him with all his strength.

Minotaurs were very dangerous creatures as they possess higher strength, speed and their body is skin is hard to penetrate; as Vritra's blade sliced through the necks of the two of them, he felt slight resistance before two heads rolled down.

'I guess they are manageable, but I will have to go all out, I will save my allocation points for the next round with how things are progressing the next round will be even more dangerous.' Vritra thought and then clearing his mind he focused solely on tearing apart the demons.
Pushing forward, he kicked one of the minotaur's head almost cracking its skull before sending tiny blades of dust into the body of the minotaur to rank havoc.

Vritra was now sure that the more this skill levelled up the more terrifying it would become, these large creature were absolutely powerless against the dust blades that attacked their bodies from inside.
More than a dozen goblins fell down at the same time few meters away from him, no wounds could be seen on their bodies but on the inside, all their organs were torn apart and their flesh was ripped.
Messages was flashing at a very high speed in front of Vritra, increasing his strength rapidly.
Thanks for reading...
