"Huff Huff You can come out now Zengis, it is safe and we have finally survived yet another month." Vritra panted, several burns all over his body; he drank healing potion and lay back as Zengis came out of the inventory and floated around him.

"I can't believe we have been in this hellhole for whole four months, Fuck I am going to kill those bastards- sigh sorry for that Zengis, this just makes me so angry, damn it." He cursed and after a large meal, even bigger than what he ate just a few days ago Vritra went to sleep.
After waking up he took a quick glance at his stats, checking his progress so he can be better prepared for the upcoming carnage.
Name: Vritra Arclis
Titles: The Cursed Hunter (Level 4)
Vitality: 100%
Stats:
Strength: 167
Agility: 168
Endurance: 166
Intelligence: 167
Mana: 165
Luck: 38
[Allocation points: 209]
In the fifth wave the difficulty level rose significantly, the demons this time were much more stronger and terrifying than any of the previous ones.
The cave shook as if it might really shatter as the horde of the next demons approached and soon and endless army of giant Minotaurs came rushing, looking quite scary and wild.
"Oh bull meat this time, well this is going to be very difficult.
The starting level is already 130, damn this try hard son of a- hell, the stats of each of them are so high."

Vritra readied himself for all the countless injuries he knew he would be getting soon, this battle was going to be very dangerous and he wasn't sure if he could really survive against such deadly creatures.
'Well if it really becomes too dangerous I can use those allocation points, they will give a huge boost.' He thought, preparing for the fifth round.
"Oh well, here goes nothing..."
[Activating skill: Danger Sense]
[Activating skill: Night Vision]
[Activating skill: Stamina Recovery Boost]
[Activating skill: Mana Recovery Boost]
[Activating skill: Death Aura]
[Activating skill: Battle Tenacity]
[Activating skill: Quick Step (Level 6)]
[Activating skill: Pain resistance (Level 6)]
[Activating skill: Lesser Healing]
[Activating skill: Granular Solidification (Level 4)]

Without holding back, Vritra struck the first Minotaur as he changed the shape of his long sword made of dust at the last second, twisted the blade into minotaur's eye, before pushing forward and destroying its brain in a single attack.

Without wasting a moment or reading the message, he dodged the dozens of attacks that rained down at him and created a large dust storm and sent out various creatures to keep a few minotaurs busy for a while.
Using quick step, his body became a blur as he sliced at the body of another demon at its belly, aiming to cut it into two.
CLANG
Vritra was pushed back as other minotaur saved the one he aimed for, it seemed a few of them even possessed higher intelligence, but he wasn't deterred.
Turning the dust long swords into whips, he jumped high and wrapped them around the necks of the two demons before pulling them towards him with all his strength.

Minotaurs were very dangerous creatures as they possess higher strength, speed and their body is skin is hard to penetrate; as Vritra's blade sliced through the necks of the two of them, he felt slight resistance before two heads rolled down.

'I guess they are manageable, but I will have to go all out, I will save my allocation points for the next round with how things are progressing the next round will be even more dangerous.' Vritra thought and then clearing his mind he focused solely on tearing apart the demons.
Pushing forward, he kicked one of the minotaur's head almost cracking its skull before sending tiny blades of dust into the body of the minotaur to rank havoc.

Vritra was now sure that the more this skill levelled up the more terrifying it would become, these large creature were absolutely powerless against the dust blades that attacked their bodies from inside.
More than a dozen goblins fell down at the same time few meters away from him, no wounds could be seen on their bodies but on the inside, all their organs were torn apart and their flesh was ripped.
Messages was flashing at a very high speed in front of Vritra, increasing his strength rapidly.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 12: Invisible Flames
paragraphs: [Quest: Survive the Fifth Wave Completed.]
[You have received 30 Allocation Points.]
[You have received the title: The Cursed Hunter (Level 5)!!]
[All stats have increased by 2.]

Another month passed in the blink of an eye, though for Vritra each day seemed like a week; after slaughtering minotaurs for an entire month he finally had the time to rest; he sat with his back against a wall that was painted in red, as he ate the meat of the strongest minotaurs that he slain.

His body was battered and bruised, the battle became much more difficult than he had anticipated as days passed the minotaurs became much stronger the earlier ones, Vritra almost lost his life a couple of times but in the end, those mighty minotaurs ended up as his food.

"Sigh Zengis, I think even if I survive the sixth round, I might finally die at the seventh or eighth round. You will once again be left alone and you will never meet those beautiful stones, yeah yeah I know why exactly are you sad so stop sulking." Vritra spoke and then sighed, throwing Zengis back into inventory.

"Just me from five months ago would laugh if someone told him that I would be talking like this with a stone, if I remain here for too long then I might go completely crazy... well more than I already am that is if I live long enough." He sighed again, distracting his mind with the thoughts of killing the people responsible for his current situation and his mother.
'There is no use thinking about that right now, I have to get out of here safely, sigh let's see the status window.' Vritra thought as an ethereal window appeared in front of him.
Name: Vritra Arclis
Titles: The Cursed Hunter (Level 5)
Vitality: 100%
Stats:
Strength: 210
Agility: 211
Endurance: 209
Intelligence: 210
Mana: 208
Luck: 40
[Allocation points: 280]

After eating his fill Vritra decided to sleep since like before he believed that the next wave will only arrive after a day or two, so after eating a large amount of meat he moved further back into the cave and covered himself with the skin of a demon that he used as blanket and soon he drifted off to sleep.

There were no wounds on his body and all his fatigue was gone, though his throat felt a bit rough because of the constant consumption of the demon's blood aside from that Vritra was in his peak state.

He was sure that he would be victorious even in the next wave but Vritra was also aware that just the starting level of 6th wave was going to be quite high, he might even need to use those allocation points.

Something was definitely strange this time, Vritra ate and slept peacefully for two days and got ready for the next horde of demons on the third day but nothing appeared, he thought that he might be getting an extra free day since the next wave will be extremely dangerous so he happily accepted and rested.

But even on the fourth day there was no sign of the next wave, then on the fifth day, sixth day and yet nothing seemed to be happening; Vritra grew more and more puzzled and now this peaceful time only made him more nervous.
While sitting he decided to have a look at his status window, wondering how much it had changed by now.

Just as he finished another large piece of lava hound meat mixed with minotaur and Troll's meat, he felt an unfamiliar sensation, it was hard to describe but it stirred something deep within him as if something was directly affecting his soul itself.
Vritra caught the sight of something sparkling in one corner of the cave not too far away from him, feeling curious he approached it slowly and cautiously.

As he got closer, Vritra finally saw it- a colorless flame, flickering and swaying weakly despite there being no wind in the cave. It was a fire without any color, if his sight hadn't improved so much then Vritra might have easily missed this colorless flame that was slightly bigger in size than a flame lit over a lighter.

"Now now, what is this thing? How come there is fire burning here and I have never seen one like that, it is kind of transparent and almost impossible to detect." Vritra mumbled, staring at the flames intently.

After thinking for a moment, he blew air at it but it didn't go out, no matter how hard he tried; since he had nothing else to do so he decided to find more about this strange occurrence, yet he was caution enough to not get too close to the harmless looking fire.

Picking up a sword from the side he put its tip into the flames and waited patiently but nothing happened, the invisible didn't even leave a mark on the sword even though the sword was of such low quality.

He did a few more experiments but found absolutely nothing while he was busy with it, two eyes glowing brightly within the space itself looked at him with hope and expectations, as if they had found their last hope.

"What is up with this fire, it can't even cook meat; sigh well forget it." Vritra shook his head as he withdrew the dust blade from the flames, he wasn't even sure how did it appeared there out of nowhere.

He tore a piece of cloth from a nearby corpse and put one of its end into the flames while he held onto the other end, wondering if it really can't burn anything but just as the cloth came in contact with the flames, they invisible fire actually began to burn the cloth or so Vritra thought.
But as he focused, Vritra noticed that instead of setting the cloth to fire the flames themselves had climbed onto the cloth as if it was some living creatures.

Startled; he hastily threw away the cloth, but it was too late; the invisible flames had already climbed onto his hand from the cloth, with his heart thumping wildly in his heart he shook his hand violently, but it stuck to him like the damn tax.
It just won't let go.

The flames moved from his finger to cover his palm and then up to his wrist within seconds, but for some reason he felt no pain, but he was panicking so much that his only thought was to get it away from him.

He enveloped it with clothes to cut oxygen supply, covered it completely in dust, even blew air at it but nothing worked at all, with each passing moment he was getting more and more nervous and afraid.

"T- There isn't huff any water here- wait I can try using the blood." Looking around, Vritra hastily shoved his hand into the chest of a corpse, hoping to use its blood to finally get rid of this damned fire.

'I heard curiosity killed the cat, now I understand it all too well. Fuck!!' Vritra stayed like that for a few seconds, but as he pulled his hand back he noticed the colourless flame seemed a little more intense than before as if it had just eaten a full meal.
He took out a healing potion and drank it but it too had no effect, no matter what he tried all his efforts resulted in failure, while the flames continued to move up his arm.

"Well Shit, is this really it? Ugh it is making me dizzy, something deep within me hurts; it is not my internal organs but as if it is affecting my existence itself, my soul?" Vritra tried to think calmly but he couldn't find a way, soon his fear turned into rage.
He had been getting his ass whooped and slaughter non stop for five months, suffering so much pain and headaches, all for him to die from this?

He couldn't accept this, he didn't wasn't to accept this, staring at the colourless flame that was undoubtedly planned to devour him as it slowly continued crawling up to his elbow Vritra's beastly instinct took over.

Without even thinking he bit his own hand with enough strength as his teeth sank into his flesh, a metallic taste filling his mouth, as he felt the pain Vritra's mind cleared; realizing what he had done Vritra hastily moved his hand away from his mouth in fear that it will even latch onto his head.
GULP

Vritra gulped his own blood in nervousness as he picked a shiny sword from the ground and looked at his own face through the reflection, thankfully there was no invisible flames on his face but then his body froze as his gaze focussed on the words that appeared in front of him.
[Mutamorphis: Analysing the body...]
[You have consumed a part of one of the Mythic Halos.]
[The Third ranked Mythic Halo: Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo detected.]

Vritra was shocked to see that message, although he had no idea what that thing was but what he saw was that from he had bitten his own palm, the strange invisible flame seemed to have disappeared, he was actually able to eat the flame.
[Warning: Mythic Halo assimilation in progress...]
[Absorbing Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo into the host's soul.]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Failed]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
Vritra saw the series of messages but what got his attention was the part of his skin where he had bit just moments ago, the invisible fire really disappeared from there.
He didn't care if it will work or not, or whether it will be dangerous; believing in his strange skill Vritra did what he thought was the most natural at that moment.
BITE!!
He bit down at the invisible flames and swallowed, even though it felt like he wasn't eating anything but the messages popping in front of him proved that actually wasn't the case.
[You have consumed a part of one of the Mythic Halos.]
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 13: Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo
paragraphs: Without a care Vritra brought his right hand closer to his mouth and wildly began to eat away at the invisible flame.

And much to his delight he noticed that it was slowly reducing in size but then as if the flame itself had noticed the change from being a predator to a prey, and felt a direct attack to its pride, it went wild as Vritra felt pain from within his body.
COUGH COUGH

He coughed out blood and fell to his knees, his vision blurring as blood began to seep out of his ears and nose, but that only resulted in making him enraged, with even more intensity he began to bite at the flames as the two tried to devour one another.
And soon another message popped...
[You have consumed the complete Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo.]

After consuming the entire flame, Vritra lay on his back panting heavily and within moment he drifted off into unconsciousness; the pain in his mind and body was too unbearable even with the pain resistance skill, at least he managed to remove all the invisible flame from his arm.
Though now, it rampaged inside his body.
[Synchronization in progress.]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]

It continued for several minutes, as Vritra's expression distorted even in his sleep his face grew paler and paler and at a visible rate his body began thinning as blood continued to pour out from his eyes, nose and ears.

Within just a few minutes, it seemed he had lost several kilos of weight. The invisible flames continued to struggle with all its might, trying to devour him and escape, but all its effort were resulting in naught.
The painful and violent yet silent fight continued within his body, two ethereal eyes continued to stare at him from the darkness with anticipation.
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Success!!]
[Synchronization with Mythic Halo: Nihil-Anima — 0%... 1%...]
[Assimilation complete.]
[Mythic Halo successfully integrated.]
[Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo successfully consumed.]
[Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo has fused with the host's soul.]

After an unknown period of time, Vritra finally began to regain his consciousness as his eye lids fluttered and a warm sensation ran through his body completely different from the painful experience from before.
"Ughhh Where am I?" he groaned and slowly opened his eyes, looking at the strange ceiling of the cave as he finally remembered what happened in the past five months.
Sighing he looked down at his body and found nothing wrong, no injury, weakness or any other abnormality.
'Sigh so I survived, but what happened to that darned flame...'
Just as Vritra was about to stand, his body froze as he heard a loud and clear voice.
"I KNEW IT!!!"
It was undoubtedly the voice of a woman; it sounded melodic and mature containing a commanding presence.
Vritra was startled, he hadn't heard anyone speaking in a long time, he jumped to his feet and looked around frantically but aside from the corpses and countless weapons he couldn't see anything.
"Who... are you?" he asked, his voice coming out stuttering.
Vritra had doubt before that someone helped him when he was given those breaks between his battles, but he still wasn't sure if the other person meant him any harm or not.

Just then, the space in front of Vritra trembled making him feel as if there was some problem with his eyes, he stumbled back as an ethereal and majestic figure began to condense right in front of him.

Vritra's breath hitched, he had to raise his head to even see the figure and soon a white dragon formed in front of him but more than an actual dragon it looked like some advanced 3d projection, it was very large as its body stretched over a large area in the cave.
But it was translucent, though the detailing was extremely high; to the point he could even see the tiniest bit of scratch on the scales of the dragon, the scales even shone brightly.

'Is someone trying to scare me with a realistic 3d image? Could it be that the next round had already begun while I was unconscious? What is going on?' Vritra was confused and on high alert, as he took a few steps back until his back was pressed against a wall.
"I knew that you will be able to succeed." Once again the enormous white dragon spoke, her body seemed to be more than a hundred meter long and her white scales glistened beautifully.
Vritra stared at the dragon's ethereal figure but still looked around wondering who was controlling this projection.
COUGH
Sound of throat clearing was heard and once again the mature female voice sounded.

"This isn't just some image or illusion, I am a real dragon in the flesh- well not in flesh or rather in soul... Anyway, congratulations on surviving against all the demons so far and even against one of the greatest Mythic Halos, actually that's quite shocking even for me." She calmed her mind, but her voice was still filled with surprise and excitement.
"You... are a dragon's soul? Are you the one controlling this cave all this time? Aren't you just an image?" Vritra questioned, still looking doubtful but even more cautious.

"Sigh Yes, I am now merely a soul. And no, at least not completely I can only control this cave to some extent and that is why you were able to get those breaks between each fight later on." The female dragon replied.

"Ah... So what is hell is going on? Who are you exactly and what was that halo or whatever?" he asked, a frown appearing on his face, as if those waves of demons weren't enough now, he had to deal with even more strange things.
Vritra was suddenly feeling homesick and even the boring school seemed like such a good place, at least there was a canteen which didn't serve just demon meat.
"Haven't you noticed anything different, did you check the messages that appeared?" she spoke in a melodious tone, there was a feeling of happiness in her voice.
Vritra finally looked at all the messages and his status window.
[Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo successfully consumed.]
[Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo has fused with the host's soul.]
And in his status window a new section had been added.
Name: Vritra Arclis
Titles: The Cursed Hunter (Level 5)
Vitality: 100%
Halo: Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo

[Description]:The 3rd ranked Mythic Halo, it possesses the power to raise and control the souls of the dead. It grants the ability to manipulate wraiths, shape soul essence into powerful forms, and harness souls for various purposes. The most ferocious Mythic Halo, devourer of Gods and Demons.

Vritra read the description but couldn't get much information from it aside from the fact that it is related to souls, so he raised his doubtful gaze towards the female dragon, before taking a calming breath and speaking.
"I am Vritra Arclis, what's your name?" he asked.
"What an odd name, Vritra... but it is a pleasure meeting you here. I am Yasmine Firehart, a dragon from the Firehart family.
I know you must have a lot of doubts about your situation and this place, so let me explain in simple terms." Yasmine shifted her body slightly, letting her giant body stretch as she began.

"You must be aware how treacherous and evil those demons are, but they are undeniably strong and have much larger number than most other species that's why all the others have to come together just to hold them back.
A labyrinth is different from some random den or cave or demons, it is only created through the death of a powerful demon and the stronger the demon is the more terrifying the labyrinth will be."
Vritra listened carefully, wondering why she was starting from that point, but he didn't interrupt her none the less as he gazed at the beautiful and large dragon in awe.
Yasmine continued to explain: "There are Halos in this world, strange entity or let's say treasures that couldn't be defined by normal explanations, which could possess different abilities.
They could be in various forms and possess abilities from as useless as a paperweight to something far more dangerous.

The mythic halos are the top treasures across all the universes, every single one of them possess extraordinary ability where the top ones among the twenty mythic halos could even match or surpass the strength of the gods and demon gods.

So in simple they are something very deadly and powerful, and the one you had just consumed, it might have been ranked at 3rd although that is already very very high but that rank can't do justice to its abilities and strength.

TheNihil-Anima mythic halorose through the ranks the fastest, from a mere halo it became one of the most destructive force of the entire universe, then it challenged the rank 2Demonic Veyll Mythic halo.

It was a fight that greatly affected the entire universe, Nihil-Anima even though ranked an whole rank below, still brought Demonic Veyll mythic halo near death but after being weakened in the fight; a demon god who had already secretly formed a bond with rank 2 halo attacked Nihil-Anima along with that demonic Mythic halo.

Hence is the reason why even someone as low levelled as you were able to devour it and form a bond, it was far too weakened under their combined attack and could only slaughter its way through to escape, but it lost the entire armies of Souls that it controlled.
It was resting in this labyrinth that was created because of the corpse of the demon lord that Nihil-Anima had killed and brought along before escaping.
Well that's the gist of this, now that Nihil-Anima had become yours you will get to know more in the future, but even in such a weak state, I can't understand how you did it, that's just impossible."

Vritra listened carefully and felt quite shocked, even that tiny part of that invisible flame was so terrifying not to mention that it could control an enormous army of souls, no wonder that even the ranked 2 mythic halo almost got devoured by it if it wasn't for that demon god.
"Of course, the Demonic Veyll was in an even weakened state and the demon god too suffered a serious injury while most of his army ended up dying." Yasmine spoke.
Thanks for reading...

He coughed out blood and fell to his knees, his vision blurring as blood began to seep out of his ears and nose, but that only resulted in making him enraged, with even more intensity he began to bite at the flames as the two tried to devour one another.
And soon another message popped...
[You have consumed the complete Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo.]

After consuming the entire flame, Vritra lay on his back panting heavily and within moment he drifted off into unconsciousness; the pain in his mind and body was too unbearable even with the pain resistance skill, at least he managed to remove all the invisible flame from his arm.
Though now, it rampaged inside his body.
[Synchronization in progress.]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]

It continued for several minutes, as Vritra's expression distorted even in his sleep his face grew paler and paler and at a visible rate his body began thinning as blood continued to pour out from his eyes, nose and ears.
Within just a few minutes, it seemed he had lost several kilos of weight.
The invisible flames continued to struggle with all its might, trying to devour him and escape, but all its effort were resulting in naught.
The painful and violent yet silent fight continued within his body, two ethereal eyes continued to stare at him from the darkness with anticipation.
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Failed!]
[Processing...]
[Success!!]
[Synchronization with Mythic Halo: Nihil-Anima — 0%...
[Assimilation complete.]
[Mythic Halo successfully integrated.]
[Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo successfully consumed.]
[Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo has fused with the host's soul.]

After an unknown period of time, Vritra finally began to regain his consciousness as his eye lids fluttered and a warm sensation ran through his body completely different from the painful experience from before.
"Ughhh Where am I?" he groaned and slowly opened his eyes, looking at the strange ceiling of the cave as he finally remembered what happened in the past five months.
Sighing he looked down at his body and found nothing wrong, no injury, weakness or any other abnormality.
'Sigh so I survived, but what happened to that darned flame...'
Just as Vritra was about to stand, his body froze as he heard a loud and clear voice.
"I KNEW IT!!!"
It was undoubtedly the voice of a woman; it sounded melodic and mature containing a commanding presence.
Vritra was startled, he hadn't heard anyone speaking in a long time, he jumped to his feet and looked around frantically but aside from the corpses and countless weapons he couldn't see anything.
"Who... are you?" he asked, his voice coming out stuttering.
Vritra had doubt before that someone helped him when he was given those breaks between his battles, but he still wasn't sure if the other person meant him any harm or not.

Just then, the space in front of Vritra trembled making him feel as if there was some problem with his eyes, he stumbled back as an ethereal and majestic figure began to condense right in front of him.

Vritra's breath hitched, he had to raise his head to even see the figure and soon a white dragon formed in front of him but more than an actual dragon it looked like some advanced 3d projection, it was very large as its body stretched over a large area in the cave.
But it was translucent, though the detailing was extremely high; to the point he could even see the tiniest bit of scratch on the scales of the dragon, the scales even shone brightly.
'Is someone trying to scare me with a realistic 3d image?
Could it be that the next round had already begun while I was unconscious?
What is going on?' Vritra was confused and on high alert, as he took a few steps back until his back was pressed against a wall.
"I knew that you will be able to succeed." Once again the enormous white dragon spoke, her body seemed to be more than a hundred meter long and her white scales glistened beautifully.
Vritra stared at the dragon's ethereal figure but still looked around wondering who was controlling this projection.
COUGH
Sound of throat clearing was heard and once again the mature female voice sounded.
"This isn't just some image or illusion, I am a real dragon in the flesh- well not in flesh or rather in soul...

Anyway, congratulations on surviving against all the demons so far and even against one of the greatest Mythic Halos, actually that's quite shocking even for me." She calmed her mind, but her voice was still filled with surprise and excitement.
"You... are a dragon's soul?
Are you the one controlling this cave all this time?
Aren't you just an image?" Vritra questioned, still looking doubtful but even more cautious.
"Sigh Yes, I am now merely a soul.
And no, at least not completely I can only control this cave to some extent and that is why you were able to get those breaks between each fight later on." The female dragon replied.
So what is hell is going on?
Who are you exactly and what was that halo or whatever?" he asked, a frown appearing on his face, as if those waves of demons weren't enough now, he had to deal with even more strange things.
Vritra was suddenly feeling homesick and even the boring school seemed like such a good place, at least there was a canteen which didn't serve just demon meat.
"Haven't you noticed anything different, did you check the messages that appeared?" she spoke in a melodious tone, there was a feeling of happiness in her voice.
Vritra finally looked at all the messages and his status window.
[Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo successfully consumed.]
[Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo has fused with the host's soul.]
And in his status window a new section had been added.
Name: Vritra Arclis
Titles: The Cursed Hunter (Level 5)
Vitality: 100%
Halo: Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo
[Description]:The 3rd ranked Mythic Halo, it possesses the power to raise and control the souls of the dead.
It grants the ability to manipulate wraiths, shape soul essence into powerful forms, and harness souls for various purposes.
The most ferocious Mythic Halo, devourer of Gods and Demons.

Vritra read the description but couldn't get much information from it aside from the fact that it is related to souls, so he raised his doubtful gaze towards the female dragon, before taking a calming breath and speaking.
"I am Vritra Arclis, what's your name?" he asked.
"What an odd name, Vritra... but it is a pleasure meeting you here.
I am Yasmine Firehart, a dragon from the Firehart family.
I know you must have a lot of doubts about your situation and this place, so let me explain in simple terms." Yasmine shifted her body slightly, letting her giant body stretch as she began.

"You must be aware how treacherous and evil those demons are, but they are undeniably strong and have much larger number than most other species that's why all the others have to come together just to hold them back.
A labyrinth is different from some random den or cave or demons, it is only created through the death of a powerful demon and the stronger the demon is the more terrifying the labyrinth will be."
Vritra listened carefully, wondering why she was starting from that point, but he didn't interrupt her none the less as he gazed at the beautiful and large dragon in awe.
Yasmine continued to explain: "There are Halos in this world, strange entity or let's say treasures that couldn't be defined by normal explanations, which could possess different abilities.
They could be in various forms and possess abilities from as useless as a paperweight to something far more dangerous.

The mythic halos are the top treasures across all the universes, every single one of them possess extraordinary ability where the top ones among the twenty mythic halos could even match or surpass the strength of the gods and demon gods.

So in simple they are something very deadly and powerful, and the one you had just consumed, it might have been ranked at 3rd although that is already very very high but that rank can't do justice to its abilities and strength.

TheNihil-Anima mythic halorose through the ranks the fastest, from a mere halo it became one of the most destructive force of the entire universe, then it challenged the rank 2Demonic Veyll Mythic halo.

It was a fight that greatly affected the entire universe, Nihil-Anima even though ranked an whole rank below, still brought Demonic Veyll mythic halo near death but after being weakened in the fight; a demon god who had already secretly formed a bond with rank 2 halo attacked Nihil-Anima along with that demonic Mythic halo.

Hence is the reason why even someone as low levelled as you were able to devour it and form a bond, it was far too weakened under their combined attack and could only slaughter its way through to escape, but it lost the entire armies of Souls that it controlled.
It was resting in this labyrinth that was created because of the corpse of the demon lord that Nihil-Anima had killed and brought along before escaping.
Well that's the gist of this, now that Nihil-Anima had become yours you will get to know more in the future, but even in such a weak state, I can't understand how you did it, that's just impossible."

Vritra listened carefully and felt quite shocked, even that tiny part of that invisible flame was so terrifying not to mention that it could control an enormous army of souls, no wonder that even the ranked 2 mythic halo almost got devoured by it if it wasn't for that demon god.
"Of course, the Demonic Veyll was in an even weakened state and the demon god too suffered a serious injury while most of his army ended up dying." Yasmine spoke.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Extract!!
paragraphs: "The demon god too suffered a serious injury, while most of his army ended up dying. Such is the power of Nihil-Anima.

Even at my prime, I wouldn't be a match for it, though now you will both have to grow together," Yasmine spoke. Her tone held pride, but she wasn't the least bit disrespectful or disdainful towards Vritra— instead, she seemed quite impressed by him.
"Oh, I understand the part about Nihil-Anima, and I also know that I can't let anyone know about this, not until I am strong enough. But it's a lot to take in, so I will need some more time.
I can feel something different in my body. It's like there is a different presence— so that's the invisible flames," Vritra mumbled, then he looked into Yasmine's eyes and spoke:
"But what about you? How did you end up here and in such a state?" Vritra questioned.

After a short pause, Yasmine spoke: "For now, just know that the demons are responsible for all this. After my body was destroyed, I had to escape, and this was the perfect place for me to hide because of the presence of Nihil-Anima.

It allowed me to stay alive even if it's in this state, after all I was nothing more than a soul now, thankfully it didn't devour me and allowed me to stay here and even kept me alive, sharing some energy with me.

After staying here for some time, I was able to control this cave to some extent. Quite a lot of people had died in this place, not even their bones were left, but you... I was quite shocked by your actions.
I never expected you to survive for so long, and by the fourth month, I was certain that even if your level is low right now, you are different and special. That's why I placed my bets on you. So..."
Just as Yasmine was about to speak in a solemn tone, Vritra interjected: "I am not going to give you my body, even if you had helped me. Anyway, tell me if you need any other help."
"I don't need to possess your body. All I ask of you is— let me bind myself to you," Yasmine replied simply.
"Can you elaborate? Have your turned into a cursed spirit or something?" he spoke, and as they talked more, he felt more relaxed.

"It means what I just said, we will form a bond. I know you can't just trust me, so you will have complete control over me in this connection, and the Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo will also help me greatly.

Even in my current state, I can help you quite a bit in your battles— not to mention my vast amount of knowledge that will be of great help to you. What do you think? There are many benefits without any drawbacks..."

As Yasmine spoke, for some reason she felt slightly nervous. The mighty dragon who fought against so many demon lords was now completely dependent on Vritra, if he really rejected then she really didn't know what to do.

"Hmmm..." He pretended to be deep in thought, though he was already sure of his decision. Not like he had much of a choice anyway, he had a feeling that even in this state this mighty dragon could actually kill him.

Seeing that Vritra still didn't reply, Yasmine's expression became a bit stern as she seemed to be thinking about some difficult choices. After a few seconds, she sighed and decided to just go all out.

"Even though this doesn't really have any bad sides for you, still let me add another benefit: if you agree, I will give you my essence blood and my Origin Scale— though there is a condition attached to it," Yasmine said. This was her limit.
"Hmmm. Everything sounds nice and all, but what do you need in return for all this? You must have some other goals, right?" Vritra asked.

"Aside from letting me survive and getting my strength back, I want you to help me regain my body, you just need to bring me back to my home— but only once you are strong enough, you are the one to decided the correct time." Yasmine spoke in an honest tone.
"I see. Also, what about the blood and scale? And what was the condition attached?" he questioned.

"My Essence Blood and Origin Scale will help you get the dragon's bloodline and dragon's physique. I am from one of the strongest dragon families— I am sure you understand how beneficial that will be to you."
She paused and then added, "As for the condition attached— if you were to accept those things, then by dragon standards, you would be considered my spouse, that is the tradition among my race."
"Oh okay, so I would be your spouse— what? Spouse?!!" Vritra was speechless as he stared at the emotionless face of the large dragon lady.
"Don't worry, it's just a weak bond and status; it won't hinder you in any way, it won't be nothing more than a title, after I get my body back, we will get rid of it."

Yasmine assured, waiting for him to accept, she had lied after all such a bond couldn't be so simple but Vritra knew nothing about all this so he couldn't possibly catch her lie, it was also a kind of insurance for her after all she too couldn't just believe him.
She knew what sharing that bond actually meant, but she really had no choice at all.

'All that will undoubtedly be of great help to me, and who knows, if I really reject her offer, she can just use this cave to kill me. But is it okay to be her spouse? Husband of a dragon? On top of that, a dead dragon? I will be married to a soul? Is that what they mean by soulmates? This is so weird.' he wondered as his expressions kept changing with each passing moment.
He couldn't help but even wonder how a human and the large dragon could possibly copulate, Vritra didn't think about them changing form since his mind was filled with some unspeakable things.
'Sigh Like she said it isn't anything serious and the benefits are too great so...'
"Alright, I accept," he spoke after a few tense minutes, and Yasmine's mood changed immediately as she released a long sigh of relief.

"That's great. The transformation of your bloodline and physique will take some time, possibly few days. Do you wish to start it now or some other time?" As she spoke, Yasmine's body began to shrink down until she looked like a white snake.
"Let's do that later. For now, I have to return to the castle and look for someone," Vritra replied.
"Okay, we will do as you wish. So let's start forming the bond— point your right hand towards me." Just as Yasmine finished speaking, Vritra pointed his right hand towards her.

Without saying a word, Yasmine flew towards his hand and entered his body through his skin. At first, he felt nothing— then a slight stinging pain, and within moments a dragon's tattoo appeared on the back of his hand before disappearing. The bond was formed, just like that.
[You have formed a bond with a Dragon.]

Vritra could now feel another presence in his mind, and he could sense that just as Yasmine had said, he had control over her to some extent. He felt relieved that she wasn't tricking him into anything.
"And we are done. Now, do you wish to continue with your killing or do you want to exit the labyrinth?" her sweet and mature voice sounded in his mind.
"I will continue it later. I have to leave, but first I want to test this halo you praised so much," Vritra said, as he looked around the messy space and soon got to work.

But what neither he nor Yasmine were aware of the fact was that in the fight of Nihil-Anima, when it was gravely injured, it had also swallowed a part of the demon god's energy— and a part of the Demon Veyll Mythic Halo before it had left the battlefield.

The domineering demonic energy was mixed and hidden in the Nihil-Anima mythic halo, which soon attracted the vast amount of demonic energy gathered in Vritra's body after all the consumption so this dangerous demonic energy didn't even try to harm him.

Even though it was just a form of energy but it was of the highest quality so it had some form of consciousness and it could feel the danger from Vritra's body, almost as if it knew that if it tried to devour Vritra's mind, it would be the one to suffer.
So unknown to Vritra, the deadly energy of the Demon God and the 2nd ranked mythic halo stayed hidden in his body.
Almost two weeks had passed, and Vritra used this time to test out the Nihil-Anima and also merge weapons nonstop— and now he was finally done.
He was able to merge all the weapons and was greatly satisfied and surprised by the weapons he got. They were just perfect.

As for Nihil-Anima, it was much more special than Vritra could have expected. Even in its weakened state, it held such strength and capability. One of its greatest abilities was to extract the soul of the dead, which could be used for various purposes like explosion, tracking, and best of all— he could turn them into deadly Wraiths.

It was like necromancy, but of souls— much more deadly than just bringing corpses back to life. As long as he channeled mana into them, they could be healed constantly, and the chances of the soul completely getting destroyed were little to none unless the attack dealt with souls.
Vritra stared at the Minotaur's corpse lying in front of him. This was going to be the last entry in his large arsenal of Soul Wraiths.
"EXTRACT!!"
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 15: Chaos...
paragraphs: "EXTRACT!!"
As he spoke, a black smoke drifted out of the body of the Minotaur's body and was instantly absorbed into Vritra's body, after the process was over he turned and glanced over the place.

"I have already fused all the weapons here and taken as many souls as I can for now, still that is already quite a big army of demonic souls. So Yasmine, shall we leave?" stretching his body he questioned.

Vritra had collected the souls of many of the demons he had killed from Goblins to minotaurs, but since Nihil-Anima Mythic halo was still weak so there was a clear limit to the army he can keep for now, even his level didn't allow him to extract the souls of all the demons he had slaughtered.
But as both of them grow stronger in the future, Vritra was sure just the army of his demonic wraiths would be enough to wipe out a kingdom or two, maybe continents and even planets...

He threw these exciting thoughts out of his mind for now, and concentrated on the presence situation, he didn't have enough time to even test his weapons or this world shattering Mythic Halo, now that he has found a way to leave this god forsaken hell, he wished to return to the capital and check up on his mother.

After making sure she is fine, he could always come back to smash the remaining levels in the death canopy and also getting the dragon's physique and bloodline while raising his army at the same time.

"Sure, but don't let my existence be known by anyone. It will put both of us in great danger, also I am curious how did you end up in this hellish place?" Yasmine asked before instructing him to go to the same place from where he had fallen in the trap.

"Sigh It's all because of those shitards, I am going to rip them to pieces after I return. If I hadn't jumped here then I would already be dead..." While they chatted, Vritra soon arrived at the destination instructed by Yasmine.
Just as he arrived there, Yasmine controlled it and opened a path in front of him revealing a long stairway leading up.
"Anyway, I am sure you already know him but meet my friend Zengis, he has been a great help in my time here." Vritra spoke pointing to the stone like weapon floating around him.
"Hehe Sure, I have been watching your interaction with... Zengis, you are really strange." Yasmine laughed, after spending some time with him she didn't seem as stiff as before.
Vritra continued to climb up the stairs as he placed Zengis back into his inventory, he was deep underground and had to climb for quite some time before bright sun light finally hit his face.

Vritra climbed the steep stairs, his senses alert despite the exhaustion weighing down on him. As each step creaked beneath his weight, the path behind him began to close, a shifting wall of stone blocking the passage back into the labyrinth over each floor.
His ragged clothes were wrapped around body, drenched in blood from the gruelling battles he had endured for so long, and the scent of death clung to him like a second skin.

He was finally out of the eerie silence of the canopy that had gripped him in a deadly grip, Vritra did not pause as he climbed. His eyes, filled with a faint anticipation, scanned the surroundings, and he moved forward without hesitation.
The moment Vritra stepped out of the labyrinth's exit, a strange silence overtook the entire area.

There were no talking, howling or even footsteps; it was completely silent except for the whistling of the wind, not even curious glances from adventurers from the labyrinth or the vendors in the market situated nearby.
Instead, people immediately stopped what they were doing, even the beasts that were roaming in the forest nearby.
All the bodies froze, movements halted, and then, as if responding to some invisible signal, the entire plaza erupted into chaos.
Vendors abandoned their stalls. Shoppers dropped their goods. Animals tied near carts began pulling at their reins, some outright fleeing. Within seconds, the busy marketplace was a ghost town.

A deadly pressure descended over a large space, most people had fainted under the crushing pressure and few even choked, gasping for breath. Even the beasts in the forests several miles around the labyrinth seemed to feel some kind of disaster as they abandoned their houses and fled at full speed.

Screams of the humans and beasts soon filled the space, even the adventurers who were around or on the first to fifth floors felt the deadly presence and panicked, they either hid or fled out of the labyrinth in haste.
Vritra stood there, barefoot and wrapped in nothing but a tattered cloth, soaked through with dried blood and grime.

His body was lean, yet clearly defined, with muscles shaped from months of battle and torment, compact and carved like sculpture. His hair was long and dishevelled, face obscured under the layers of dust and curtain of his black eyes, and his pitch black eyes half-lidded with exhaustion.
The air seemed heavy, thick with an unknown fear.

In the distance, Vritra noticed all the changes occurring all of a sudden, everyone was fleeing in terror. His gaze followed their erratic movements, wondering what could have caused such a commotion. Were they being hunted? Or perhaps an enemy was nearby? Maybe some demon?
He instantly became alert but couldn't sense any danger around.
"Is there some kind of threat around?" he asked, his voice hoarse from drinking too much of the demon's blood.
Yasmine's voice echoed in his mind, calm and steady, but there was a trace of something... amusement.
"Yes. They are fleeing after sensing the thick deadly pressure of some dangerous demon, the killing intent in the air must be really suffocating for them all."

Hearing her words, Vritra was even more alert as he looked around and tried to sense any demon nearby but couldn't find anything at all, even the humans who were around had already fled or just fainted on their spots.

"I can't sense anything, is there really a demon here?" Vritra questioned with a sceptical look on his face but then he thought of something: "Don't tell me they can sense your presence, is it you who scared them all?"

"No, it is you who looks like a walking calamity, its like fresh blood is oozing out of your body filling the entire atmosphere... haha those poor souls, they must be feeling dread, to them you must seem like a very strong and dangerous demon from the lower levels of the labyrinth." Yasmine spoke, her tone joking.
"Huh?" Vritra's brows furrowed in confusion.
He focused on all the beasts fleeing, their instincts driving them to panic, and the humans in the marketplace who were running and murmuring among themselves, clearly disturbed.
"My killing intent? But I can't sense anything..." Vritra mumbled in confusion as he looked down at his body, aside from the fresh air nothing seemed to be different.

"That is because you have already gotten used to such environment, you have slain thousands of demons and the killing intent you are unconsciously releasing is quite terrifying for these people. It will be hard for you to control it yet, and it might attract strong people and demons to you." Yasmine explained then she pondered in her mind.

'Is it just me or is there a sense of demonic aura present around him? Maybe it is because he had been devouring so many demons each day, anyway I think it will be back to normal as he stop eating them but is he really a human?'
Vritra took a deep breath, trying to feel anything strange around him, he did feel something bloody in the air but he didn't seem to have any control over it.

It had been months since he had truly been able to feel the sensation of a peaceful moment. But now, as he stood here—his body bathed in blood, his clothes torn and filthy—he could faintly feel the weight of his own presence.
"Can you help me control it?" he asked, fully aware that he couldn't head back to the castle while carrying such heavy presence.

Yasmine's reply came instantly. "It's not something that can be simply controlled in a short time. Once you experience some peaceful time you will naturally learn to keep your intent hidden, but for now I will help you contain this suffocating aura."
Vritra nodded, although he didn't completely trust Yasmine yet but with the condition they were bonded she won't be able to harm him in anyway.
All of a sudden, the heavy pressure from the air disappeared as if it never truly existed, even Vritra sensed the iron scent of blood from around him weaken.
'I should leave before people start to notice me.' He thought.

His feet moved on their own as he walked away from the labyrinth and turned towards the forest, his body moving as though on autopilot while he was still trying to process the knowledge about the killing intent and observing his surroundings. He had changed greatly since the time he had arrived in this place; it wasn't just his strength.

As he walked into the surrounding forest, he sensed the tension in the air around him. The faint and distant sounds of beasts—chirps, rustles, the occasional birdcall—faded into nothingness; there wasn't a creature in a long range around him.

He moved deeper into the trees, the shadows of the forest wrapping around him like a cool embrace. After more than five months without access to clean water or even the luxury of a proper meal, his body was in dire need of water. His throat was dry, the more demon blood he drank the thirstier he always felt but at least it kept him alive.
"I need to find water first," he muttered, almost to himself, while scanning the surrounding.
"I can sense a stream of water not too far away from here, just head south." Yasmine spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 16: Water...
paragraphs: Vritra closed his eyes for a moment, searching with his senses. It wasn't long before he too found a small stream, its water flowing clear and cold, glimmering under the weak rays of the sun filtering through the trees.

Without wasting any time, he ran towards the stream and instantly his body became a blur, with his current agility points his speed was already very fast. It took him less than a minute to cover a large distance, and soon he found the clear stream of water.
He crouched by the water's edge, drinking greedily, feeling the liquid slide down his throat in a sweet rush.
More than five months had passed since he had the luxury of drinking water, even the tasteless liquid seemed incredibly tasty.
He hadn't realized how desperately he had longed for it. The water seemed to rejuvenate him, washing away some of the grime and the fatigue.

As he stood, he unwrapped the ragged cloth that had clung to his body, peeling it off, revealing a delicate and chiselled body that was free of any marks and scars despite his bloody time in the labyrinth.
His body was lean, toned, every muscle sculpted by the brutal trials. He washed himself quickly, scrubbing away the blood and dirt, his reflection briefly catching his eye in the water.
His hair had grown quite a bit in the last five months and now looked like tangled strands. His eyes—pitch black and hollow eyes— also seemed to have changed but it was hard to point the change.

"You've have changed greatly from the time I first noticed you enter the canopy," Yasmine remarked, she still couldn't understand how a weak human like him had managed to survive all this time, his resilience was truly deadly and as a human he even devoured the demons, the dragon lady had no words.
He smiled faintly, though the gesture was empty. "More than five months had passed huh... it feels like I have been there for dozens of years."

Yasmine was silent for a moment. Then she spoke again: "The time inside the Death canopy is different from the outside world, by a little over five times. So only around a month had passed outside even if you had been inside for more than five months."
"A month..." he muttered, he remembered hearing something similar from the commander who had brought them inside the labyrinth, the situation wasn't as bad as he thought.

But looking at his hair he decided to cut them a bit since others might suspect that his hair shouldn't have grown so much in just a month, so he formed a blade of dust and without any hesitation he cut his hair short, but it still looked quite long and messy.

"Seriously, even among the dragons or the demons, I have never witnessed anyone level up so quickly. Your growth and the mythic aura are bound to grab too much attention and danger; it would be better to remain hidden for the time being." Yasmine advised, she enjoyed finally being able to talk with someone after so long.
"Yeah, I understand, anyway tell me in your current state how strong are you?" Vritra asked, cleaning his clothes a bit.

"Hmm..." after a slight pause, Yasmine's confident voice sounded in his head: "Even in this state, I can guarantee that I can at least allow you to escape even against the strongest opponents from this kingdom." She answered, if she was in her prime, she could easily destroy the entire Dunshire kingdom.
"That's good to know." Vritra no longer had much worry though that didn't mean he was going to be careless, but some people were going to have it quite rough.

With a final glance at the stream, Vritra stood and put his ragged clothes back on; then started making his way back towards the city. He didn't know the way after all he was sleeping the entire ride, but Yasmine seemed to have sensed the presence of some people not too far, she guided him towards them her voice sounding in his mind.

Vritra wasted no time he was too worried about his mother; at full speed he ran into the direction that Yasmine indicated and turned into a flash. The people who were busy running away frantically were scared out of their wits as they suddenly found this strange man running beside them out of nowhere.

His hair was long and messy and his clothes were in such bad state; blood stains were still present all over them. But as Vritra questioned, they simply answered his question and told him the direction back into the city.
So, changing his direction, Vritra headed towards the capital at his maximum speed, he wanted to make sure that his mother was fine; he didn't even want to think about any other case.
Just after a few minutes another thought came to his mind.
"Wait, won't the others be able to see my level; especially that damn goddess?" Vritra questioned, pausing for a moment.
"..." Yasmine was deep in thought for a few seconds then she sighed and replied: "Sorry but even I can't hide your status."

Vritra frowned; this will be a big problem. Even though his strength had increased miraculously but it was enough to challenge just anyone, even inside just the kingdom there must be many powerhouses who can easily kill him.

'I have to find a way to hide my status window or I really might end up dying but not going back isn't also an option.' Vritra frowned, no matter how much he racked his brain he couldn't think of a way.
Just then...
[Mutamorphis: Analysing the environment...]
[You have acquired the passive skill: Fake Status.]
"..." Vritra stared at the messages that suddenly popped then glanced at his status window and without a doubt, his status was back to what it was at level 1.

"Huh? How did you do that? Even I can't see through this illusion, just what kind of hidden skill do you have that is so terrifying?" it took her a while to calm down, despite her long life she found him to be an anomaly.
"So, you are from another world?" Yasmine asked and her question surprised Vritra, instead of answering he asked: "How did you come to this conclusion?"

"There is a legendary story about a group of people who had come here from another world, one among them had somehow managed to awaken a dormant ability and his strength increased to the level that he had defeated many demon lords. Your situation seemed similar." Yasmine explained.
"Oh? You mean to say all the people who had transmigrated to this world have different kinds of dormant abilities?" Vritra questioned in surprise.

"I don't think so, I believe only a few among them have such strong abilities but awakening such a skill is an almost impossible task so only one person before had accidentally managed to awaken it, there must be some hidden conditions set for it." She added.
"Yeah, I am from a different world and just after arriving here I was almost murdered." While answering Vritra thought about his Mutamorphis skill.
It was related to survival and adaptation to the environment so he wondered if him getting used to that situation, fighting, devouring demon flesh and all that was the precondition for its awakening.
There was a lot of things he wanted to know, but for now reaching the castle was more important so he while talking to her he began running again.
"What else do you know about this summoning thing?" Vritra asked, after his killing intent was hidden, he could feel that the restless beasts had finally started to calm down.

"From what I know, although summoning like these are rare but they aren't too rare otherwise a medium sized kingdom like this wouldn't have been able to do so. In the past, several groups of people had been summoned to this world, some from your earth while other who weren't humans."
Yasmine explained patiently, now that they have to spend a long time together so she planned to help him get stronger as soon as possible.
"Hmmm I see, then do you know anything about a goddess named Diana?" he asked another question without slowing down his speed at all.

"..." there was a momentary pause as if she was searching through her memories after almost a minute, Yasmine replied: "No, if she was something of significant strength or role, I would definitely know her, is she the goddess that summoned you."
Vritra replied with a... Uh huh
"She must not be a true god, otherwise she wouldn't be staying in this kingdom." Yasmine spoke after a moment of pondering.
Vritra had heard the word true goddess for the second time so he asked: "What does this true god means? And what difference does it make?"

"Hmm let me explain it in simple words... Gods and demon gods are entities that are-" she paused suddenly and maybe it was a coincidence the sky suddenly began to turn dark as thunder began to rumble in the dark clouds.
Vritra was surprised since the weather was fine just moments ago but all of a sudden there were such loud thundering in the sky, he felt a bit uneasy by the sight.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 17: Chaos
paragraphs: After sighing, Yasmine said:"There are some secrets that I can't speak. If I were to say them, you would be in extreme danger since knowing some things would bring the wrath of both Gods and demon gods.
Many things are bound to their senses—like even saying their real names directly would result in your death if you aren't strong enough.

Anyway, I can tell you about your goddess. Diana was born as a normal human—well, not exactly—but yeah, at her birth she was just a human, though she must have been born with—uh, let's say holy energy. Over time, she must have followed the path of the Gods and finally transformed into a Lesser Goddess.
She couldn't be compared to a real God, but there are many divine abilities that she must be able to use, just like summoning you lot here."
Vritra nodded, feeling a bit shocked by her words. It was indeed beneficial to bring along someone as knowledgeable as this lady dragon.
He found it shocking that just speaking of something would be enough to bring about a natural disaster. This only made him want to increase his strength as soon as possible.

After making sure that his mother was alright, he planned to finally undergo the huge transformation and get the dragon's bloodline and physique. Then he would return to that Death Canopy to finish his remaining business.
While several thoughts were running through his mind, Vritra suddenly remembered something as his steps came to a sudden halt. He looked up at the sky and saw the thunder crazily rumbling.
"I haven't been able to test my weapons yet. Isn't this just the perfect chance to test their abilities?"
After speaking, he quickly pulled out the weapons that he had created after several days of hard work from his inventory.

The space around Vritra lit up as soon as the two weapons came out. There was a heavy axe in each of his hands. The blades were shiny and looked as if they were made entirely of diamond. They seemed extremely sharp.
The back of the axe was like a terrifying hammer that could crush anything to a pulp. Just the sight of them would make anyone feel how heavy and dangerous they must be.
Vritra had countless options to choose from among all the weapons in that Death Canopy, but he chose these since they were the perfect slaughtering tools that suited him more than anything.
"Chaos Axe..." Vritra called out in a low voice, and as if his weapons could understand his words, lightning bolts moved over the blades.
Among the weapons that were dropped after he killed all those demons, there were all kinds of abilities and elements. But for now, he chose simple attributes for his Axe of Chaos.
First, thunder—strong enough to turn most foes to burnt corpses or at least stun even stronger opponents.

Second, sharpness and weight—for the blade and hammer side of the axes respectively. So they became extremely sharp, and on the other hand, the hammers became just as deadly, since even when he exerted little force, the weight of the axes increased exponentially at the moment of impact.
Third and last, a deadly but slow-burning poison—the more of it injected into anyone's body, the more dangerous it would become. Of course, it was only planned to be used on stronger enemies.
With these attributes, Vritra was not only prepared to fight large hordes of demons like in that Death Canopy, but he could even fight with foes much stronger than him.

WIELDER:VRITRA ARCLIS
RANK:UNKNOWN (Incomplete)
BASIC ABILITIES:
THUNDER
SHARPNESS
POISON
GRAVITY IMPACT
ADDITIONAL ABILITIES:

• Endurance: 239 (209+30)

• Luck: 40

"Hmmm. As I thought, the luck stat doesn't increase that easily. It seems only special titles can increase it for now," Vritra mumbled, then he focused on testing the axes.

He stretched both his hands out to either side of his body, putting the axes at shoulder level. After taking a deep breath, he used all his strength as he swung them in a horizontal slash, releasing a loud roar—without holding back.
WHOOSH
In the next moment, it was as if a ray of light had just flashed. Everything remained silent for a moment, and in the next instant...
BANG BANG BANG
As if a chain reaction had started, one after another, dozens upon dozens of trees in front of him were cut in half. They fell down, and instantly the area in front of Vritra became completely clear.
"Nice, it's better than I expected."
Vritra was satisfied with the result, but he wasn't done yet. In the next second, he raised both of them toward the sky.
THUNDERRRR

Bolts of lightning struck down from the sky, falling directly over the axes. For a moment, Vritra's arms trembled, but he was able to hold on. Then he lowered the axes and watched lightning bolts dangerously dancing over the blades.
The Axe of Chaos had the ability to absorb and contain the electricity for some time. Then he pointed them both forward and lightning bolts shot out.
BOOM BOOM

Immediately, all the fallen trees were blasted apart by the deadly strike. Wind blew, making Vritra's long hair flutter. He was amazed at the sight. Although he had borrowed the electricity, his weapons also had the ability to do the same upon absorbing mana.

"Not bad. This weapon matches perfectly with your fighting style, but I wonder why I couldn't see their ranks. They were fine at the start," Yasmine spoke. With these weapons alone, his strength had increased.

Vritra nodded, then put the axes away. There were hundreds of thousands of weapons that had dropped. Upon merging some special ones among them, his axes seemed to have changed somewhat—but he wasn't yet sure how big the change actually was.
"Well, they're good enough for now. After returning to that place, I will continue to make them stronger," Vritra mumbled and then set off back to the castle.
Before long, the bustling capital came into view again, but Vritra's appearance attracted countless gazes.

His tattered appearance, the blood still staining his clothes—it was as if he had been through a deadly disaster. All of it caused a stir as he entered through the outer gate of the city. People stepped aside, casting fearful glances as he passed, and even the guards near the gates paused when they saw him.
There wasn't much security at the outer gate, and despite his ragged appearance, none of the guards stopped him. It wasn't too rare for people to get attacked by the demons, after all.
Ignoring all the gazes, Vritra made his way toward the castle, moving at a slower pace.
It wasn't long before he arrived in front of the large castle. As he approached the gate, he obviously attracted the gazes of all the guards.
One of the guards approached him cautiously, his hand resting on the hilt of his sword."Who are you?" he asked, his voice tight with suspicion.
Vritra met the guard's gaze and spoke lazily: "I am one among the many who were summoned here from another world by the goddess. My name is Vritra."
They stared at him suspiciously, but a few people among the summoned ones had indeed gone missing in the labyrinth. Despite the doubt in his heart, the guard decided to ask his commander about this.
After speaking to the other guards, he turned around and ran into the castle. The others kept staring at Vritra while talking among themselves.

It wasn't long before the same guard came back running. After stopping in front of Vritra, he panted for a few seconds. As soon as he caught his breath, he spoke: "Y-You can enter. The goddess has been informed about your return, and she has asked you to go meet her immediately."
Vritra nodded in response. He was in a hurry to enter as well.

The guards blinked, then looked in recognition. After all, they had seen someone with messy hair among those people. Though now his hair was longer, and his entire appearance looked as if he had survived a bloodbath.
Thanks for reading..

chapters.title: Chapter 18: Lucky
paragraphs: News spread quickly all over the castle, and it was soon relayed that one of the persons who was supposed to have died in the labyrinth over a month ago had returned. The gates opened with an audible creak, and Vritra stepped through, still feeling all the gazes focused on him.

As he walked into the castle, a few of the guards were following behind him as if they were still suspicious; ignoring them, he decided to first go and meet the Goddess. He had already made up a story for her and everyone else.

Until he knew who was behind the event which almost resulted in his death, he had to stay vigilant; even the king and goddess might be part of this whole thing, and despite the hike in his strength, Vritra didn't believe he could defeat the entire kingdom's army just yet.
"First I will test out Diana's intentions. I wonder how strong she is," Vritra thought while heading towards the large temple.
He felt the king and the goddess were in cahoots, but he could only make his move after making sure of his opponent's strength.

While walking towards the castle, he passed by the castle grounds, and as he did, he saw a group of teenagers—his classmates—gathered in the field, though there were just a few of them. The moment they spotted him, the murmurs began. All of them stared at him in disbelief; after all, from the commander of the fourth team, they had heard that he had fallen into a trap and died.

His eyes scanned the crowd, his focus narrowing as he searched for someone familiar, but there wasn't anyone he was searching for. Neither his mother nor Max's group was there, so Vritra just glanced at the few students and then headed straight.

"H-He isn't dead? And what happened to him? His clothes are so ragged and his hair is so long. Just what has he been through?" one among the boys exclaimed. None of them were close with Vritra, but in this new world, he still felt familiar.

"But about his mother... we all thought he died, she uh..." a girl murmured, her brows knitted with a little concern, but since none of them had any good impressions of Vritra so they didn't try to talk to him.

It had already been a month since they arrived in this world. All this time they had either been training their skills or getting used to hunting demons. They had even gained a few levels by working so hard and killing those dangerous creatures levels as high as 6 to 10.

Though only the strongest of the group could deal with demons of level around 10, only Vanessa had been absent from all this ever since she heard the news of his death. The few teenagers sighed as they thought about the pitiful woman.

After walking for a few minutes, Vritra soon arrived at the magnificent gate of the temple, completely unaware of the talk of his classmates. The whole building was made of some special white stones that seemed to be glowing faintly; it looked very beautiful.
People were walking in and out of the temple, but as soon as they saw him, they hastily backed out of his way after seeing his appearance, afraid that he might attack them in the next moment.

As Vritra walked through the gates, he saw many figures dressed in white. Some were praying, while others were busy with simple chores. Upon his entrance, all the gazes were focused on him, and the reaction he received was the same as before, though their gazes were also filled with disgust.
One of the men walked closer to Vritra but stopped a few meters away from him. Then he looked him up and down before speaking with a slight frown: "You are Vritra?"
"Yes," came the simple reply.

"Follow me." All the people here knew a little about Vritra. He had received such a useless ability that could only move dust around. They were even surprised that he was able to come back alive from the labyrinth after almost a month.
The man, who looked like a priest, walked silently but with hurried steps as if he couldn't withstand the presence of the person following behind him.

They took a few turns and stopped in front of stairs. The priest turned around and glanced at Vritra with his nose wrinkled, then he spoke: "Go straight up and you will find the goddess. But be aware to behave in her presence."
Vritra nodded and didn't react to the clear disrespect. Then the priest snorted and walked away.

"You are getting quite a welcome in this place. Why did you even return if they already believed that you are dead? Is there someone you care a lot for among the people who are summoned?" the familiar feminine and sweet voice of Yasmine sounded in his head.

"Yeah, my mother," Vritra replied simply and began to climb up the stairs. The air was filled with a flowery scent which immediately reminded him of the pure and otherworldly beauty, the goddess Diana.
"I see," Yasmine responded, although their goals are important but she wouldn't want him to just forget about his previous life.
After crossing the stairs, Vritra finally saw the ethereal figure of the goddess. She was standing with her back facing him, her hands resting over the railing of the balcony.

She wore a white dress, and her milky skin seemed to be glowing. She looked so pure and delicate, even with those sinful curves. The only feeling her appearance ignited was to revere and cherish her from a distance.
Radiant, sacred, and untouched.
Vritra stopped some distance away from her and waited.
He didn't use the appraisal skill to check her level, believing that she might become aware of his probing. Instead, he asked in his mind: "Yasmine, how strong is she?"

"Your current level is 181, right?" Without waiting for a reply, she added, "Her strength couldn't be limited by numbers because of divine abilities that use her belief and holy energy, so her peak strength is at least thrice your level."

Vritra's brows creased slightly before he became calm again in the next moment. He had expected the huge difference in strength, but even after five months of torture, he didn't even possess the strength to be a tiny threat to her.
And Yasmine might be downplaying Diana's level a bit to not demotivate him, but he had just started so he didn't take it to heart, despite her appearance Diana was a few centuries old.

But his thoughts were interrupted by Yasmine: "But don't worry. If she really attacks, I can bring you to safety, though killing her with my current strength could be a little difficult. Anyway, there is still something we can do about her if you really want to.
Even if 'it' is in an extremely weakened state right now, you still hold a world-threatening level of treasure in your body, and this goddess of yours can't compare with the true Gods."

Vritra understood what treasure she was talking about. It was the terrifying Mythic Halo. He was a little curious about that last sentence, about the true gods, but he decided to ask about it later. Instead, he questioned: "What can we do?"

"Using the Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo, we can..." Yasmine shared her plan. After she finished, Vritra's lips curled into a devilish smile. If he could succeed, then his time in the kingdom would become much easier.
'I see, then-'
But before he could ask anything else, he stopped as he sensed the goddess move.

After a few minutes of silence, Diana finally turned around. She really looked breathtakingly beautiful—her deep blue eyes, tender and pink lips, and those rosy cheeks. Her beauty could only be defined by the word divine.
She had remained silent all this while to observe the young man and put some psychological pressure, yet aside from his ragged appearance, she didn't find anything strange.

After all the people returned from the labyrinth, she had received the news that Vritra had died after falling into a trap, a few others had died there too, even though she knew all about the scheme behind this but since the casualties were all low levelled so she didn't really care.
"Vritra..." Her melodic voice sounded. As Diana looked at him, no emotion could be seen in her eyes. After all, someone as insignificant as him wasn't even worth her contempt or disdain.
"Tell me, what happened inside the labyrinth?" she questioned. Her voice, although soothing to the ears, held an oppressive pressure.
Vritra took a deep breath as his act began. Clenching his fist, his expression changed to one of slight fear and awe as he glanced at the beautiful goddess, just like most others his age did.
Just by that one look, the goddess was already underestimating him. There was absolutely nothing special about him—except for those slightly higher-than-others stats.

"I had decided to venture alone inside the labyrinth s-since the commander said there are almost no demons inside. I was inside a large hall when something suddenly struck me. I d-don't remember what exactly happened. Both my mind and body f-froze at that moment, and somehow, I fell into a trap."

Vritra paused, his breathing was faster, and his face was covered with beads of sweat rolling down his forehead, pretending to still feel goosebumps from that incident. The fear in his pitch-black eyes was evident, a slight tremor could be seen running through his body, a perfect act to the last detail.
Thanks for reading...
