chapters.title: Chapter 19: Scars
paragraphs: Taking a deep breath, Vritra continued with his story.
"I was very lucky that I didn't fall all the way to the bottom of the trap to my death. Instead, my unconscious body hung over a stone that hooked my clothes...sighI was really lucky.
After I came to my senses, I was frightened and almost fell down, but luckily, before my clothes gave up, I was able to hold onto the bulging stone.

I shouted for help, and just when my hands were about to give up, luckily someone was passing by there and they heard me—and thankfully, that person helped me out. After that, he gave me these clothes since mine were torn, and then he brought me back here."

Vritra finished his story, a look of gratification on his face while Diana listened without much visible reaction, but Vritra could sense slight interest in her crystal-like eyes. Only after he had finished did she give a slight nod.
"I see."

Her expression remained unreadable. Vritra didn't know if she was involved in what happened to him or not, but just from her attitude, he didn't like this woman at all. Just her presence and gaze brought a sense of inferiority to others.

'So much luck huh...' Diana stared at Vritra for a long time, several thoughts going through her mind; of course, she had many doubts about the story he just gave her, but he was just too insignificant, so she didn't really care all that much.
Not wanting to waste any of her energy on him she nodded and spoke:
"You can leave. It's good that you have returned. For now, you can rest. You will receive further orders later."

Vritra nodded with a slightly flustered expression, his fists were still clenched, and slight shivers could be seen running across his body; all the details were easily noticed by the goddess, proving how ordinary and mediocre he really was.
'How rare, someone actually came back after their ambush. But I wonder how long he can stay alive—'

He turned and began to walk away, but just as he started to climb down the stairs, something almost invisible sparkled around his body. It was almost impossible to see, but the presence it emitted was undoubtedly chilly.

Diana's thoughts suddenly came to a shocking halt as she noticed that faint and nearly invisible flicker of aura around his body. Her eyes widened in shock and her red lips parted, yet she was unable to speak anything.
Both her mind and heart were in turmoil at this moment, she couldn't believe what she had just seen and felt, it was such an impossible sight.
As Vritra's figure disappeared from her vision, her thoughts finally exploded.
'W-Was that...'She found it hard to form a proper sentence. After taking a deep breath, she calmed her mind and wondered to herself:
"Was that a Halo? And a Mythic one at that? No no no, there is no way... a Mythic Halo wouldn't just appear like that, even more so on this insignificant human."
She walked to a chair and sat down. Then she replayed the scene when Vritra was leaving. After thinking for a few minutes, she couldn't help but exclaim:
"There is no doubt about it. That was definitely one of the Mythic Halos. How could someone like him get his hands on it?

In any case, judging from the faint colour, that Mythic Halo seemed to be the twentieth-rankedMisty EssenceMythic Halo. It has many abilities, but its strongest ability is creating reality-like illusions. Despite being ranked last, it is still extremely powerful."

Diana's voice was filled with excitement. She wouldn't even dare to think that what she saw was the 3rd-ranked Mythic Halo. These Mythic Halos were so precious that even the last-ranked one could create large chaos and bring extremely strong people to fight for it.
They were after all one of the biggest divine treasures of the world, even normal halos were quite precious, not to mention a mythic halo that even she was unworthy to possess.

'No matter what, I have to get it.'Diana thought. She was sure that such a terrifying thing wasn't stable in Vritra's body; otherwise, she wouldn't have seen that flicker of its aura. She closed her eyes and began to plan her moves.

Diana was sure that she would have to make her move as soon as possible before someone else notice it, if news of it leaks out just the name: 'Misty Essence Mythic Halo' will bring chaos to the entire kingdom.
For a long time the goddess couldn't even calm down, but one thing was for sure there was something special about Vritra.
Not only he came back alive after getting attacked by such strong warriors but he even possessed such a terrifying thing, so Diana only became more cautious in her planning.
If she were to know that it was the 3rd ranked Mythic halo, then the poor goddess might have just fainted.
Vritra left the temple under all the watchful gazes. He desperately wanted to go and meet his mother, so with hurried steps he moved towards the castle.
The distance wasn't too far away, so he arrived at the entrance within minutes. The guards were surprised at first, but the news of his return had already spread, so they didn't stop him.

He directly went towards the room assigned to his mother. Most of his classmates had gone out, so almost all the rooms were empty. Just as Vritra got close to his mother's room, the door creaked open and an old maid walked out of it with a plate full of food. She sighed and shook her head.
As Vritra suddenly appeared in front of the old maid, it gave her a startle and she almost dropped the plate. Then she looked him up and down and felt a little afraid.
"Is my mother inside?" Vritra asked, his nervousness and fear clearly evident in his eyes.
"M-Mother? So you are her son? But I heard you died in the labyrinth... Did you actually survive?" She hadn't heard the news yet, so the old maid was quite surprised, but then she smiled and nodded.

"She is inside, but..." she hesitated, and after a sigh, she added: "I won't hide anything. After she heard the news of your death, Vanessa had almost gone crazy. She tried to rush back into the labyrinth many times even after she was brought back. She won't eat anything and—"
The maid seemed to hesitate again, but then she decided to tell him:

"Over the duration of the last month, your mother wasn't able to handle the news of your death well, and she tried to take her life many times. She had lost all her will to live. If it wasn't for the goddess giving her all those expensive potions, she would have long been dead." She finished with a heavy tone, feeling very bad for her.
Vritra could no longer stand still. His mind filled with pain that not even the Serene Mind skill could deal with. He pushed open the door and rushed inside.

There he saw her—the familiar face of his mother. She was sleeping. Her body seemed considerably thinner than before, and the usual rosy colours of her face couldn't be seen. She looked so weak that the sight of her pained Vritra's heart.

This scene hurt him even more than anything he had experienced in the past five months. His love for her couldn't be described by mere words. She was the person he loved and cherished more than anything.

With slightly unsteady steps, he walked closer to the bed. There she lay motionless on the bed, looking so pale and weak, her eyes closed in sleep. But as he got closer, Vritra noticed that there were faint, barely visible scars on her wrists that weren't there before. It seemed under the effects of the potions, it wouldn't be long before they disappeared, but the sight of those marks made his chest tighten painfully.
"M-Mom..." he muttered softly.

He gently touched her wrists, his fingers brushing against the faint scars. There weren't just one or two—there were more than ten cuts. He couldn't even imagine how much physical and mental pain she must have gone through in this one month.

He touched her cheek and couldn't feel the warmth that should have been there. Her skin felt cold to the touch. Even though back on Earth, Vritra and Vanessa didn't get much time together, they both cared about each other a lot. Just like how she couldn't hear one bad word about her son, Vritra too couldn't see even a single scratch on her body.
But now...

The more he looked at his mother, the more his emotions surged—anger, grief, a violent rush of pain. Rage surged, and killing intent almost burst into the air but was stopped in time by Yasmine, or it might have harmed Vanessa.

This was all because of those people who tried to kill him. Just thinking about them, Vritra felt a desire to kill like never before. He suddenly stood up as his pupils faintly glowed with a blood-red light—completely unnoticed by both Yasmine and even Vritra himself. He wanted to slaughter the classmates that were in his team.
Along with all the guards and the commander, the king, and every person in the castle—
As the sight of his mother appeared in his mind, Vritra felt inhuman level of anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 20: Go! Halt!
paragraphs: "Vritra, STOP!! Calm down first." Yasmine's voice suddenly sounded in his mind with urgency—she could clearly sense his emotions.

"I know you are angry, but losing your temper isn't good at this time. I understand with your strength you could create a disaster in this castle, but what about your mother? Even if strong people came to stop you, I would be able to help you escape, but your mother would be in danger then.
Believe me, I know how hard it is to hold everything in, but revenge would be best if you don't get yourself hurt in the process. I am with you, and I will do my best to get your revenge."
Vritra clenched his fists until the sound of bones cracking could be heard. He closed his eyes and took a deep breath. He knew Yasmine was right, and anger wouldn't solve anything.

The emotions he was feeling at this moment were too hard to control. With heavy steps, he walked towards the window and pushed it open, letting the fresh air hit his face. He clenched the window sill.
CRACK CRACK
But even without using half his strength, the window sill broke, and cracks appeared over the entire window and stretched to the wall. Vritra loosened his grip and slowly opened his eyes.
But just as he opened his eyes, he saw something that increased his rage exponentially.
He almost couldn't hold back and jump out; on the road in front of his window, two boys were chatting among themselves and laughing as they walked, not caring about their surroundings.
One was Jace and the other was Tyler. Both of them were the underlings of Max and were in the same group as Vritra inside the labyrinth. The sight of them made him mad with endless rage.
Jace was thin and tall, while Tyler was shorter and looked like a balloon.
Their pair was quite comical to look at and was often made fun of by everyone until they joined Max's bully group and began to bully others along with him.
At this time, it seemed they were returning from some kind of training...
"Sigh, I am really hungry right now. Didn't they say we won't feel that much hunger if our level increases? I am already at a high level 7, why do I still feel the hunger?"
Tyler spoke, rubbing his round belly. With each step, his body jiggled; he was so fat not even his neck could be seen.

"Forget hunger, our instructor looked really hot today. Did you notice she kept glancing at me and how worried she looked when I charged alone at a Goblin? Haha, I might propose to her soon—" Jace said while laughing loudly, thinking about his one hundred ninety-sixth crush.
"Yeah, she was looking at you because you're a weakass, and your ability is now the most useless since some people died in the labyrinth," Tyler spoke. At least he wasn't the last.

"Oh right, did you hear that rumour? All the people were talking that someone had returned from the labyrinth. Do you believe it?" Jace questioned, while fiddling with a small knife, feeling a bit nervous since they also had a small role in that incident.
"I don't know, maybe—"
While the two were busy chatting joyfully, Vritra's rage was increasing to levels even higher than before. His pupils were flickering with a dangerous blood-red colour.

A terrifying killing intent shot out of his body that even Yasmine failed to stop in time. The air around Vritra instantly turned into bloody mist, but this time the killing intent didn't spread; instead, all of it was focused on the fat and thin teenagers.
BOOM

As if a bomb had exploded, a loud sound rang out. Jace and Tyler were suddenly crushed onto the ground as if more than a hundred-kilo weight was pressing down on them. Even the road surrounding them cracked and thrust inward.

"!!!" Vritra was surprised by the scene, and because of the distraction, his killing intent disappeared. As the scene of two bloodied figures came into view, both of them were crushed in strange postures.

Jace's body had bent such that his head was pressed against the ground between his knees, while Tyler really looked like a ball right now. Under the pressure, even their clothes were ripped until they were barely covering their bodies.
But that wasn't the worst of it. Several of their bones had cracked, and their skin was even ripped in many places as large amounts of blood began to flow out of their bodies.

As the pressure disappeared and the pain sank in, two beast-like wails sounded immediately. Just from their voices, it was evident how much pain they were feeling—their entire bodies were filled with injuries.
'Oh? Was that really me? What was that?' Vritra wondered. He hadn't even attacked them, but with just his gaze alone, they both were reduced to that state.

"Yes, that was indeed you." Yasmine said helplessly. Even for his level, the killing intent he exuded was a little overbearing. A skill might be helping him, but that still couldn't explain that suffocating killing intent, even after she was holding it back.
If she wasn't holding it back, they would have already turned into toothpaste.
Of course, it was going to be suffocating. After all, Vritra was unknowingly carrying the energy of the demon god and the 2nd-ranked Mythic Halo, the Devil-Veyll.

'What kind of demon have I found? It's hard to believe that he was just a level 1 mere five months ago, and now he has already grown so much. If he continues like this, then it won't be long before he becomes a terrifying existence. I have to help him as much as possible during the journey of his growth.' Yasmine made a resolve in her heart.
Vritra stared at the two battered and bruised teenagers, then...
"Killing intent, go!"
BOOM
"Halt!"
"Killing intent, go!"
BOOM
"Killing intent, go!"
BOOM
"Halt!"
"Hmm, not bad."

After releasing his killing intent a few times, he finally felt a bit better. Even though he wanted to keep going, both Jace and Tyler were on their last breaths at this moment. Their skin was torn, most of their bones shattered, and even their internal organs were messed up.
Of course the two boys had already fallen unconscious, their breathing had almost stopped; under the pressure these two low level humans were thoroughly crushed.
Had Yasmine not held back most of the killing intent, the commotion would have been even bigger.
The sound of the explosions had attracted many people. The guards were hurriedly rushing in their direction, and after seeing their condition, all of them gasped.
"I-Is it an enemy attack? Hurry, get them to the temple first!!" one of the guards shouted, afraid that just a touch might send the two boys to the afterlife.
"I will search this area and check who attacked them. Report it to the commander; this is very serious."
"Oh God, are t- they dead? Ugh both of them peed in their pants a- and what is that disgusting thing leaking from behind the fat one, uwaa is that shit? Did he eat the families of fish earlier?"
"Stupid, stop talking nonsense and get working if someone hear you saying such thing about them then your lazy ass will be grilled along with those fishes."
"Also, their breathing is so weak, since you cursed them earlier go ahead and give them both cpr, j- just ignore that liquid and blood coming out of their mouths."

Vritra stopped paying them attention as he heard a slight rustling sound from behind. He turned and saw that Vanessa was waking up. She groaned, and her eyelids fluttered open, but her eyes held no emotions as she stared blankly at the ceiling.

Vanessa's body trembled when she heard this familiar voice, but instantly her eyes were filled with tears. Ever since he disappeared, she had been hearing his voice. He kept appearing before her eyes, but none of it was real.
She had lost him forever.

Vanessa wanted to end her life, but the cruel people here wouldn't even give her freedom to do that—especially that goddess, who seemed to have some kind of hidden motive. And it wasn't hard for Vanessa to guess what she had planned based on the abilities that she had received.
But just as she was despairing, a shadow fell over her face. Believing that it was the maid, she listlessly raised her gaze—but her eyes widened as she saw the person standing in front of her.
"V-Vritra...?" she called out in a barely audible voice, wondering if she was still in a dream.
"Yes, Mom, it is me." He sat down beside her and gently touched her cheek. His eyes were filled with various emotions as he gazed down at her.

Feeling the warmth of his palm, Vanessa finally came back to her senses. For a few seconds, she could do nothing but stare at her son. Just as reality sank in, she moved forward and embraced him tightly, tears flowing down her cheek uncontrollably.
Thanks for reading...

Vanessa wanted to end her life, but the cruel people here wouldn't even give her freedom to do that—especially that goddess, who seemed to have some kind of hidden motive.
And it wasn't hard for Vanessa to guess what she had planned based on the abilities that she had received.
But just as she was despairing, a shadow fell over her face.
Believing that it was the maid, she listlessly raised her gaze—but her eyes widened as she saw the person standing in front of her.
"V-Vritra...?" she called out in a barely audible voice, wondering if she was still in a dream.
"Yes, Mom, it is me." He sat down beside her and gently touched her cheek.
His eyes were filled with various emotions as he gazed down at her.
Feeling the warmth of his palm, Vanessa finally came back to her senses.
For a few seconds, she could do nothing but stare at her son.
Just as reality sank in, she moved forward and embraced him tightly, tears flowing down her cheek uncontrollably.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 21: Something Indecent
paragraphs: "Y- You... sob sob This is not a dream?!! Vritra sob sob where were you sob all this time? I was so scared sob sob," Vanessa wanted to say a lot but all her words were drowned under her sobs.

She choked on her words as tears rained down her pale cheeks, staining his clothes; in a gentle and loving manner, Vritra continued to stroke her long and smooth green hair, finally finding peace after months of physical and mental torture.

Vritra hugged his mother back and comfortingly patted her back, he allowed her to cry in his arms for a long time. This was the first time he had seen his mother in such a state in over eighteen years. In his mind, her image was that of someone strong, someone who stood straight no matter what kind of problem they faced and always overcame them in the end.

But now, she looked so weak and helpless. He wrapped his arms around her in a protective manner; at this moment, more than anger, he felt sadness seeing her like this. Just like her, he also wanted to protect her from any kind of harm.
Even if he had to slaughter a few kingdoms for it, unlike those who would sacrifice their loved ones for the greater cause.
After almost an hour had passed, Vanessa finally seemed to have calmed down to some extent but she still remained in his arms and refused to move away, fearing he might disappear again.
"Tell me, what happened? Why are you in such a state? Did you get injured? Did—" once she started, Vanessa kept throwing questions at him, one after another.
"Wait mom, let me speak." Vritra said, then he released a long breath.

"Actually, while I was inside the labyrinth I had decided to wander around separately from others; not long after, someone attacked me from behind. I am not completely sure who it was or why they did it, but it must be the commander or someone from my team.

But I was able to escape and ended up falling in a trap..." Vritra began to recite the story but he hid a few things so as not to make her worry too much, like the endless waves of demons that he fought, the presence of the mythic halo, and the dragon lady.
Vanessa was very worried about him. After hearing his words she was furious and almost rushed out of the room but was held back by him. After hearing the whole story she asked:
"Who were the people that helped you?"

"They were a team of five who had gone there to hunt demons but luckily they spotted me and saved me. After bringing me back, they left immediately since they were going to some important mission outside the kingdom." Vritra replied, he had to mix some lies among all the truth.
"I wanted to thank them..." Vanessa mumbled but then her brows creased as another thought came to her mind.

"Since someone had already attacked you, now that you are back, they might try it again, we should ask..." Vanessa wanted to ask the goddess for help but she knew that the goddess couldn't be trusted, and in this situation, they couldn't trust anyone.
Neither the king nor the Goddess, not even the people they had transmigrated with; the two of them could only depend on each other.
"Heh don't worry mom and look at this." After speaking, Vritra gestured towards the empty space in front of him. Vanessa looked over and her eyes instantly opened wide in surprise and bewilderment.

"L- Level 181?!!" Vanessa stared at his status window which displayed only his level. She knew how difficult it was to level up just based on Lucian's classmates who were all still low level even after a month.

Vritra gave her time to take in all the information. He had no reason to hide his strength from his mother, the only person he trusts. On the other hand, if she still believed he was weak, it would be much easier for outsiders to take advantage of them.

"How did you get at that level in just a month?" finally Vanessa asked. She didn't even want to imagine what he must have gone through in there, all alone; just the thought made her feel a deep pain in her heart.

"Mom, you should have heard that the time inside the labyrinth is different. In the trap I had fallen into, the time there passed more than two times as fast as the outside. So it wasn't just one month for me and the people who saved me were of quite high level, they helped me kill many demons." Vritra explained, then he added:
"Now you won't have to worry about any danger, with my current strength I will protect both of us... I- I missed you so much, I was really worried about you."

Vanessa was smart enough to sense a little bit of lies in his story. She was familiar with every one of his expressions and even the way of talking, but for now, she decided not to ask any further questions. She was just so happy that he was back to her.
She could feel his worry and love. Now she was thankful that she hadn't succeeded in her suicide attempts; otherwise, she couldn't even imagine how heartbroken he would have been.
Tightening her arms around him, Vanessa's head rested over his chest. She looked downwards and her eyes held complicated emotions as if she was just about to make a really big decision.

'What would be the point of hesitating if I were to really lose him? I am happy as long as he is with me, nothing else matters.' Just as this thought came to her mind, the doubt vanished from her eyes; instead, she was determined about this decision of hers.

'I am sorry honey, your mother will have to do something indecent to you... it is for both our sakes, I hope you understand.' Vanessa sighed in her heart but she had already made up her mind. That is the only thing she could do to help Vritra and herself.

Both of them remained silent. Vanessa stayed in his arms, feeling the warmth that she missed so much. It wasn't long before Vanessa fell asleep. This time she felt relaxed unlike before where she fell asleep because of the medicines.

'Sigh we can't stay in this kingdom for too long, I will have to find a way to leave as soon as possible...' Vritra thought. Seeing his messy appearance, he decided to take a proper bath and change into a new set of clothes.
But just as he tried to move, he found himself entangled in his mother's tight embrace, even in her sleep she was holding onto him so desperately; he smiled and decided to wait until she wakes up.
The commotion of the attack soon died down even though two people were almost crushed to their deaths but no one was able to find the location or identity of the attacker.
Jace and Tyler were both brought to the temple and fed with high level healing potions, they were saved just in time, and most of their injuries healed.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 22: Soul Wraiths
paragraphs: Even though everything seemed to have returned to normal, all the people who worked in the temple noticed that something was different there—to be specific, the goddess was acting a bit different for some reason.

Diana seemed to be preparing something in her room; she even took several things from the treasury of the temple, after which the goddess didn't leave her room at all—not even coming for the prayers or anyone who came to meet her.
Even though Vritra was nothing more than a level 1, just the fact that he possessed such a dangerous Mythic Halo was enough to make her more cautious. She didn't want to leave any kind of loopholes.

The beautiful goddess, looking pure and majestic, stood in her room and gazed all around. She was already done putting up a strong barrier over the walls so even if there was a fight, she would be able to take care of everything within the walls of her large room.

"Heh, Vritra, if you were lucky enough to have survived then you shouldn't have returned to this place. Maybe you could have lived a few more days. It's too bad that your strength is so low—it would be better if I take care of that treasure for you." Diana chuckled as she continued with her preparation.

She planned to get the number 20th Mythic Halo the next day. Although the process might result in Vritra's death, she couldn't care less about someone like him who possessed such a trashy skill, even if he survives, she would have to kill him in the end.
Leaving traces of her treasure behind would only bring disaster to her in the long run.
"Just wait a bit longer, from tomorrow I will be your new owner..." the goddess felt excited, there were few things that make her feel like this.
Vanessa had such a peaceful sleep after such a long time. When her eyes opened, she found herself leaning onto her son—she had fallen asleep on his shoulder.
"Are you awake?" Vritra asked with a smile. Even though she still appeared a little tired, she already looked a bit better than before.
"Mmm." Vanessa nodded, her lips curled up and she thanked the gods that Vritra's return wasn't just a dream. But then she looked at him and saw his messy appearance.
"You urgently need a haircut and a nice bath... uh, also a new set of clothes," Vanessa said after looking him up and down, and Vritra agreed with her.
A few minutes later, Vritra sat on a chair and Vanessa stood behind him as she carefully cut his hair. There wasn't much to do; she just needed to decrease the length a little.
Since he looked really good with long and slightly messy hair, this time she pushed the hair that was covering his face back, revealing a very charming face.

"Why don't you keep them like that from now on? You look better like this," Vanessa said. She didn't get as much time with him back on Earth, so she didn't want to interfere too much in his personal life. She knew he was smart enough to know right and wrong.
"Sure." Vritra nodded. It didn't really matter to him; he just didn't like getting too much useless attention.
"I will prepare food for you while you finish your bath, and it's done." Vanessa spoke with a smile. She looked at his face and smiled—he truly looked perfect.

After nodding, Vritra left her room and returned to his own, which was right next to it. All his clothes were stored there. While Vritra was busy catching up with his mother, Yasmine silently observed Vanessa. The dragon lady could clearly sense that Vanessa wasn't a human.
But since Yasmine knew that she was Vritra's mother and had come here from another world, she understood that she must have gotten a new bloodline and physique—and it was quite a unique one at that.

'Should I ask him about it?' Yasmine wondered. From her observation, she could tell either Vritra didn't know about it or he didn't want to talk about it, so in the end she decided not to talk about it for now.
After returning to his room, Vritra headed into the bathroom while his mind was busy with many things. Even if he had a plan against the goddess, he still had to be extremely careful.
After a few minutes, Vritra was ready in a new set of clothes. He threw his wet hair back and was about to head to Vanessa's room when Yasmine's voice rang in his mind.
"Oh right, I forgot to mention before—Nihil-Anima also has an ability called corpse explosion. Even though it is still weak, I think you can do that."
'Corpse explosion... I guess I'll give it a try later. For the explosion, do I need a normal corpse or does it have to be a Wraith?' Vritra asked. He decided to try it after eating.
"Both could work. The difference will be in the size of the explosion," she replied and added a few more things she knew about this ability.

When Vritra got the Mythic Halo, he used the corpses of the demons and turned them into Soul Wraiths that were completely under his control because of the Nihil-Anima, after which a new section had appeared in his status window.
SOUL WRAITH INVENTORY:
Goblin Champions: 5000
Orc Lords: 2000
Troll Warlords: 1000
Lava Hound Elites: 500
Minotaur Commanders: 300

Vritra had only turned the strongest types among each race of demons, since there was a limit to how much Nihil-Anima could currently do in its weakened state. Yet he was quite surprised by the fact that even in a weak state, it was so strong.
Of course, he now stored most of the corpses in his inventory. Previously they were just for his emergency rations, but now with such a treasure in hand, there were countless uses for them.

But it seemed there was a time limit to turn a corpse into a Wraith. In any case, Vritra was quite satisfied with his current arsenal. If he allowed all of them to cause havoc across the temple and the kingdom, then the number of deaths would reach a very high number.

'And the best part is—even if these Wraiths are destroyed, they would only lose their form and return to the storage. I only need to exhaust some Mana to regenerate them, so as long as I can supply the mana, the army would be truly endless.'

Vritra only needed to expend his mana when he extracted these Soul Wraiths from those corpses. Then they wouldn't need any more energy and would follow his commands until they were destroyed or had exhausted all their energy.

Just to gather this army, Vritra had exhausted all the mana potions in his inventory, and even then he barely made it. Because of this, he was tempted to use all the allocated points for mana, but he stopped his impulsive behavior.

Currently, he had a few priorities. After his small plan succeeds and his mother's safety is guaranteed, he wanted to return to the labyrinth and finish that Death Canopy trial. He also wanted to increase and strengthen his army of Wraiths.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 23: Holy-food
paragraphs: First of all, Vritra had to find a way to strengthen the Nihil-Anima for the purpose of strengthening his soul wraiths. This seemed to be its current limit. Although after finding a host it had already started to heal, the speed wasn't too fast, so Vritra had many things he needed to do currently.

Even making his Axe of Chaos stronger also needed him to return to the labyrinth. Another extremely important matter was getting the Dragon's bloodline and physique— it'd definitely bring him many benefits.
And all of it depended on whether his first plan could succeed.
While talking with Yasmine in his mind, Vritra walked into his mother's room, but she wasn't there at the moment, so he began to look around. Soon he noticed several books on a shelf.

His own room was rather simple. It seemed even here they were being treated based on their abilities. Now that he looked carefully, this room seemed much better in every aspect— even the mattress was much softer.
'So Mom really received a better ability? I wonder what her ability is though. Is it really related to food?' Vritra wondered.

But he didn't care much about it for now. If his mother wasn't telling him about it, then there must be a reason behind it. Although he was a little curious, he knew when it was necessary, she would tell him on her own.
Walking towards the shelf, he pulled out a book with the title:Ancient Languageand began to read. His understanding capabilities had always been abnormally great for some reason.
The door opened, and Vanessa walked in while carrying a plate full of food and a glass of milk. After entering, she saw that Vritra was reading a book.
"Let's eat. I cooked the dishes you like, healthy and delicious," she said with a big smile. It had been a long time since she cooked food for him.
Vritra put the book back on the shelf and walked to sit on a chair. Vanessa placed the plate and glass on the table in front of him.
"Hmm, it smells delicious." He sniffed the food and felt as if his soul was being cleansed. After eating bitter demon meat for months, just the smell of this food was enough to make his mouth water.

"Go ahead and taste it." Vanessa smiled. She stood by his side and waited for him to taste it, but hidden from her son, there was a nervous glint in her eyes. She hoped he didn't find out that something was strange with his food.

Vritra first silently looked at all the dishes, making his mother even more restless and nervous. In the dishes there was vegetable stew, rice, a strange looking but delicious-looking loaf of bread that probably was unique to this world, and at last, some kind of soup.
Then there was a glass of warm milk.
Thankfully, she hadn't added any meat. That was the last thing Vritra wanted to eat for now— literally.

Yes, there was no way he would be full with such a small meal— it was just for taste. But at the end of the meal, he could only rely on his stash of demon meat. Even if he didn't want to admit it, his body had started to crave that.
Both the sight and smell were just superb. Vritra was almost bewitched by the food. He knew that his mother's cooking was delicious, but this food seemed to be on an even higher level.

Not able to hold back any longer, he picked up the spoon and filled it with rice. He brought it close to his lips but paused before it could enter his mouth. Then he raised his eyes and looked at his mother.
Vanessa was extremely flustered at this moment, but with years of experience handling tense situations, she maintained a calm expression while her mind was about to explode.
'D- Don't tell me he somehow found what I added in the food.'
"Mom, aren't you going to eat?" Vritra asked.

"Oh— yes, I will. Check the food first and tell me how it tastes. It's been so long since I made something," Vanessa quickly answered. She was a very smart lady. Even Vritra couldn't catch any fluctuations in her emotions. Plus, he wasn't on guard against her.
"I see. Then I will try it." Vritra smiled and nodded. He wasted no time and filled his mouth with the rice. As he chewed, his eyes widened as his taste buds exploded.
Without giving any review yet, Vritra tasted all the things on the plate with eagerness. This was definitely the most delicious food he had ever eaten in his life, in all honesty.

As Vanessa watched him eat the food where she had added a special liquid, even she couldn't hide her emotions anymore. Her face turned bright red like a tomato. She hastily turned and for some reason began to rub the wall with her shaky hand, trying to remove imaginary dust.
"Mmm Mom, it's perfect. When did your cooking get so good? This is the best—" Vritra's words suddenly halted, and he stared in shock at the messages that suddenly popped in front of him.
[+EXP Earned.]
[+EXP Earned.]
Vritra: "..."
These experience points definitely came from the food he had just swallowed. Although the amount was so small that it was negligible with his current strength, it still came as a shock.
That wasn't all. Vritra could even sense that although he wasn't using his Dust Manipulation skill, even that had gained a small amount of EXP, though it was very little.
Countless thoughts immediately ran through his mind.

'Oh right, she told me that the ability she received was related to food. So she was telling the truth? The food she makes can give EXP and even increase the skill's EXP? Hmm, no wonder she received such good treatment. Her skill is quite good— it's just that she is still at level 1.' Vritra pondered in silence for a few seconds. If her level was higher, then the EXP he received would certainly be much higher.

"Mom, so this is your ability? This food actually gave me experience points. So it is not only delicious but even increases strength..." Vritra praised Vanessa's food and skill, but the mother in question felt as if her face was burning. She felt so embarrassed and shameful.
Without turning back she spoke, "Yes, that is my ability, so eat as much as you can. In the future, when my level increases, you will be able to level up easily without any danger."
Vritra knew she was very worried about him. He could feel her love in the food. But what he didn't know was that the love was also very intimate and sultry.
Then he began to eat the food as messages kept popping in front of his eyes. Her ability was truly very special.
Yasmine: "..."

The dragon soul in his body observed the whole scene in silence. Without a doubt, with her senses nothing could be hidden from her eyes. She not only knew about Vanessa's bloodline and physique but even knew why this food was so special.
Thanks for reading...

sentences.text: First of all, Vritra had to find a way to strengthen the Nihil-Anima for the purpose of strengthening his soul wraiths.
This seemed to be its current limit.
Although after finding a host it had already started to heal, the speed wasn't too fast, so Vritra had many things he needed to do currently.
Even making his Axe of Chaos stronger also needed him to return to the labyrinth.
Another extremely important matter was getting the Dragon's bloodline and physique— it'd definitely bring him many benefits.
And all of it depended on whether his first plan could succeed.
While talking with Yasmine in his mind, Vritra walked into his mother's room, but she wasn't there at the moment, so he began to look around.
Soon he noticed several books on a shelf.
His own room was rather simple.
It seemed even here they were being treated based on their abilities.
Now that he looked carefully, this room seemed much better in every aspect— even the mattress was much softer.
'So Mom really received a better ability?
I wonder what her ability is though.
Is it really related to food?' Vritra wondered.
But he didn't care much about it for now.
If his mother wasn't telling him about it, then there must be a reason behind it.
Although he was a little curious, he knew when it was necessary, she would tell him on her own.
Walking towards the shelf, he pulled out a book with the title:Ancient Languageand began to read.
His understanding capabilities had always been abnormally great for some reason.
The door opened, and Vanessa walked in while carrying a plate full of food and a glass of milk.
After entering, she saw that Vritra was reading a book.
"Let's eat.
I cooked the dishes you like, healthy and delicious," she said with a big smile.
It had been a long time since she cooked food for him.
Vritra put the book back on the shelf and walked to sit on a chair.
Vanessa placed the plate and glass on the table in front of him.
"Hmm, it smells delicious." He sniffed the food and felt as if his soul was being cleansed.
After eating bitter demon meat for months, just the smell of this food was enough to make his mouth water.
"Go ahead and taste it." Vanessa smiled.
She stood by his side and waited for him to taste it, but hidden from her son, there was a nervous glint in her eyes.
She hoped he didn't find out that something was strange with his food.
Vritra first silently looked at all the dishes, making his mother even more restless and nervous.
In the dishes there was vegetable stew, rice, a strange looking but delicious-looking loaf of bread that probably was unique to this world, and at last, some kind of soup.
Then there was a glass of warm milk.
Thankfully, she hadn't added any meat.
That was the last thing Vritra wanted to eat for now— literally.
Yes, there was no way he would be full with such a small meal— it was just for taste.
But at the end of the meal, he could only rely on his stash of demon meat.
Even if he didn't want to admit it, his body had started to crave that.
Both the sight and smell were just superb.
Vritra was almost bewitched by the food.
He knew that his mother's cooking was delicious, but this food seemed to be on an even higher level.
Not able to hold back any longer, he picked up the spoon and filled it with rice.
He brought it close to his lips but paused before it could enter his mouth.
Then he raised his eyes and looked at his mother.
Vanessa was extremely flustered at this moment, but with years of experience handling tense situations, she maintained a calm expression while her mind was about to explode.
'D- Don't tell me he somehow found what I added in the food.'
"Mom, aren't you going to eat?" Vritra asked.
"Oh— yes, I will.
Check the food first and tell me how it tastes.
It's been so long since I made something," Vanessa quickly answered.
She was a very smart lady.
Even Vritra couldn't catch any fluctuations in her emotions.
Plus, he wasn't on guard against her.
"I see.
Then I will try it." Vritra smiled and nodded.
He wasted no time and filled his mouth with the rice.
As he chewed, his eyes widened as his taste buds exploded.
Without giving any review yet, Vritra tasted all the things on the plate with eagerness.
This was definitely the most delicious food he had ever eaten in his life, in all honesty.
As Vanessa watched him eat the food where she had added a special liquid, even she couldn't hide her emotions anymore.
Her face turned bright red like a tomato.
She hastily turned and for some reason began to rub the wall with her shaky hand, trying to remove imaginary dust.
"Mmm Mom, it's perfect.
When did your cooking get so good?
This is the best—" Vritra's words suddenly halted, and he stared in shock at the messages that suddenly popped in front of him.
[+EXP Earned.]
[+EXP Earned.]
Vritra: "..."
These experience points definitely came from the food he had just swallowed.
Although the amount was so small that it was negligible with his current strength, it still came as a shock.
That wasn't all.
Vritra could even sense that although he wasn't using his Dust Manipulation skill, even that had gained a small amount of EXP, though it was very little.
Countless thoughts immediately ran through his mind.
'Oh right, she told me that the ability she received was related to food.
So she was telling the truth?
The food she makes can give EXP and even increase the skill's EXP?
Hmm, no wonder she received such good treatment.

Her ability was truly very special.

chapters.title: Chapter 24: Squeeze~?
paragraphs: 'Is this normal between humans from another world? Is this how they nurture their child or is it that thing... keeping the bloodline pure?' Yasmine was amused and intrigued by Vanessa's action. She could tell for sure that Vritra wasn't aware of any of it.
For a moment, she wondered if she should inform him about it but ultimately decided not to.

'It's not like she is going to harm him, and it is quite fun to watch. Heh, let's see how it turns out.' Yasmine had been quite bored before, but now it seemed her life was going to be full of surprises and fun.
As Vritra finished all the food, Vanessa had finally calmed down quite a bit, though internally she was still shocked at what she had just done. She looked and saw that he had eaten all the dishes.
'Sigh... I wonder how he would react if he were to know that I hadn't received any ability related to food but what I obtained was...' She lightly chewed her lip and continued with her thoughts:
'I obtained the physique and bloodline of a Succubus Queen, and even the abilities I have are all too... erotic. Even though we both get stronger with my abilities alone, the methods are just...'

Vanessa couldn't finish her thoughts, but no matter what, she would rather go through that shameful path than stay weak and not help her son in getting stronger, which will definitely put them both into extreme danger in the future.
"Mom, are there any leftovers?" Vritra asked, as he licked his lips. Experience points aside, the food was heavenly.
Vanessa mechanically nodded her head, took the utensils from Vritra, and walked out of the room with hurried steps.
"Hmm... she is acting a bit weird. I wonder what's mom thinking." He wondered, but it didn't seem like there was any problem, so he didn't think too much about it.

In the end, Vritra ate a couple more portions of the food. Even though he wasn't full yet, he decided to finally stop—albeit reluctantly. He rubbed his belly, pretending to be full. Now only the glass of milk remained.

To his right, Vanessa was eating her own food. Of course, her food was perfectly normal since her holy fluid wasn't going to have any effect on herself, and she would never add that magical nectar to her food even if it did.

Vritra picked up the glass of milk and took a small sip. The moment it touched his tongue, a rich wave of flavour overwhelmed his senses. It was sweet, creamy, and unbelievably delicious—so much so that he found himself pausing just to savour the lingering taste.
The sweetness spread in his mouth. After a brief pause, he gulped it down and felt a comforting warmth travel through his body and settle in his belly.
"Sweet..." Vritra muttered unconsciously. Even the milk tasted unbelievably delicious, like it had been bestowed upon him straight from the heavens.
"COUGH COUGH!" When Vanessa heard this, she choked on her food and patted her chest, trying to hide her bright red face.
'I-It's fine. It is not like he is drinking that for the first time; he's had this... kind of milk before, although a long time ago.' Vanessa thought, trying to reason with herself.
"Are you fine?" Vritra passed a glass of water to her. Vanessa nodded.
And then suddenly came the familiar messages.
[+EXP Earned.]
"Huh? Mom, even this milk is giving me EXP? So even if you just warm something up, your ability still works? That's incredible! No wonder this milk tasted so wonderful." Vritra exclaimed in surprise.
"Is that so? That's good to hear." Vanessa buried her face into her food and muttered in a voice as low as a mosquito's.
Vritra no longer paid attention to her strange behaviour and began to drink the milk slowly, savouring the creamy taste to the fullest. It was just the perfect temperature.
After he finished the entire glass, he looked at his mother with a delighted gaze and asked:
"Mom, is there more?"
Vanessa was once again bewildered by this, but now she was getting better at hiding the tremors of her body. Without meeting his gaze, she lightly shook her head and added:
"No, that's all for now. Next time I will squee—cough, bring out more."
"Oh, okay. Bring at least five—no, eight glasses." Vritra said, the sweet taste was still lingering on his tongue, while he observed her reaction secretly.
"E-Eight?!! COUGH COUGH!" Vanessa choked on her saliva. Vritra filled her glass of water and looked at her with worried eyes.
"Are you sure you are fine? Or did you get sick since you used your ability by cooking food?" he questioned.
"No, I am perfectly fine. Don't worry, that ability isn't taxing at all." Vanessa said, as she busied herself with eating her food again.
"If you say so... I am going out—" Vritra stood up and began to speak but was interrupted by his mother.

"Wait, why don't you sleep in this room? I would be much more at ease that way. You know, after you disappeared, how scared I was, I—I even almost..." Vanessa almost choked as she wiped her eyes, looking even more weak and fragile.

"Okay, I will." After answering, he walked out of there. Then he walked into his own room. It was already getting dark, and from the distant sound, he could tell that most of his classmates had returned to the castle and seemed to be talking outside.
As soon as Vritra entered his room, he sat on the bed and fell into deep thoughts:

'Something is definitely wrong with mom. No matter how much she tried to hide it, I can tell she was very nervous, and the problem seemed to be the food and her ability... and what was that about squeeze?'

He thought about it for a few seconds but couldn't figure it out. But at least he was sure that she wasn't in any danger. She was just being sneaky and doing something without telling him. Vritra decided to think about it later, as there were more important matters right now.
"Let's eat first. Yasmine, make sure the smell of the demons' meat doesn't leak out of this room." He said and then pulled out meats of different demons, from lava hound to minotaur.
"Sure." Yasmine immediately enveloped the entire room with a layer of aura, stopping the smell and even sound from leaking.

Vritra wasted no time as he began to feast on the large amount of demon meat. Now it seemed only it could resolve his hunger, and it no longer tasted as bad. In less than twenty minutes, Vritra was done with eating. He released a long breath and rubbed his belly.
'If I am not wrong, then Diana will call me tomorrow. She must be quite desperate to get her hands on my ranked 20th Mythic Halo. Heh, I wonder what kind of expression she will make tomorrow.'

Vritra knew that the goddess had misunderstood which Mythic Halo he possessed. In fact, with Yasmine's help, he had made the invisible flames look a bit milky, plus Nihil-Anima was still incredibly weak, so she fell for it.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 25: Experiment
paragraphs: Although Yasmine and Vritra had started this plan, he was quite vigilant since this plan included a few assumptions—like the goddess would try to snatch the Mythic Halo while keeping him alive instead of first killing him and then collecting the loot—so this plan was still a bit dangerous.

Vritra wasn't worried that Diana could kill him, but once Yasmine had to use her ability to save him, then he would have no option but to leave the kingdom along with his mother. That was the worst outcome for now.
While Vritra was deep in thought, he began to feel hot. Without thinking much, he opened the window and wiped the sweat off his face.

"How strange, it wasn't so hot just now..." he mumbled, then he asked: "So how do I use that ability—Corpse Explosion? I plan to use the corpse of a goblin, not the soul wraith goblin, and how big will the explosion be?"

"Hmm, if you are just using a goblin corpse, then the explosion will be quite small. Just add a wisp of Nihil-Anima to the corpse, and whenever you will it, the corpse will explode," Yasmine explained.

After nodding, Vritra pulled out a corpse of a simple level 12 goblin from his inventory. Then he bent down and touched the corpse with his finger, letting a wisp of Nihil-Anima enter the corpse. Even though nothing changed on the surface, he could feel a slight connection as the invisible flame spread across the corpse.
"Explo—" Vritra suddenly stopped from testing this ability. After thinking for a moment, he decided that he should test it in someone else's room.
He opened the door and glanced outside. With his senses, he could feel that almost all the rooms were empty—almost!!
Two rooms, aside from his mother's and his own, still had someone in them, and after a moment, he remembered to whom these rooms belonged.
"Tyler and Jace? Heh." Vritra's lips curled up. He didn't plan to go himself. Instead, he extended his right hand and said in a low voice:
"EXHUME!!"

Instantly, a black shadow manifested and appeared in front of Vritra. It was a goblin, and although its body structure looked exactly the same as a normal goblin, it was pitch black in color, and its skin seemed to be covered by a dark fog, looking much more dangerous.
Nodding in satisfaction, Vritra first pointed towards the goblin corpse, then towards Jace's room, and gave a command:
"Take this corpse and throw it in that room, but very secretly."

Although the intelligence of these wraiths was still quite low, they could easily understand simple commands. But Vritra felt he needed to select a leader for his mindless army—an intelligent soul wraith.

The little demon wraith nodded its head, mirroring Vritra's action. Then it picked up the corpse and glanced to its left and right. After making sure, it ran towards the other corner of the corridor where Jace's room was located.
Jace and Tyler's rooms were next to each other, and both of them were in their rooms since they were recuperating after getting deathly injured earlier in the day. They were asleep at this moment.

Vritra sat back on the bed and closed the door, then shut his eyes, connecting to the senses of the goblin soul wraith—one of his abilities that allowed him to perceive everything the wraiths could sense.

Just as the wraith had opened the door, Vritra could clearly see the thin Jace lying weakly on the bed. He was deep in sleep. Although most of his injuries had healed, he was still wrapped in bandages.
And on closer look, a thin yellow layer could be seen around Jace's body. It seemed to be some kind of protective shield, probably put there to protect him by someone in case of another attack.

Without wasting a moment, the soul wraith threw the goblin in the room and disappeared instantly. It turned into a black and unnoticeable shadow and ran back towards Vritra's room. Passing under the door, it completely disappeared into Vritra's shadow.
"Let's see how it goes." After taking a deep breath, Vritra gave the mental command.
"Explode!!"
BOOOM!!!
The walls of all the rooms shook. The fire and force of the explosion spread into Jace's room and completely enveloped him before breaking into the room next to him and destroying everything.
Vritra: "..."
"Is that your definition of a small explosion?" he asked in exasperation. This small explosion was enough to shatter two large rooms.
"Huh? Isn't that weak? Try a soul wraith or a high-level corpse and see the explosion," Yasmine answered. With her standards, this was nothing.
Sighing, he decided to rest for the day. In any case, the experiment was successful, and the results were better than he expected. If he were to explode a large mountain of corpses...
Sigh,Vritra was already feeling pity for his enemies.

The explosion attracted the attention of lots of people. The guards came running towards the room and were shocked to see the level of damage. The two rooms were completely in shambles, and only two weak men could be seen in the fire.
They were rolling and squeaking like pigs on fire. Even though they were able to survive, the injuries were extremely bad, and their skin was completely scorched.

"Damn, someone attacked these two again. They aren't even the most talented in the group, so whom did these two offend? I knew it—these little rascals looked at all the women with such lustful eyes. They had it coming," a guard spoke after seeing their condition.
"Let's not waste time. We can't afford to let them die. Hey, you go inside and—" another guard was about to order.
"N- No, I am not going to do CPR and mouth to mouth this time. I did it earlier today, and now my children hate me. These bastards smell like shit; I am ready to quit this job."
"What are you talking about? I was asking you to go inform the commander about it and search the surroundings."

"Wait these two are gasping for breath, sorry but you will have to sacrifice yourself once again, but don't worry this time there mouth isn't filled with vomit and other liquids, they are only burnt... sigh do it or I'll expose your affair."
"Ugh... You are going to die a virgin captain, that's why you are single; why don't you try giving cpr this time, you could have your first kiss."

While the guards and others were busy talking, Vritra walked back to his mother's room. Vanessa too had come outside after hearing the noise, wondering if her son was affected, but she heaved a sigh after seeing him.
"What happened?" she asked.
"I was doing an experiment," Vritra replied as the two walked into the room.
"???" Vanessa had question marks on her head, but then she thought that it might be some new ability of his, so she didn't ponder much.
The two chatted for a while, talking about things from back on Earth to this new world, and soon both of them lay on the bed and closed their eyes.

Vanessa glanced at her son's face and thought:'Since I have literally become a succubus, I need to form a connection with a man and acknowledge him as my master to truly display my ability and become stronger together.'
Thanks for reading...

It turned into a black and unnoticeable shadow and ran back towards Vritra's room.
Passing under the door, it completely disappeared into Vritra's shadow.
"Let's see how it goes." After taking a deep breath, Vritra gave the mental command.
"Explode!!"
BOOOM!!!
The walls of all the rooms shook.
The fire and force of the explosion spread into Jace's room and completely enveloped him before breaking into the room next to him and destroying everything.
Vritra: "..."
"Is that your definition of a small explosion?" he asked in exasperation.
This small explosion was enough to shatter two large rooms.
"Huh?
Isn't that weak?
Try a soul wraith or a high-level corpse and see the explosion," Yasmine answered.
With her standards, this was nothing.
Sighing, he decided to rest for the day.
In any case, the experiment was successful, and the results were better than he expected.
If he were to explode a large mountain of corpses...
Sigh,Vritra was already feeling pity for his enemies.
The explosion attracted the attention of lots of people.
The guards came running towards the room and were shocked to see the level of damage.
The two rooms were completely in shambles, and only two weak men could be seen in the fire.
They were rolling and squeaking like pigs on fire.
Even though they were able to survive, the injuries were extremely bad, and their skin was completely scorched.
"Damn, someone attacked these two again.
They aren't even the most talented in the group, so whom did these two offend?
I knew it—these little rascals looked at all the women with such lustful eyes.
They had it coming," a guard spoke after seeing their condition.
"Let's not waste time.
We can't afford to let them die.
Hey, you go inside and—" another guard was about to order.
"N- No, I am not going to do CPR and mouth to mouth this time.
I did it earlier today, and now my children hate me.
These bastards smell like shit; I am ready to quit this job."
"What are you talking about?
I was asking you to go inform the commander about it and search the surroundings."

"Wait these two are gasping for breath, sorry but you will have to sacrifice yourself once again, but don't worry this time there mouth isn't filled with vomit and other liquids, they are only burnt... sigh do it or I'll expose your affair."
"Ugh...
You are going to die a virgin captain, that's why you are single; why don't you try giving cpr this time, you could have your first kiss."
While the guards and others were busy talking, Vritra walked back to his mother's room.
Vanessa too had come outside after hearing the noise, wondering if her son was affected, but she heaved a sigh after seeing him.
"What happened?" she asked.
"I was doing an experiment," Vritra replied as the two walked into the room.
"???" Vanessa had question marks on her head, but then she thought that it might be some new ability of his, so she didn't ponder much.
The two chatted for a while, talking about things from back on Earth to this new world, and soon both of them lay on the bed and closed their eyes.

Vanessa glanced at her son's face and thought:'Since I have literally become a succubus, I need to form a connection with a man and acknowledge him as my master to truly display my ability and become stronger together.'
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 26: Invitation
paragraphs: Her ability was quite similar to dual cultivation, in which both partners would grow stronger together, but it wasn't as simple.
The reason she wasn't telling Vritra about her abilities and motive yet was because... how could she just ask her son such a thing?
Like, Vritra would you like to do ecchi things, have sex with your mother and form a bond with me?
First she needed to make some small preparations and only then could she tell him openly, even though she had a reason behind what she was doing but that doesn't change the fact that it was a taboo.
'Sigh I am sure he might already be aware that my ability isn't related to cooking...' Vanessa closed her eyes and decided no to think about all this for now.
'This is just to protect both of us, nothing else...'
It was past midnight when Vritra began to fall incredibly hot, in his sleep he threw away the clothes of his upper body and then lay back, he was drenched in sweat.
This wasn't Vanessa's ability after all she is still level 1, she couldn't affect him that much.

Inside his body at this moment, the Nihil-Anima Mythic halo was resting peacefully and slowly getting restored, its life wasn't in a danger anymore after finding a host and since the energy that was corrupting it had finally left it.
Yasmine was also in a state of slumber, although her senses were spread across the room in case of any danger but her soul body was also in a state of repair under the Mythic halo.

So none of them noticed as a mixture of black and red energy drifted out of the Nihil-Anima, the black energy was the remnants of the 2nd ranked Mythic Halo while the red energy belonged to a Demonic God.
Even though both were only remnants of energies but they seemed to be possess consciousness of their own and no longer being controlled by anyone.

Instead of devouring Vritra's body, the two types of energies decided to secretly merged with it, they too seemed to have sensed a dangerous skill in his body that would cook them up if they tried to harm him.
Extremely slowly, without alerting anyone the two types of energy began to merge with his blood and flesh, the effects won't be evident until the process completes but once it is finished...

Devil-Veyll Mythic Halo is extremely terrifying, and the energy of the Demon God possessed horrifying destructive ability, it could be imagined what would happen if these things fall into the hand of a single person.

Early in the morning when Vritra woke up the first thing he noticed was the softness pressed against the side of his body then he felt a little cold, and then he noticed that he wasn't wearing any cloth on his upper both.

While his mother was sleeping right next to him using his arm as a pillow while her arms wrapped around him, he didn't think much about Vanessa's actions but he was confused about his missing clothes but after thinking for a moment he had a vague image of himself throwing it away.

"How strange..." While muttering Vritra gently moved his mother's hands and head, then he stood up as he stretched his body, he did feel that something was different but it was impossible to notice the change.
Without wasting any time, he returned to his room and then entered the bathroom after all if his planning is correct then very soon he would be getting an invitation by that arrogant goddess.
The Goddess might not be aware but the game between them had already started and contrary to what she believed it was Vritra who had made the first move.
After some time Vritra and Vanessa were eating breakfast together and once again he was obtaining experience points just by eating, the two were chatting when they heard a knock on the door.
Vritra opened the door and saw that it was someone from the temple in a white robe.
"You are Vritra?" the man asked, looking at the handsome boy standing in front of him.
"Yes." Vritra answered simply and looked at him with a questioning look.
"Goddess had asked for your presence in the temple, there is something important she wishes to discuss with you." The man in white robe said, still feeling surprised by the teenager's appearance.
"Alright, I will head there soon." Vritra nodded and without saying anything more he closed the door shut.
"What is it about?" Vanessa looked at him with a worried look, she had a feeling that this meeting might be very dangerous.
"It's nothing mom, she just wants to ask some question. You don't have to worry, even if anyone attack I can beat them up now." Vritra said with a smile, his words calmed her a bit.
After eating he left his mother in the room but didn't head straight towards the temple instead he walked randomly around the castle, looking around as if he was on a sightseeing.
But no one noticed the constantly black shadows that flew from under his feet, he scattered the soul wraiths in all directions, almost emptying the entire stack in his possession.
This was his last plan, if nothing works in the end and only option is to flee only then would he use them to cause chaos, giving him a better chance at escaping.
Except for a hundred or so minotaurs, he had emptied all the storage if all of them were truly unleashed then who would pay any attention to two fleeing figures.

After he was done Vritra finally began to walk towards the temple, on his way he had come across a few of his classmates but none of them seemed to recognize him, from gloomy to extremely charming the transformation was simply too big.
It didn't take him long to appear at the temple, once he appeared at the gate he walked inside without any hinderance, the same Priest was waiting for him the one he met the previous day.
"Where is the goddess?" Vritra asked as he stopped in front of the Priest.

"Huh?" the Priest at this person in confusion for a few seconds, he was clearly waiting here for a scruffy and messy looking figure, then it bloomed on him and he asked with disbelief: "Are you Vritra?"
"Yes."
"Oh!!" the shock was evident from his expression then he composed himself and gestured: "Cough Go up the stairs, the same one as yesterday and then enter the first room you see."
Vritra nodded and headed towards the stair, even now shadows continued to rush in all directions from under his feet.
'What did he eat to suddenly change so much? Is it really the same person?' the Priest stared in shock at Vritra's distant figure who climbed up the stairs and disappeared from his sight soon.
"Be careful, I will make my move the moment I sense that your life is in danger." Yasmine's reassuring voice sounded in his mind.

'Thanks, but don't reveal yourself until I really have no hope. If nothing goes wrong, she won't even know what had happened to her.' Vritra's voice was full of confidence but he was also a bit nervous.
The goddess was much more powerful than him currently, if he wasn't careful then his future plans would be affected quite a bit.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Arrogance
paragraphs: Yasmine's mood was solemn. If Vritra really could manage to pass this challenge, then they would gain a huge advantage, but she was worried since once the plan started, Vritra would have to hold back the goddess for a few seconds on his own.
'If only I had more energy...'

After arriving at the top of the stairs, Vritra saw the familiar balcony to his left; he continued to walk a little further and finally saw the room on his left. The door alone looked so beautiful, majestic, and expensive.
KNOCK KNOCK

He knocked on the door and waited. More than thirty minotaurs slid into the shadows and then surrounded the room. Their presence was completely hidden, since unless Vritra ordered them to act, they would be nothing more than ordinary shadows.

"You can enter." An ethereal and sonorous voice sounded from inside. Vritra pushed open the door and walked inside. What greeted him was a dazzling sight of the large room—everything here looked grand and exquisite.
It contained normal things like a bed, chairs, tables, antiques, mirrors—a lot of mirrors—and many other things.

After scanning the room once, Vritra's gaze focused on the goddess who was standing calmly in front of him, exhibiting a blinding brilliance. She looked as gorgeous as ever, her skin smooth and milky.
Vritra slightly bowed as his body trembled and his hands were shaking. He didn't even look straight at her; the game had already started.
"G- Goddess, did you have anything to ask me?" he asked. He knew such an act would be useless in front of absolute strength and absolute intellect.
But arrogance seldom went hand in hand with intelligence.
And strength becomes useless if it is not coordinated with the mind. Just by being arrogant and looking down at Vritra, Diana had already lost half the game.
"Yes, take a seat." Her voice was like a cool breeze, giving one a sense of ease, almost hypnotizing them. But as her gaze focused on Vritra, there was a bit of a surprise in her eyes.
"Are you Vritra?"
'Sigh, how many times am I going to be asked that today?'
"Yes, I am." Vritra nodded and then sat on the chair, acting nervous but also showing his attraction toward the beautiful goddess in front of him.

'Haa, just as I had expected, this guy is just like the others. Afraid of me yet entranced by me. How is he so lucky to have found that? Well, whatever.' Diana no longer thought about it. She pointed toward a cup placed on a table in front of Vritra and said:
"You can drink the tea. It is fresh."
Vritra nodded but didn't pick up the cup, as he kept looking at her, as if he had just met the love of his life.
'If I didn't know he is acting, then even I would have believed his facial expressions. It isn't easy to focus on such small details.' Even Yasmine was surprised by his acting skill.
Feeling that it was time, Diana casually waved her hand and walked in front of Vritra. A wisp of energy was released by her that spread across the room. Her pretty eyes narrowed as she questioned:
"Yesterday, did you lie about anything to me or did you hide something?"

Vritra's eyes widened, and he showed a flustered expression as if he had just been caught red handed. Then he gulped and tried to hide it: "N- No, I told you everything. I didn't lie or hide anything."
'Ha! Look at this guy, he is making it so obvious. Anyway, there is no need to waste any more time talking, I should get it done with.' Diana thought.
There were two major ways that she could currently use to steal the Misty Essence Mythic Halo without attracting any attention.

First, kill him and take it, as easy as that. But it had one major problem: if she killed the previous host, then there was a high chance that this thing might reject her, and she couldn't really force it.

Second, the one she planned to use—forcefully break the connection between them—which was a better method in this case since the connection between the two was clearly quite weak. Getting the Mythic Halo's acceptance would have a higher chance, since it would seem that Vritra had rejected it on his own.

"FREEZE!!" Diana wasted no time as she raised her slender arms at an extreme speed. Hundreds upon hundreds of invisible threads burst out from all directions and wrapped all over Vritra's body, as he was forcefully pulled to stand on his feet.
Vritra's eyes widened in shock, and aside from his pupils—which showed a terrified look—he couldn't move at all; he couldn't see any of the strings that seemed to have appeared out of nowhere.

"Hahaha! As I expected, this was too easy. Now don't try to resist and be a good child, and you will be allowed to live. Otherwise..." Diana laughed loudly. Of course, she didn't plan to let Vritra live, but giving him false hope would make the whole process much easier.
"Uuuuum hmmmm!" Vritra tried to speak and struggled desperately, but it was of no use. He could only stare at Diana's milky white hand extended toward his chest, going toward his heart.
The goddess was ecstatic, while on the other hand, Yasmine was feeling extremely anxious. She was ready to make her move at any time. The most important thing now was his life.

"Don't worry, it will be over very soon." Diana smiled as she pressed her soft palm over the area of his heart. It seemed that her physical hand had stopped in front of his chest, but a hand made of energy passed through his skin and flesh.
Diana focused as the energy hand moved inside his body, searching for one of the greatest treasures of the universe. It wasn't long before she sensed strange fluctuations.
As she expected, Vritra and this Mythic Halo hadn't merged properly, so the second method was indeed the best.
Without wasting a moment, she grabbed that faint and whitish flame, and then forcefully pulled it outside of Vritra's body.
"This is it!!" she exclaimed. Even though the struggling little flame was still connected to Vritra's body by a thin thread, she had succeeded with her plan. Now one last step remained.
'This is just too easy.' She was gloating. Now she only needed to merge it into her body and let it form a connection to her soul. Finally, she would be the new host of this Mythic Halo.

Just as that flame was pulled out of him, Vritra's mouth filled with blood, but he couldn't even cough. It felt as if his throat was being squeezed by countless invisible threads. He felt a deep pain all across his body—even his soul was under torment now.

Diana instantly injected the white flame into her chest and then guided it toward her heart and soul with her energy. But just as the white flame came into contact with her soul, she suddenly felt that something was wrong.
Her soul body trembled, showing a instinctive fear towards this unknown flame.
'This isn't right...'
Thanks for reading...
