chapters.title: Chapter 28: All Out!!
paragraphs: In the next moment, the white colour of the flame disappeared, and it transformed into an invisible flame that released waves of energy that shook her soul.
'W- What?!! It isn't the ranked 20th Misty Essence Mythic Halo? But it's clearly not a fake then...'
It only took her a moment to ponder all this as she noticed that just having this invisible flame near her soul was making her soul shudder, so she came to a terrifying realisation.
"T- Third ranked Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo?!!!" Diana was so shocked and shaken that her mind and body shut down completely for a couple of seconds.
How could this be? How the hell is this even possible?
This is absurd—such a thing in the hands of this pathetic and idiotic human?

'Wait, then that white colour was clearly forged... was it done to fool me? So he was aware of everything all this while?' Diana's heart skipped a beat. She raised her eyes and looked at the helpless boy in front of her.
The terrified gaze of the goddess met Vritra's eyes. All the panic and fear had completely disappeared, and he looked at her with a ruthless expression.
'This was a trap.' Diana instantly understood everything. Even if nothing was making sense right now, the important thing was to get rid of Vritra and move this cataclysmic thing out of her body.
She tried to move the invisible flame away from her body, but her momentary pause had given the Mythic Halo enough time to attach itself to her soul under Vritra's order.
"NO!!" Diana screamed in terror as she felt the invisible flames rapidly spreading across her soul, and she could do nothing to stop it—
No, wait, there is still one way to stop them.
If Vritra is killed before the process is complete, then everything would be fine. He is still a weak level 1—no matter how much he plots, in front of her he could do nothing.
She instantly made up her mind, but as she looked at Vritra, she saw a mocking look in his eyes. But she didn't care; she had to kill him with one strike.
At this moment, Vritra finally made his move.
'SHATTER!!' he shouted in his mind, and in the next moment, out of the shadows in the room, dozens of stones shot out.
BANG BANG BANG BANG
In the next instant, under Diana's surprised gaze, all the mirrors were shattered and the restraints on his body disappeared completely.

'How foolish. Since she underestimated me, she put up such a small trap; isn't she making it too obvious? Who puts up so many mirrors in their room? Not to mention it was obviously some kind of light element restraint, so obviously these mirrors were the carriers.' Vritra thought, as he hastily made distance between himself and the goddess.
Now all he needed to do was survive until Nihil-Anima succeeded in taking control over her soul. The distance between the two couldn't be too large.

As he gazed at his surroundings, Vritra saw that the walls of the room were covered by a thick layer of red barrier, which was set up by the goddess to cut off his escape route and also not let anyone outside notice whatever happened here.

"You are indeed smart, but too weak." Diana was enraged as she suddenly appeared in front of Vritra. Her speed was much faster than his. She raised her right hand and brought it over to her left shoulder.
WHOOSH
Vritra only had time to put his arms in front of his chest as defense. As Diana swung her arm with almost all of her physical strength, she didn't feel the need to use any of her holy energy.
Yet again, she had underestimated him.
BOOM!!
As the back of her hand struck him, Vritra was blasted backwards and his back struck the red barrier, almost breaking his backbone.

He coughed out blood, and for a moment his vision blurred. From the elbow, his right arm was blasted and turned into minced meat, filling him with pain; thankfully, there was still a pain reducing skill.
Vritra barely managed to stand on his feet. His whole body trembled and felt as if it was about to fall apart—even his right arm was broken.
[Lesser Healing Activated.]
"Oh?" Diana was once again shocked, but she quickly realised that even his level 1 status was false; now was not the time to ponder this.

If he didn't die from her previous strike, then the next would certainly take his life. She could feel the Nihil-Anima rapidly spreading across her soul. Undoubtedly, it was extremely weak right now or she wouldn't even have any chance—but she still needed to hurry.
Vritra spat out blood, then fixed his gaze on the ethereal goddess in front of him. Suppressing the pain, he rushed forward and muttered:
"EXHUME!!"
Diana didn't care about his little tricks. Since he was coming towards his death, then she would fulfil his wishes.
But just as the fuming goddess was about to take a step forward, two large hands came out of her shadows and clutched her feet.
The level of the Minotaur was above level 150. Although it was nowhere near enough to defeat her, it was more than enough to make her stumble.
Diana lost her balance and stumbled forward. She hadn't anticipated anything like that, and before she could even regain her balance, Vritra's hand shot towards her throat at full strength.
At this moment, Vritra put all of his allocation points into Strength at once.
[Allocation Points: 280]
(Strength: 240)
[Adding 280 allocation points to Strength.]
(Strength: 520)
A strange current instantly coursed through his body, filling Vritra with overflowing strength; in a moment, his strength had increased more than two times. The change was very evident.
Each of his muscles was filled with explosive power. The addition of so many stat points to Strength had undoubtedly increased his physical power by many times.
WithLesser Healing, his broken right hand was already in a much better state.
Without pausing for a moment, he clutched Diana's throat with all his strength, his fingers and nails sinking into her smooth skin.
BOOOOM!!

Vritra didn't hold back as he smashed her body into the red barrier with all his might. Even if it was not enough to injure her much, the attack left her gasping for breath. Yet Vritra didn't pause, not giving her a moment's time—he pulled her back.
BOOOM

Then, like swinging a toy around, he raised her body high up and then smashed her into the floor. The muscles of his right hand were bulging, and veins seemed as if they were about to pop out—even the bones were under immense pressure.

Even the floor was covered by the red barrier, so the floor didn't break despite such destructive force. Meanwhile, Diana felt her internal organs churn. Her main strengths were neither physical power nor defense.
She could easily kill him if she was allowed to use her holy ability—yet Vritra gave her no time to even relax. He was afraid that if Diana got even a moment, he would die.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 29: Sweet!
paragraphs: With a resounding boom, Diana was smashed against the floor. She coughed while feeling her head buzz. This much force wasn't enough to injure her, but her throat and head felt slight pain; especially the shock of Vritra's strength.
Yasmine observed everything nervously, just a few more seconds...
Vritra once again raised her body and exerted all his strength as he swung her towards the wall.

But there was undoubtedly a huge difference between the two in every aspect. Even though Vritra had managed to catch the goddess off guard, she had already regained her senses, as rage filled her being.
A mere mortal dared to hit her in such a disrespectful way; even treating her delicate body in such a bad manner.

Even before Diana was smashed into the wall or the barrier for the third time, her hands struck out at a speed that Vritra couldn't even see the attack. Her palm, containing all of her physical strength plus whatever holy energy she could conjure within seconds, hit Vritra's chest.
BOOOOOM

The force was so intense that his body flew back and collided with the barrier in a violent manner. In an instant, almost all the bones in his body had shattered while his chest caved in a bit; all the ribs were broken.

He coughed out blood and had no strength left in his body to even raise his hand. His skin was torn and blood was flowing out from all over his body, forming a pool of blood around him; his breathing was extremely shallow.

Diana wasn't planning to underestimate Vritra again. Even though she felt that this strike should be enough to kill him, she still rushed after him, and as she expected, even though he seemed to be on his last breath, Vritra had survived.
He didn't even have the strength to mutter a single word, so he gave his command in his mind, as he barely clung to consciousness.
"Exhume..."
In the next instant, more than twenty towering figures appeared in front of Diana out of nowhere, momentarily stunning her.
'I-Is this the ability of the Nihil-anima? I have to get rid of him!!'
ROAARRR

All the minotaurs charged forward, but Diana's momentum didn't pause for a moment. Her hands moved with grace as she easily tore the minotaurs in front of her into pieces as they turned into smoke and disappeared.
These strange-looking beings only managed to delay her for less than three seconds, and once again, Diana was upon the weak and helpless Vritra, ready to crush him with her next strike.

Two hands emerged from her shadows once again, clutching her feet and trying to make her fall. But how could she fall for the same trick again? Diana snorted and forcefully freed her feet by crushing those hands.

She stood in front of Vritra, her hands raised as deadly energy gathered over her palms. But Diana froze for a moment as out of nowhere, Vritra began to laugh in a maniacal way, as if in the face of danger he had truly gone mad.
"Enough!!" she brought her hands down, her face burning with anger.
Under his weak breathing, Vritra muttered with great difficulty: "F-Freeze..."

And instantly, Diana's body froze. Her palms had stopped just a few inches above his head, almost delivering a deadly blow, and only now did she notice that the colourless flames had already covered the entirety of her soul.
Dread filled the goddess at this realization. She struggled with all her might but couldn't do anything.
'I lost?' She couldn't believe that she had lost to someone so much weaker than her, all because of her stupid decisions, and now he could decide upon her life and death with a single thought.

While the goddess was dealing with her despairing thoughts, Vritra tried to cope with the pain as he took several long breaths, and under the effect of the lesser healing, he was finally able to move his right hand a little.

He took out a few bottles of healing potions from his inventory and drank them. Warmth spread across his body and his injuries began to heal rapidly. The cracked bones were soon back to their peak state; almost all of his injuries healed within the time of a couple of minutes.

Even his breathing became normal. Vritra then glanced at his right arm; although it was healing and regenerating, the pace was very slow. It would take at least a few weeks and many more potions for it to completely heal.
Finally, he looked up at the goddess. Her palms were hovering just a few inches above his head, clearly intended to turn his head into minced meat.
"Step back," he said and stood up. Diana obediently put down her hands and took a step back, standing straight like a mannequin except for the hatred and rage in her eyes.
"You lost. Now tell me, how do you want to die?" Vritra flashed a devilish smile, giving goosebumps to the goddess in front of him.
"..." Diana couldn't speak anything. Her eyes were filled with shock, hatred, disgust, and a little fear. With just one word, she might really end up dying.
'He isn't a human. I have underestimated him too much; all because of my arrogance...' Diana cursed Vritra and herself at the same time.

"Yes, you are right about all three things. If you weren't so arrogant, then you would have killed me first. If you hadn't underestimated me, then you wouldn't have just sealed this place but also used more treasures. And I am indeed not human." As he spoke, Vritra stood in front of her. He gazed at her dazzling face; he felt that it was a waste with that personality of hers.
Well, personality could be changed after her training.
'He can even read my mind?!! What do you want?' Diana was even more terrified now. She had truly become a doll in his hands—wait, only one hand now.

Vritra didn't say anything. He held her shoulder, and in the next moment, he pressed his lips against her jade-like neck, feeling her butter-like skin. The goddess thought that he planned to taint her body, but before her thought could develop any further—
He bit her neck as a little pain shot through the goddess's body. His teeth sank into her smooth, milky skin and then her warm blood flooded into his mouth. Vritra gulped one mouthful after another.

This felt even better than the potions he had drunk. Instantly, his left arm began to heal at a rapid pace. Diana shut her eyes, feeling more and more terrified; she was right—he is a demon. Now she was regretting getting greedy over a treasure. Was it more important than her life?
After a few minutes and drinking several mouthfuls of her blood, Vritra finally pulled his lips away from her neck. He licked the drop sliding down her smooth neck and muttered: "Sweet!!"
Diana's wounds healed almost instantly and Vritra was back in his peak state. He felt so full of energy that he could go another round of fight with this goddess.
"Hmm, the sweet blood of a goddess indeed tastes much better than the blood of demons." Vritra spoke as he licked his lips, giving yet another shock to Diana.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 30: Obedient
paragraphs: 'D- Demon blood? You even drank demon blood?' Knowing that he could hear her thoughts, she asked in her mind.
"You can speak," Vritra said, then he added, "Yes, I did. Do you want to try it?"
While speaking, he pulled out a glass full of strange red liquid and brought it in front of Diana.

"No!!" The frozen goddess was terrified. Demon blood was like poison for humans, but for her it was much worse. Normally, even if she drank it, she could destroy it with holy energy, but now she couldn't even gather her holy energy.
'Let's see how much command I really have over her,' Vritra thought. Even though he could clearly feel the connection with her soul, it is never too bad to test it out in advance.
"Drink it."
After he ordered, despite her inner struggle, Diana took the cup and slowly brought it over to her lips. Her eyes were full of panic and disgust, but she had no control over anything.
GULP GULP
Then she drank the liquid without any resistance, a look of horror on her face. But then she nodded that it wasn't demon blood—in fact, it was wine.
Vritra took the glass and put it back in his inventory, feeling satisfied. Just for the purpose of training, he tried a few more commands.
"Sit."
Diana sat down.
"Stand."
She stood up.
"Sit."
She sat down again.
"Hand." Vritra said as he extended his right hand, and like an obedient puppy, Diana put her soft palm over his.
"Bark."
"Woof woof," she barked in a cute tone.
Diana was burning with shame and embarrassment. She was a Goddess; a figure above all mortals and someone who is respected and revered by all.
And now he was treating her like a puppy. Her face had turned red, but she didn't even dare to curse in her mind, fearing that he would hear and punish her.
She was already getting tamed.

"Good job. Now go and sit on the chair." Hearing his next order, she stood up and sat on the same chair where Vritra had sat before. It seemed their situation and position had been completely reversed.
"Are you alright?" Yasmine asked, feeling relieved. At the last moment, she had almost made her move but was stopped by him.
'Yes, I am feeling better than ever. We succeeded,' he replied.
"Yeah, we did." Yasmine also felt quite happy at conquering this milestone. Now several of their plans would become much easier.
"How about we make a small deal?" Vritra said as he sat on the table in front of her, a small smile on his charming face—which looked very detestable to the woman in front of him.
"What deal?" she asked, biting her lip and trying not to think about her earlier treatment.
"You willingly obey my commands, and I won't force you to do anything. You wouldn't want to be treated like that in front of others, right?" Vritra spoke.

Diana was deep in thought for a few seconds, and he didn't interrupt her. After a few seconds, she realized that this was the best choice she had right now. She didn't want to become his puppet, and more than that, she didn't want her reputation to shatter.
Then she spoke in a stern tone: "Okay. Just make sure you don't cross the line."
"Hah! How arrogant. Come here and massage my left arm; it feels a bit stiff." Vritra laughed, breaking apart the air of arrogance that was once again building around her.

This time it wasn't a command, so Diana stared at him with anger. But then she stood up and walked behind him. For a moment she wanted to chop his head off, but along with this thought, a searing pain burst into her entire body.
"If you even have a thought of harming me, whether directly or indirectly, you will feel this pain. Just a reminder." Vritra said as he relaxed on the table.
Gritting her teeth, Diana stood to his left and began to massage his arm with her thin fingers and soft palm, trying her best not to crush it.

"Anyway, I have a few important things to ask, and based on the answers I will decide whether you will live or die. Also, if you try to lie or hide anything, you will be punished." He spoke and glanced at her face. Her face was twisted with humiliation and fury.
"O- Okay."
Vritra went straight to the point.
"How many people were killed during that trip into the labyrinth?"
"Aside from you, six," Diana answered, and Vritra could feel that she was telling the truth.
"Were you behind it?" he asked. His expression had turned solemn now.
"No," the goddess denied immediately. She kept massaging his arm.
"Hmm. Then is the king involved in that? What do you know about it all? What is the reason behind killing them and taking their bodies?" he questioned.
"I don't know anything about it. I was informed by the commanders that seven of you had met an accident in the labyrinth." Diana answered without showing any reaction.
"You lied. Good job. Now, get ready for your punishment." Vritra said and pulled his left hand back, and she finally stopped massaging it.
Diana looked at him with arrogance, but she was a little afraid of Vritra—not only because he held complete control over her.
He stood up and gave an order.
"Lean over this table." After Vritra spoke, Diana's body moved on its own, and her body bent forward as she placed her palms over the table and stood in position.
Vritra moved behind the confused and fearful goddess as he gazed over her rear. Even though her clothes were rather loose, even they couldn't hide those curves of hers.
Her juicy ass was round and full, looking fleshy and plump.
Vritra raised his right hand and in the next moment...
SMACK!!
He brought it down and spanked her soft ass. At the brief moment of contact, he felt the soft flesh, and after the slap her hips jiggled and bounced.
"Ahhh~" A strange sound leaked out of Diana's mouth at the sudden slap. Her eyes widened in shock, and for a few seconds she couldn't believe that someone would dare to treat her in such a manner.
Then endless malice burst into her mind—shame, embarrassment, such humiliation—but she could only curse in her mind and do nothing. Her body was shivering.
How dare a mortal touch her pure and holy body!!
How dare he hit her—so hateful and detestable...
"Now answer my previous question. If you dare to lie again, the punishment will be double." Vritra said, smiling from ear to ear. He could still feel that soft sensation on his palm.
'New achievement unlocked, I guess—spanked the goddess.' He jeered in his mind.
"I- I..." Diana was at a loss for words. She didn't want to say it since this matter was just too dangerous, and she didn't want to get involved in it in any way.
But she was sure of one thing—Vritra was certainly enjoying himself. If he really wanted to know, he could just give an order, but he was playing this strange game with her.
Thanks for reading...

Black smoke flew everywhere and covered the two of them. The box remained shut tight, but the explosion was quite small and didn’t harm them.
"COUGH COUGH I told you I had started reading books just recently—COUGH—what did you expect," Vritra spoke as he coughed and fanned the smoke away with his hand.

"COUGH COUGH," Diana coughed as well and looked at him. She almost believed that he could open it. As the two glanced at each other, both of them were covered in black color. Diana laughed at him first, then seeing that she was also a victim, she got angry and stomped her feet and ran into the bathroom.
This just wasn’t her day.
"This thing is really difficult to open, but I have a feeling that you could find something good inside, so let’s bring it along," Yasmine suggested.
Vritra nodded and waited. After Diana came out, he went to take a bath in her bathroom as well, even though the goddess wanted to reject it at first.

chapters.title: Chapter 36: The Little Plunderer-1
paragraphs: "Of course I won’t, you have earned your freedom. Anyway, let’s go."

Then the two walked out of the temple and headed to the large castle. People stopped and bowed respectfully when they passed by Diana; everyone respected her, and it seemed that just by seeing her, their day became better.
Diana raised her head high in pride as they passed by several people. She glanced at Vritra and smirked.
"You are pretty popular and respected," he said.
"Of course I am, I am a Goddess," Diana replied in a proud tone.
Soon the two entered the castle. All the guards bowed respectfully in front of her as well, and no one dared to stop them.

Together, they made their way towards the backside. The castle was truly enormous—it was quite easy for people to lose their way inside. After taking dozens of turns, Diana finally stopped in front of a large door.

In this long and wide corridor, there were only three doors. One was made of white jade, the second was made of some black ancient metal and had weapons’ shapes carved on it, while the third was made of gold.

This was one of the highly guarded places; there were dozens upon dozens of guards placed just in this corridor and their strength wasn’t weak at all. They were all clad in heavy gold armor and carried swords and spears.
All of them bowed towards Diana after she stopped in front of the white jade door. She gave an order: "Open this."

"As you command, Goddess." One of the guards opened several locks placed on the door, then pushed it open. Then they walked some distance away from the door to give her respect and let her choose whatever she wanted.
"Let’s go—" Diana said and began to walk, but was interrupted.
"Wait, I want to go inside alone; you know if you go inside with me I would be under pressure, and I get slower under pressure." Vritra spoke with a solemn face.
"Sigh, just go inside and take whichever potion you need. Don’t take too long." Diana didn’t want to argue with him, so she just decided to stand outside.
There was some kind of barrier at the door which made it impossible to see what was inside. Vritra nodded, then pulled out something from his inventory.
"Zengis, keep an eye on them." A silver-colored round stone with a flat surface appeared in his hand; there was even a face carved naturally on it.
As Vritra walked into the inventory, Zengis floated in the air right outside the door with dust swirling under it. The goddess stared at it in confusion.
’Is he stupid that he is talking to a stone, or does he think we are stupid that a stone could stop us?’ she wondered.
As soon as Vritra stepped into the inventory, his eyes widened.
"This isn’t an inventory, this is a damn factory." He exclaimed. The room was so big that several houses could be built here and there would still be a big space left.
There were several hundred shelves neatly arranged across the room. Sparkling potions were filled in delicate bottles and properly arranged.
"Let’s get to work." Without wasting a moment, Vritra found the soul potion section, which was the most important right now.

Even for the rare soul potions, there were lots of shelves; no wonder Diana was so proud and said the Dunshire kingdom is popular for its collection of potions. She was quite good at managing them all.

Vritra picked up a jade bottle that was filled with crystal clear fluid in which small tornado-like images could be seen rising constantly. He removed the cap and then drank the entire contents before throwing it away and moving on to the next.

Diana waited outside for more than ten minutes. Even though she knew that most people would just stare idiotically at the shelves and potions for a few minutes after entering, she was still getting impatient.
But she didn’t enter and just stared at the silver stone. She made herself feel better by saying that he must be amazed by seeing such a grand view.
After ten more minutes, just as Diana was about to enter, the barrier flickered and a figure with slightly red cheeks walked out, his eyes looking a bit hazy.
BURP BURP BURP BURP BURP

Five burps sounded at the same time, but the timing was the same so it sounded like one. Vritra, Yasmine, Nihil-Anima, Demon God’s energy, and Devil-Veyll Mythic Halo—all of them were full to the brim after such a big meal.

Vritra almost felt like he might really explode if he wasn’t careful with the energy in his body. His soul was constantly absorbing the vast and overwhelming energy while the others residing in his body were filled with ecstasy.
"Sorry about that," Vritra said, covering his mouth.
"Are you done?" Diana asked as she stared at the strange changes in him, but she didn’t think too much.
"Yeah, I took a few potions, just very few. That is not a problem, right?" he asked. His face looked even more flushed now.
"No, it is fine. Can we leave now?" Diana asked, still maintaining the prideful air around her.
"I need to take a weapon too. You know I am leaving for a very dangerous adventure, right?" Vritra spoke, with his mouth still covered.
"Sigh, fine, go ahead." After speaking, she glanced at the guards in front of the black door and then gave them the order to open the door and move aside, letting Vritra enter.
The guards, although confused, didn’t question her orders and did as they were told. After the door was opened, they moved further away and made way for him.
"Wait outside for me." Vritra said and then walked into the black door. This time Zengis automatically flew in front of the black door as his figure disappeared into the room.

"Whoa, t- this is crazy." Vritra’s eyes were sparkling as he stared at the countless weapons and ornaments that lay in front of him—they were truly dazzling. Most of the weapons were much better than his Axes of Chaos in most aspects. This was truly a treasure trove.
He picked one weapon after another and merged them into his Axes of Chaos, also choosing a few with good abilities to keep them as they were, to be used based on certain situations and emergencies.

After going through a lot of armor, he only liked one body armor that covered the entire body from neck to feet and was made of some kind of very tough and flexible type of leather. On touch, it only felt like silky cloth. It was pitch black in color and wouldn’t be visible in the dark, plus its defense was quite high.
He even chose a few rings that increased his stats, stuffing them all into his inventory all the while merging different weapons into his axes.
Diana waited patiently outside the inventories. She stared at the floating silver stone for a while and got bored. The guards didn’t dare to look straight at her and kept their gazes down.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 37: The Little Plunderer-2
paragraphs: Diana waited outside the inventory for a while and got bored.

’Let’s see which potions he had taken, I can ask someone to fill it up again later.’ She thought and decided to check the potion inventory. She remembered the exact number and position of each and every potion.
Without saying a word, she walked in through the white jade door. Just after entering, she staggered and almost fell forward, her eyes filled with disbelief as she stared all over the inventory.
There wasn’t a single soul potion left; the shelf was completely empty.
And most of the other potions were taken away by him. He still left many behind which he probably didn’t like, but more than half of the potions were gone just like that.
"D- Didn’t he say he took only a few? Is this what he meant by few?" Diana felt a sharp headache. This was clearly a robbery; how was she going to explain it to the others?
This was, after all, the royal family inventory. Even if they respected her, not only would her reputation be gone, but who knows—the king might ask someone from the Nine Pact to make her vanish.

"Oh!! T- The weapons..." Diana’s eyes widened as she remembered the robber had now gone into another treasure room. She rushed out of there and, without paying any attention to the guards, entered through the red door.

"!!!" Just as she expected, more than half of the weapons were gone. She took a long and cold breath, feeling her legs becoming weak. Then her gaze moved to the thief, who was busy hastily merging weapons or stuffing them into his inventory.
"S- Stop, Vritra!!" Diana spoke and rushed to his side. She held his hands and looked at him with a pleading look.

"You can’t take everything. Even I won’t be safe if you do that. Then who will keep your mother safe?" Diana said. She was well aware that since he was going out, the responsibility of Vanessa’s safety would fall on her.
"Yeah, you are right." Vritra forcefully suppressed his madness and greed as he pondered.
"How about we put up a show that someone stole them?" he suggested.

"Then all the guards standing outside and their families would be killed. It would be better if you just put them back for now. You can take whichever you like, a few—just a couple at a time." Diana said carefully. She believed that he had put all of them into his inventory.
"Hah, and now you care about other people’s lives?" he said with a mocking look but knew that he needed to solve this small problem he had just created.
Vritra glanced at the shining axes in his hands. They had already swallowed a lot of weapons, and he didn’t plan to return anything that he had already taken.
"Well, let’s do this..." After thinking for a while, he began to explain his plan to the goddess, who heard it all with a bewildered expression.
"Okay, that is the only way to shift the blame to others." Diana nodded. As she blinked her beautiful eyes, she suddenly wondered how she had ended up becoming his accomplice in crime.
"Since that is taken care of, let me take a few more weapons. This will go along better with our plan anyway." Vritra said and then continued with his plundering.
After over twenty minutes, Vritra and Diana walked out of the red door and once again entered the white jade door. She took the remaining potions as they prepared the stage.
Then Vritra took Zengis and put his friend back into the inventory. As the two parted ways like nothing out of the ordinary had happened, neither did the guards notice anything.

Before separating, Vritra had ordered Diana to take absolute care of his mother. She shouldn’t suffer even a little and be given whatever she wants. He even asked her to bring lots of barely alive demons to the castle so that Vanessa could give the finishing blow and level up.
After making all the rules clear, Vritra returned to his mother’s room where she was waiting for him. She had already prepared dinner for him by then.
The rest of the day passed quietly as the pair of mother and son spent all the time together chatting. It had been quite long since they talked like that.
Then night fell, and Vritra slept beside his mother.

Early in the morning, Vritra was all ready to go on this journey. He said goodbyes to his mother and advised her to stay in her room for the time being. Vanessa looked quite sad since they would have to be away from each other for over a month again.
But she didn’t try to stop him again. After leaving the castle, Vritra headed straight to the temple where Diana was already waiting for him. She stood calmly and proudly outside the temple.
Yet inside, she was feeling quite nervous. Vritra had emptied the biggest inventories of the royal family, after all.
"You are here." As Diana saw him approach, she smiled and acted all friendly even though she was so angry at him inside. The two chatted normally and walked towards the gate together.

All the guards and people passing by them looked at them and greeted the goddess respectfully. Vritra and Diana were just putting on a show to make everyone remember that Vritra had left the capital early in the morning. The more witnesses, the better, so that they wouldn’t associate him with the robbery that would happen later in the day.
Diana brought Vritra to the gate and bid him farewell.
"I hope your journey goes well this time." she said.
’I hope you really end up in some trap this time.’ she thought.
"Return safely and stronger than before." she said.
’Please don’t ever return. Just let me live in peace. I will keep your mother safe, so please find a dangerous place outside and rest there in peace for eternity.’ she thought.
Vritra smiled and nodded: "Don’t worry, goddess. I will return as soon as possible, and I will bring to you your favorite milk."
COUGH COUGH

While Diana appeared flustered, Vritra turned and walked away from the castle without glancing back. Now his next destination was the labyrinth with several goals to fulfil, where all of them led towards strength.

’This time I am fully prepared with all the necessary items.’ Vritra thought. Diana had even packed several boxes of food for him and even that especially made milk—several bottles of that mysterious yet delicious milk.
A lot of water and food. He was even carrying a bed; it seemed there was no limit to the size of items he could store in his inventory.
He walked for over a dozen minutes when Yasmine’s voice sounded in his head:
"I can sense a group of people following us."

’Yeah, I barely sensed it too. Though I am not surprised. I am even sure that one of them must be that commander who wanted to kill me and forced me to jump in that trap. Since I returned alive, of course they would be suspicious.’ Vritra added in his mind, but he acted as if he hadn’t felt anything.
Thanks for reading...

It had been quite long since they talked like that.
Then night fell, and Vritra slept beside his mother.
Early in the morning, Vritra was all ready to go on this journey.
He said goodbyes to his mother and advised her to stay in her room for the time being.
Vanessa looked quite sad since they would have to be away from each other for over a month again.
But she didn’t try to stop him again.
After leaving the castle, Vritra headed straight to the temple where Diana was already waiting for him.
She stood calmly and proudly outside the temple.
Yet inside, she was feeling quite nervous.
Vritra had emptied the biggest inventories of the royal family, after all.
"You are here." As Diana saw him approach, she smiled and acted all friendly even though she was so angry at him inside.
The two chatted normally and walked towards the gate together.
All the guards and people passing by them looked at them and greeted the goddess respectfully.
Vritra and Diana were just putting on a show to make everyone remember that Vritra had left the capital early in the morning.
The more witnesses, the better, so that they wouldn’t associate him with the robbery that would happen later in the day.
Diana brought Vritra to the gate and bid him farewell.
"I hope your journey goes well this time." she said.
’I hope you really end up in some trap this time.’ she thought.
"Return safely and stronger than before." she said.
’Please don’t ever return.
Just let me live in peace.
I will keep your mother safe, so please find a dangerous place outside and rest there in peace for eternity.’ she thought.
Vritra smiled and nodded: "Don’t worry, goddess.
I will return as soon as possible, and I will bring to you your favorite milk."
COUGH COUGH
While Diana appeared flustered, Vritra turned and walked away from the castle without glancing back.
Now his next destination was the labyrinth with several goals to fulfil, where all of them led towards strength.
’This time I am fully prepared with all the necessary items.’ Vritra thought.
Diana had even packed several boxes of food for him and even that especially made milk—several bottles of that mysterious yet delicious milk.
A lot of water and food.
He was even carrying a bed; it seemed there was no limit to the size of items he could store in his inventory.
He walked for over a dozen minutes when Yasmine’s voice sounded in his head:
"I can sense a group of people following us."
’Yeah, I barely sensed it too.
Though I am not surprised.
I am even sure that one of them must be that commander who wanted to kill me and forced me to jump in that trap.
Since I returned alive, of course they would be suspicious.’ Vritra added in his mind, but he acted as if he hadn’t felt anything.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 38: Evolution-1
paragraphs: Vritra walked casually in the busy market while looking around, showing interest in different things in the market.
’Do you think we can kill them all?’

"Hmm, not all of them. We can kill more than half of the group, but there are a few who are quite strong and fighting them now could bring trouble later, so let’s just leave for now," Yasmine suggested.
’Alright, but how are we going to do that? These guys are following me like their lives depend on it.’He felt a headache while sensing those prickly stares from behind.
"Leave that to me. As soon as you are out of their sight, I will take care of it," Yasmine said with confidence.
While Vritra was deep in thought, he almost collided with a large bull. Halting his steps, he took a step back, a bit surprised to see a bull walking on the street.

After focusing a bit, he saw someone riding the bull; it seemed to be a man in his twenties whose bald head was shining under the sun. He was holding a wooden staff in his hands and wearing an orange robe.
He looked like a monk, with half-closed Chinese-like eyes and a fox-like face.

"Hoho, please forgive me, pitiful one." The man spoke in a high-pitched voice that was a bit too thin for a man. Then he added: "Hello, I am Monk Shitless. I didn’t see you down there and almost hit you, please forgive me. If you don’t mind, can you tell me the way towards the temple?"
Vritra looked at the monk and sensed that his followers had paused too. After a moment, he pointed backwards and spoke: "Go straight from here."
"Okay, okay." Monk Shitless nodded with a smile.
"After going straight, ask someone else," Vritra added.
"Okay oka—sorry?" Monk Shitless was speechless, but then he narrowed his eyes and stared carefully at Vritra’s forehead. In a meaningful tone, he spoke: "I can see your fate. You!!"
Vritra rolled his eyes as he moved to the side and began to walk, but Monk Shitless continued to speak: "Be careful of all women, the ones you know and the ones you will meet in the future.
There might be dangers, heartbreaks, betrayals a— and wait... listen to me, the women around you might have hidden motives. Unknown women might even attack you in strange ways—"
Yasmine: "..."
’Wow, is he the real one?’she wondered, since all women did seem to have some motive.
Take Diana as an example, then Vanessa—even though she didn’t plan to hurt him in any way—and then Yasmine; she too had lied to him a bit about something.
"Let’s leave," Yasmine said.
Vritra nodded and continued to move forward, ignoring the monk who shrugged and continued his journey on the bull.
Suddenly, Vritra took a turn into an alley and walked into thin alleys for a while, which appeared like a maze.
For a moment, Vritra was out of sight of the people following him, and right at that moment he disappeared from there.
Vritra’s vision darkened for a moment and in the next moment, he appeared outside the capital. He looked around and asked: "Teleportation?"

"Yes, after drinking all those soul potions, my strength has restored a bit, so this much isn’t a problem. In fact, even Nihil-Anima has recovered a little, and even though you have not absorbed all of it yet, your soul has also been strengthened," Yasmine said.

"That’s good. Drinking so many bottles of soul potion wasn’t a waste after all. My army will increase by a lot this time," Vritra spoke. After leaving the capital, he walked slowly for a while then looked back and said:
"EXPLODE!!"
Instantly, a large explosion shook the castle and lots of corpses that were placed in the inventories in advance exploded. There was chaos and confusion, and a part of the castle broke.
"EXHUME!!"
Then hundreds of shadows flew out from the inventories carrying random things from there as if they were stealing different stuff. A few of them even picked up the bricks as they rushed out of there.
After travelling for a while under everyone’s gaze, the shadows disappeared and soon returned to Vritra’s side, who turned and headed towards his next destination.

Vritra once again arrived in front of the labyrinth, which looked just as dangerous as before. The people some distance away from it were calmly conducting their merchandise, and many were entering and leaving the labyrinth.

"Haa, let’s get it done with." Taking a deep breath, Vritra entered the labyrinth and followed the same path as before. Instead of taking those stairs, he decided to fall down from the same trap since that is faster.
Arriving in that familiar hall, he stepped on the trigger and then his body was swallowed by the darkness as he fell down the slanted path. But this time, he landed safely without any injury.
"And we are back!!" Vritra announced. The walls were still covered with dried blood, except there was no fresh blood now.
"Shall we start or do you need some time to prepare?" Yasmine asked, as an enormous dragon’s ethereal figure moved out of his body and floated in the sky.

Then she reduced her size and circled around Vritra. He understood what she meant. He had already discussed his plan with her. Before starting with the demon waves, he would undergo the transformation of his bloodline and physique.

"How big will the transformation be? I will still have a human body, right? Will my appearance change? Will I transform into a dragon like you? How much will my stats increase? And the marriage you mentioned—" Vritra crossed his arms and asked one question after another.
"Wait, wait, you will know all that after. As for your questions, I can answer them. The transformation will be huge; after all, your entire body will be reconstructed.
Yes, you will still have a similar body, but yeah, your appearance will also change quite a bit. You can see the change in stats yourself. You will be able to transform into a dragon at will too.

And as for marriage... yes, it is just a symbolic thing, a small and negligible matter. Back in my race, this is just what people believed and arranged for marriages, you don’t have to pay it any attention. A small matter indeed." After giving all the answers to the best of her abilities, she asked:
"So, are you ready?"
"Yes." Vritra nodded resolutely, ignoring her strange last words.
"Alright then, let’s begin." Just as she spoke, a drop of white blood flew out of the ethereal dragon and a white scale, which then floated right in front of Vritra.
"So what do I have to do?" Vritra asked, looking at the two objects in front of him.
"..." Yasmine remained silent for a few seconds. Her face was solemn at this moment and she seemed to be lost in her thoughts.
Vritra didn’t interrupt her. After all, they had quite a lot of time. He waited and soon Yasmine’s gaze focused on him.
"You have to swallow my blood and just hold that scale," Diana instructed. Vritra didn’t notice it, but a red drop of his blood floated in front of Yasmine.
"...Do you accept me?" she asked in a strangely serious tone, looking directly into his eyes.
’Does she mean this dragon transformation? Or is this how the ritual goes?’Vritra had no idea of the dragons’ customs and rituals. After a moment, he nodded and answered:
"Yes."
His lips parted and the white drop of blood floated into his mouth, while at the same time, Yasmine also took his blood into her mouth. Both of them gulped them at the same time.

Then Vritra held the white scale in his right hand. It was the same size as his palm and looked beautiful and shiny. As a warmth spread all across his body, the scale disintegrated into energy and was absorbed into his body.

Before he had time to ask anything, the hole in front of him went blank. A white fog was released out of the pores on his body, which soon turned into a cocoon-shaped layer and completely hid him from sight.
Both of Yasmine’s and Vritra’s eyes were clouded as their consciousnesses shifted into strange visions. They were completely immersed in it.

While Vritra’s mind was going through a barrage of memories, the transformation in his body began, as his body was being destroyed and reconstructed at the same time. Every cell in his body—bones, organs, blood—every part was undergoing drastic changes.
Messages upon messages poured in front of him, but he couldn’t see any of it.

[Evolution to Dragon Physique has begun.][Progress: 0%...]...[Evolution to Dragon Bloodline has begun.][Progress: 0%...]...[Your strength grows, Strength +1][Your strength grows, Strength +1]...[Your agility grows, Agility +1]...[Your mana grows, Mana +1][Your mana grows, Mana +1]...[Your endurance grows, Endurance +1][Your endurance grows, Endurance +1]...
While these messages kept popping in front of him after every short period of time, Vritra found himself in a completely separate and new space.
As the darkness subsided, Vritra was confused at first, since he didn’t find himself in that familiar cave nor was there the smell of blood.
Instead, a blurry but bright image appeared in front of him, but it was more than just an image; it was like he was inside that video but had forgotten his glasses, yet the experience was quite real.
The crying of a baby attracted his attention. Vritra turned and saw a baby girl in the arms of her mother. He didn’t know what to understand from this, but for now, he continued to observe it.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Evolution-2
paragraphs: Vritra’s gaze focused on the couple and the baby. Although the scene was a little blurry, he could clearly sense the joy of the couple as they gazed at the baby girl.
The scene changed—the girl grew, and Vritra watched several of her life moments. By now, he clearly understood that she was not a human but a dragon and most likely Yasmine.

Her home and all the people around were completely different from anything Vritra had ever seen. He saw dragons flying in the air and fighting; their strength was simply terrifying. Just a roar from them was enough to make the ground explode.

He watched the little girl grow slowly, learning new things, spending wholesome time with her family. She grew up in such a nice environment, and it was also clear that her status in her race wasn’t low. Wherever she went, everyone showed her great respect.

As Vritra continued to watch, the girl had now grown into a woman looking more than twenty years old, and Vritra was simply baffled by her beauty. If Diana was a 9/10, then she was simply a 100. There was just no comparison, and her strength too was much higher than Diana’s already. Of course, there were suitors all around who kept trying to get her attention.

Her behavior was warm towards her family and friends but cold and indifferent towards most. Diana was arrogant, but she was confident and proud. It seemed her existence itself was the epitome of perfection.

Whether it be intelligence, strength, or looks, no one could even come close to her in the entire race. With the passage of time, her strength and appearance only got better. Vritra watched several parts of her life.

The moments of joy, her sadness, the moments that enraged her, all the ones she had killed, and every emotion she had felt—Vritra could feel it too, as if he was living a different life along with her.

Hundreds of years had passed, and her name was famous everywhere. Yasmine floated in the air and looked at the night sky, her expression solemn. Vritra looked at the woman in front of him. Despite being somewhat blurry, he was bewitched by her looks. She just looked extremely stunning and seductive. Her curves had grown perfectly, with just the right amount of fat over the right places.

Vritra was surprised not only because of her mind-blowing beauty but also because he thought Yasmine couldn’t take the human form. He just stared at that figure without letting his thoughts disturb him.

Time continued to pass. At some point, Yasmine was heartbroken when her father had died while fighting against the demons. He alone had fought several Demon Lords, but in the end, even the strongest dragon—Yasmine’s father—wasn’t able to survive.

That was one of the lowest moments of her life, where she almost broke apart. Even her mother had disappeared, and it was suspected that under the schemes of the demons, she was killed too. Yasmine cried a lot at that time, and that was the last time.
Seeing that sobbing, lonely figure, Vritra felt a sinking feeling, and he just wanted to rush forward and embrace her. But unfortunately, he couldn’t do anything but watch.

Since both of her parents were gone, Yasmine had no choice but to take charge of the entire dragon race, and she became the youngest Dragon Queen. There was some resistance at first, and a few dragons even seemed to scheme behind her to take the throne.

But with her overwhelming strength, she suppressed them all. After that, she fought countless battles year after year, and just like that, hundreds of years had passed, and Vritra just continued to watch her life.
Yasmine had grown very cold and ruthless. Her strength had grown. Under her rule, the dragon race prospered, and she had become one of the strongest beings under the Gods.

As Vritra continued to observe, he saw a battle against several Demon Lords where Yasmine was beating the other side into misery. One of the Demon Lords brought out a fist-sized glowing black cube that looked magical. It glinted and sparkled.

Upon sensing the aura, Yasmine was both shocked and angry, since she recognized that this was the attack from one of the Demon Gods, and it was a rule that the true Gods wouldn’t interfere directly with anyone unless they were true Gods.
As the attack struck her, Yasmine was badly hurt, and her physical body was destroyed. But still, she barely managed to escape from the Demon Lords with her damaged and weakened soul.

She floated around for a long time, traveling a large distance until she felt an intense but weak aura emanating from somewhere, and that is how she ended up in the labyrinth and stayed in the care of the weakened Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo.

She stayed in the labyrinth for several years and had barely recovered. Vritra watched countless people falling into the Death Canopy as despair took over them. After a long time, Vritra saw himself entering, and the whole scene continued until the moment they returned to the labyrinth.

Outside the energy cocoon, Yasmine was undergoing a similar kind of experience. She went through countless memories of life, but his life was much shorter than hers, so her experience ended faster than his.
But she stayed unconscious even after the visions had ended, floating in the air as the mystical process continued.
While Vritra was undergoing the transformation, the two types of energy in his body that always remained hidden and could only come out for a very short time finally had some peace.
Demonic-Veyll and the energy of the Demonic God knew that their time had come. There was no better chance than this, and if they wished to choose Vritra as their host, they had to act now.
But both of them were wisps of energy that had been separated from their host—one of the Demon God—because of Nihil-Anima. So for now, they were barely staying alive.

After a tacit understanding, the energy of the Demonic God and Demonic-Veyll both decided to merge partially and form the bond with him. They could sense demonic energy in Vritra’s body—the amount was just enough for them to grow a little.

Black flames and purple energy merged and spread across his body, not hindering his dragon transformation but instead syncing with it perfectly. A dark purple core began to form at the center of his chest, letting the demonic energy merge and spread across his body seamlessly while also concentrating into the core.
Time passed silently inside the Death Canopy. Several days had passed just like that. Yasmine was the first to wake up, then she just floated around the energy cocoon.

They didn’t have to worry about any human falling into the trap and endangering Vritra’s life since she had halted the trap for now. With the time difference of five times from the outside world, this was the perfect and safest place for Vritra to undergo this transformation where he was almost defenseless.

Almost twenty days had passed when the transformation in Vritra’s body finally ended. It took several days more than what Yasmine had expected, but the aura around the cocoon was extremely dense and dangerous.
Thanks for reading...

She floated around for a long time, traveling a large distance until she felt an intense but weak aura emanating from somewhere, and that is how she ended up in the labyrinth and stayed in the care of the weakened Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo.
She stayed in the labyrinth for several years and had barely recovered.
Vritra watched countless people falling into the Death Canopy as despair took over them.
After a long time, Vritra saw himself entering, and the whole scene continued until the moment they returned to the labyrinth.
Outside the energy cocoon, Yasmine was undergoing a similar kind of experience.
She went through countless memories of life, but his life was much shorter than hers, so her experience ended faster than his.
But she stayed unconscious even after the visions had ended, floating in the air as the mystical process continued.
While Vritra was undergoing the transformation, the two types of energy in his body that always remained hidden and could only come out for a very short time finally had some peace.
Demonic-Veyll and the energy of the Demonic God knew that their time had come.
There was no better chance than this, and if they wished to choose Vritra as their host, they had to act now.
But both of them were wisps of energy that had been separated from their host—one of the Demon God—because of Nihil-Anima.
So for now, they were barely staying alive.
After a tacit understanding, the energy of the Demonic God and Demonic-Veyll both decided to merge partially and form the bond with him.
They could sense demonic energy in Vritra’s body—the amount was just enough for them to grow a little.
Black flames and purple energy merged and spread across his body, not hindering his dragon transformation but instead syncing with it perfectly.
A dark purple core began to form at the center of his chest, letting the demonic energy merge and spread across his body seamlessly while also concentrating into the core.
Time passed silently inside the Death Canopy.
Several days had passed just like that.
Yasmine was the first to wake up, then she just floated around the energy cocoon.
They didn’t have to worry about any human falling into the trap and endangering Vritra’s life since she had halted the trap for now.
With the time difference of five times from the outside world, this was the perfect and safest place for Vritra to undergo this transformation where he was almost defenseless.
Almost twenty days had passed when the transformation in Vritra’s body finally ended.
It took several days more than what Yasmine had expected, but the aura around the cocoon was extremely dense and dangerous.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 40: Evolution-3
paragraphs: The white energy cocoon slowly dispersed as Vritra opened his eyes for the first time in twenty days. His eyelids blinked open, revealing two blood red, crystal like eyes full of shock.
Yes, Vritra was truly baffled— not because of the change in appearance, nor because of the increase in his stats, neither due to the new energy core that had appeared in his body out of nowhere.
His body, which had been floating, slowly landed on the ground as one after another, several messages appeared in front of him.
[You have obtained the Physique of the Dragon King.]
[You have obtained the Bloodline of the Dragon King.]
[You have formed an eternal Soul bond with the Queen of Dragons, Yasmine Firehart.]
[You have obtained the...]
Vritra paused for now and didn’t read further as he looked around and soon found the lady dragon floating in the air above him. Before he could speak, Yasmine spoke first in a playful tone:
"Congratulations for getting a Dragon Queen waifu. We are now husband and wife for eternity, aren’t you lucky?"
Vritra: "..."

He was truly speechless and didn’t know what to say for a while. As the two looked into each other’s eyes, there was a sense of familiarity and closeness between them— as if they had known each other for a long time.

"Wait wait wait, didn’t you tell me this is just a temporary thing and holds no significant meaning? We will get rid of it right after? But this feels like an unbreakable bond..." Vritra finally spoke. He had felt that something was wrong from her behavior, but because of her prideful nature he didn’t expect she would choose to trick him like this.
"Oh, did I say that? Hehe, I lied. Now don’t fret over small details." Yasmine giggled, her gaze filled with mischievousness.

Previously, whenever Yasmine had talked with him there had always been an invisible wall, and she maintained a certain distance. But now she leapt through that distance and smashed the wall into pieces.
"Does the concept of divorce exist among you dragons?" Vritra rubbed his forehead. He couldn’t believe he had gotten married before even reaching age 20.
Not to mention, he had married an almost stranger. A stranger who isn’t even a human but a dragon— a dragon who only exists as a soul— and now they were eternally bound.

"Of course not. Now only death can drive us apart. Don’t worry, my husband, I will take very good care of you in the future." She spoke in a playful but also a serious tone, and after a moment she added, "But since I tricked you into this marriage, I will allow you to marry a few more wives. Of course, the number shouldn’t be too big, and I will hold the title of the first wife."

After that bonding, they had gotten quite close. Though that doesn’t mean they had started to love each other out of nowhere, but now there weren’t any boundaries between the two, and the trust couldn’t be any higher.
"L- Let’s put aside that topic for now. Let me see what kind of result this transformation brought."
He glanced at the messages again— the ones he didn’t read earlier.
[You have obtained the Essence of Demonic-Veyll Mythic Halo.]
[You have obtained the Energy of one of the Demon Gods.]
[The two energies have started to fuse.]
[Progress: 0%...]
[Progress: 100%]
[You have obtained the ’Evil-Veyll God’ Essence Core.]
[Starting the merging with your body...]

Vritra was once again surprised by these lines of messages. He had heard the name of the 2nd ranked Mythic Halo from Yasmine once before, since Nihil-Anima had fought against it and was later ambushed by the host of that Mythic Halo— one of the Demon Gods.
So this truly came as a surprise. But before he started any questions about this, he looked at his status window, eagerly waiting to see just how much his stats had increased.
Name:Vritra Arclis
Race:Dragon (???)
Titles:The Cursed Hunter (Level 5)
Class:Dust Lord (Rank: C) [SSS+(?)]
Bloodline:Dragon King
Physique:Dragon King
Halo:Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo
Weapons:Axes of Chaos
Vitality:100%
Stats:
• Luck: 40
[Allocation points: 0]
"!!!" Vritra was quite surprised as he read the stats. All the stats had increased by more than two times. Strength, endurance, and mana had even increased by an entire 500.
That was certainly an incredible jump.
"My stats... they have increased by a lot. Wait, does that mean the dragons are born with such high stats? Isn’t that a cheat?" Vritra asked in a shocked tone.
"Not all, but you have obtained the strongest bloodline among the dragons. As for me, my stats were certainly that high from the start." Yasmine replied with a smirk.
"Hah. This is a lot higher than I thought. So if I transform into a dragon, will my strength increase even further?" he asked, while staring at the stat window.
"Yes, your strength and endurance will increase after your dragon transformation. But remember, the first time is always a little painful." Yasmine joked.
"Hmm, looks like dragons have little to do with intelligence, when compared to other stats." Vritra smiled as he looked at Yasmine.
"Then congratulations on being promoted to a dumb race. You might have just become the smartest being in existence... in our race, oh so great husband of mine." Yasmine laughed and replied.
"Anyway, before we try all that— what is this?" Vritra extended both of his hands, his palms facing upwards.
Yasmine moved closer to him and gazed at them. In the next moment, a colorless flame burst out of his right hand that had already recovered a little.
And then a dark purple flame burst out of his left hand, that despite being much weaker still possessed a deadly presence. That aura startled Yasmine and she moved back slightly.

"W- Where did you get that?" she asked while staring at it cautiously. How could she forget that presence? Although it was different, there was undoubtedly the aura of a Demon God— and something else too...?

"I don’t know. A core had formed in my body when I woke up. This should be the fusion of the energy of some Demon God and a wisp of the 2nd ranked Mythic Halo." Vritra explained as the two flames disappeared.
"Ah, I understand now. Is it harmful to you in any way?" Yasmine quickly made the connection between Nihil-Anima and that purple flame. She felt worried about him.
"No, I have complete control over it. It can’t harm me— not now, not in the future." He replied, and took out a mirror from his inventory, looking over himself and again receiving a shock.
"..." The changes were clearly visible. Although he still resembled the past him, his appearance too had undergone a huge transformation.
If previously his looks were at the peak of the human race, now he had far surpassed that. His face, skin, body— everything had been modified by several levels.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 41: A Worthy Dragon King
paragraphs: Vritra glanced down at his body and could tell that his muscles had become even more refined, even his height seemed to have increased slightly; if someone wasn’t close to him, they wouldn’t even recognize him easily.
His body was slightly sleek and tall yet with perfectly refined muscles, even his skin had become buttery smooth. Yasmine observed him for a while and then nodded:
"You look even more handsome, indeed worthy to be my dragon king."
Ignoring Yasmine for now, Vritra looked at his stats and felt that his agility stat was left behind and needed immediate attention, so he decided to add more points to it after leveling up.
"Now, shall we start grinding up for levels?"
He pulled out the axes from the inventory and held the two tightly. The two battle axes had grown incredibly after devouring many higher-grade weapons.
Not only had the additional points increased from 30 to 100, but the main change was their sharpness and the gravitational increase—it could easily chop even stronger enemies without any difficulty.
"Okay, then I will call forth the 6th wave, get ready."
As soon as Yasmine stopped speaking, messages flashed in front of Vritra.
[Quest: Survive the Sixth Wave.]
[Reward: 35 Allocation Points and the title: The Cursed Hunter (Level 6)!!]
[Penalty: None]

The cave began to rumble, dust flew in the air and countless footsteps sounded at the same time. Vritra was relaxed as he watched small dots appear in the distance that slowly enlarged. Narrowing his gaze, he focused—and these creatures looked much bigger than the minotaur.
[Activating Appraisal.]
Race: Demon Giant
Level: 166
Class: Warrior Giant
Vitality: 100%
Stats:
• Strength: 320
• Agility: 210
• Endurance: 290
• Intelligence: 20
• Mana: 175

"Not bad, the demons are getting stronger with each wave." Vritra mumbled as countless blades of dust appeared behind his back and several large dust figures formed behind him, looking just like those giants.
He even called out hundreds of soul wraiths—the stronger ones in his possession—and now he noticed another small problem.
"Although the number of soul wraiths is very high, they are all too weak and could barely be used in a proper battle; a very strong opponent could wipe them all out instantly."
While the giants were rushing towards him, he was deep in thought and turned his questioning look towards the dragon lady—uh, his brand new dragon wife.
"Is there a faster way to increase their strength?" he asked.

"Yes, there is. You can either have quantity or quality. What I mean to say is, by letting those soul wraiths devour each other, their strength will increase rapidly." Yasmine answered, circling around him and watching him with interest.

His battles were truly spectacles—he literally butchered the other side without a hint of doubt. The image of him fighting for five months straight, sitting atop a big demon corpse mountain while covered in their blood, was imprinted clearly in her mind.
"I see, then let’s do that after this wave. I am sure I can handle this one on my own."
GRRRRAAAAAWWWRRR!!
ROOOOOOAAAAARRRRRRR!!
Finally, the endless waves of demons crashed into the invisible wall. They roared madly and kept hitting it, their eyes bloodshot, and they wanted nothing more than to crush their target.

"Open it." Vritra said calmly, raising the two heavy axes to either side of his body while his gaze remained on the large creatures who were all at least 25 feet, and many on the back side were more than 30 feet tall.
Vritra looked tiny in front of the horde. If they were to surround him, he would just disappear completely—yet he wasn’t the least bit afraid of them.
"Your wish is my command, Lord Husband." Yasmine said playfully, making Vritra laugh. She seemed so much different from the cold and ruthless queen he had seen in those memory fragments.

But she used such mischievous demeanour only towards him. Their marriage was like an arranged marriage where the couple falls in love after it; everything aside, the two were really comfortable in each other’s company.
"Thank you, my queen." He smiled towards the majestic dragon flying above and then got ready for the brutal battle that was about to erupt.
UUUUUUUUURRRRAAAAAAHHH!!!
BWOOOOOORRRGH!!!

Just as the invisible wall disappeared, like large zombies those giants came pouring out towards him while roaring madly, trying to hit him with their large hammers or just stomp on top of him to death.
The difference in size was actually quite beneficial to Vritra—even if these giants possessed high strength, what use was it if they couldn’t even hit him, plus the high difference in their agility.
The giants had human-like physiques but their bodies were dark blue in colour—they weren’t normal giants, but demonic giants.

They held large weapons that accidentally kept hitting the others. Despite the high levels, their intelligence was quite low. Combined with agility, Vritra didn’t have to worry about getting injured at all.
This time, his main goal wasn’t to survive—since that was a sure thing—but he wanted to slaughter as many as possible without getting hit a single time.
Vritra stomped his right foot on the ground as the area around him exploded with a loud boom and a crater formed as his figure pounced towards the approaching giants.
He took a deep breath and held it, remembering the positions of all the demons.

His strength had already crossed the 1000 mark, although that doesn’t mean he can fight someone at level 1000, but he could easily defeat those several levels higher than him—so he wasn’t the least bit worried about this fight.
Not to mention the upgraded weapon that he held.
Vritra swung both his hands at the same time as he reached the same height as a giant. Then he brought the two heavy hammers toward the head of the first giant from both sides.
BOOOOM
Instantly the head exploded, blood splattered and pieces of bones and brain matter flew all over. The giant of more than level 160 was dead—even though Vritra hadn’t even used half his strength.
But without pausing, he tapped on the shoulder of the dead giant and raised his right hand up high before bringing the axe down, hitting the top of the head of another giant.
WHOOSH

The giant was instantly split in two, with just the shockwave that was released upon impact. The blades of the axes cut through their tough defences as if hot butter through a knife—wait, the other way around.
He sensed air rushing from behind and, without even turning, he used the shoulder of the second giant to push himself forward as a hammer smashed against the split giant in the next moment.
Vritra completely ignored defence and only dodged whenever the giant tried to hit him. His endurance was already quite high and he wouldn’t get injured even if he was hit by those large weapons.
Endurance not only represented stamina but also the physical defence of the body; Vritra’s endurance was above 700, so those attacks were pretty much useless against him.
[You have killed a Level 167 Demon Giant.]
[You have killed a Level 170 Demon Giant.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[You have levelled up!]
[All Stats Increased by 1.]
[You have gained 1 Allocation Point.]
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 42: Too Easy
paragraphs: Messages kept flashing in front of him but with a bloodthirsty expression, he slaughtered his way forward. Large heads of the giants were bouncing up each time the axes were waved.
Or their heads were crushed under the hammer without even using the gravitational ability of this great weapon.
The dust giants got into a fight with the demons, but they could at most hold back their opponent for a little while. Even the dust blade couldn’t kill these giants directly.
After all, his dust manipulation skill was still at level C, but Vritra could feel that very soon it would evolve again and become more useful.
The more he used this skill, the more its proficiency increased. It wouldn’t be long before it was raised to rank B.
While others’ talents couldn’t be upgraded—whether they were grade C or S—they would stay just there. Based on the level of the user, they would be able to show the power of their skills.
But the dust blade could still blind the enemy and could even block their windpipes, momentarily stunning them.
[You have killed a Level 172 Demon Giant.]
[+Exp Earned.]
And that was all Vritra needed to cut his giant friends to pieces. Since the task had become much easier, the previous thrill had almost disappeared.

Vritra still enjoyed fighting, but now he didn’t go crazy while fighting. He was still perfectly calm as his figure kept jumping into the endless crowd of giants. Jumping over their heads and shoulders and cutting them like woods made of wax.
"So this Death Canopy was created by Nihil-Anima? Why did it go through all that trouble?" Vritra even had the time to calmly talk while attacking and dodging.
These things were too slow for him.
"Yes, with the help of the Demon Lord’s corpse, all of these are created.

Using his energy, blood, and flesh. Under special circumstances, after the death of a Demon Lord, such a labyrinth could be formed, then such demons are created." Yasmine began to explain, while enjoying the sight of him killing those giant creatures left and right.

"As for why Nihil-Anima did it—since it was so weakened, it couldn’t easily break apart the soul of a dead Demon Lord, so it created this place and then broke them into countless demons. Making it easier to swallow the souls of these small demons and also the people who fell down here. And it couldn’t control the entire labyrinth." She finished, while floating around him.
Vritra struck the top of a giant with both hammers, crushing all the bones of his body and turning it into shrimp, as it died immediately.
Even though they were instantly killed by him, the demons kept charging forward with madness. Not a single giant was yet able to hit him.
[You have killed a Level 179 Demon Giant.]
[You have killed a Level 181 Demon Giant.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[You have levelled up!]
[All Stats Increased by 1.]
[You have gained 1 Allocation Point.]
"Go, go, kill them all! I am here for moral support for you. I’ll cheer as you slay them—just the perfect first night of our wedding, very romantic." Yasmine said, looking at her husband.

"Oh, and do you know what is even more strange than our first night? The fact that I didn’t even know I was getting married until the moment we were actually getting married." Vritra spoke, as he kicked the head of another giant away.

"Hehe, actually, in our dragon race when a strong warrior likes someone, they would just go ahead and abduct them. Proposing, love, and marriage all come after that." Yasmine stated, looking at the corpses that were dropping one after another.

Vritra continued his slaughter while the two talked. Since killing them was such an easy task, he didn’t even need to take a break for over a week, since his passive skills kept him refreshed while working in the background.

Finally, he decided to pause for a little while and eat something. Vritra moved back while it was quite difficult for the giants to move since the place was just too crowded. Then, raising both his hands, he poured a large amount of mana and commanded:
"Tsunami of Dust!!"
In the next moment, a huge amount of dust flooded, covering a large area and rising up to the chests of the giants, making it almost impossible for them to move. Then he jumped to the starting point.
Taking out a table from his inventory, he set the food on the table. Of course, the food that his mother had packed—it was still just as fresh, even the milk.
"Heh, is it tasty?" Yasmine asked. She had reduced her size by quite a lot and floated in front of him.
"Mmm, it is. Do you want some?" Vritra began to eat, as the familiar messages popped out, but he paid little attention to them.

"No thanks. I don’t deserve such intense love from your mother. She loves you a lot, huh. I can almost see how much love she had poured into that food." Yasmine spoke, her words filled with a hidden meaning.
"Yeah, we have always depended on each other. But from your words, it seems she had added something unspeakable to this food." Vritra didn’t pause eating as he asked.
"No. Anyway, when are you going to try improving those soul wraiths?" she asked while changing the topic.
"At the end of this wave. I also need to open that mystery box, but I wonder how I can do that." Vritra wondered. He did have an idea, but he wasn’t sure if it would work.

After finishing all the food that Vanessa had packed for him, Vritra drank the milk. Since he wanted to savour the taste of this delicious food for a while longer, he decided to eat the demon meat later.

And once again, Vritra jumped onto the immobile giants who were still struggling, and again he began to chop them into pieces. Days passed by just like that. However, this time the killing went much easier because of Yasmine’s presence—she always joked and talked, and the two had grown closer.
Just like that, the first month in the dangerous yet sweet Death Canopy passed just like that. His killing rate had increased by several times compared to the previous waves.
[You have survived for a total of thirty days.]
[Quest Progress: 0 days remaining. (100%)]
[Quest: Survive the Sixth Wave Completed.]
[You have received 35 Allocation Points.]
[You have received the title: The Cursed Hunter (Level 6)!!]
[All stats have increased by 2.]
Vritra sat on his dining table while he enjoyed the mixture of Demon Giant’s meat along with the hot lava hound meat, while observing his stat.

With each wave, the levels of the demons kept increasing rapidly. The starting level itself was above 160, and the highest demon giant that he faced was at level 200. Also, as he levelled up, the difficulty of just increasing one level was getting higher.
He had to kill a lot of demons to reach level after reaching level 200. This wave remained too easy for him—he hoped to face something challenging the next time.
Thanks for reading...
