chapters.title: Chapter 43: Blackmail
paragraphs: Name:Vritra Arclis
Race:Dragon (???)
Titles:The Cursed Hunter (Level 6)
Class:Dust Lord (Rank: C) [SSS+(?)]
Vitality:100%
Stats:
Strength: 1151 (+100)
Agility: 672 (+100)
Endurance: 870 (+100)
Intelligence: 481 (+100)
Luck: 42
[Allocation points: 94]
Vritra looked at his stats and level. This time he had exchanged quality for quantity, since the giants were too weak for him, so the number of giants he had killed was incredibly high.
So he was able to obtain quite a lot of experience points, otherwise he wouldn’t have levelled many levels above 200.
Yasmine had told him one important detail:

"Although high stats represent high strength, levels are there for a reason. It might not be obvious now at such levels, but at very high levels, each level makes a big difference. Otherwise, wouldn’t a level 1 with 1000 points in stats obtained by using various weapons and artifacts be able to defeat level 1000?
So stats and strong skills do make a big difference, letting you fight stronger opponents, but with each level up, your overall combat strength increases on its own."
Vritra understood her words. It just meant he had to be careful when dealing with opponents of a higher level. Stats might not always show who is stronger.
Plus, a dragon at level 1000 could easily wipe out an army of goblins who are all at the same level, but that also means that a dragon would need more EXP to level up.
So, Vritra now needed even more experience points. Thankfully, he had an endless supply of experience points.
"Now, it is time to take my battle rewards." Vritra looked at all the corpses of the giants that lay behind him.
Taking out lots of mana regeneration potions, he began to raise the dead and turn them into Soul Wraiths. Since the giants were of higher level, he needed to use even more mana.
At least, with Nihil-Anima gradually healing, he could raise as many of them as he wished, and now he didn’t want a weak army— instead, an extremely strong team even if it was small.
It took almost a day to raise several thousand giants from the dead, since he used most of the corpses he had collected to turn them into Soul Wraiths too.
And finally, after a day’s hard work, he stared at the status window displaying the number of Soul Wraiths.
SOUL WRAITH INVENTORY:
Goblins: 31,638
Trolls: 22,964
Lava Hounds: 18,267
Minotaurs: 13,443
Demon Giants:22,371
Vritra had stored lots of corpses in his inventory; that was why he was still able to get more Soul Wraiths.
"That’s a very big number, easy to create a very big chaos, but they will do little in real battle," Yasmine spoke and added:

"If you let them devour one another, then the resulting Soul Wraith would be countless times stronger and could easily wipe out an army of the same type. Leveling for them is easier than us, even more so as Soul Wraiths who could directly devour one another. So go ahead and try it."
"Alright, I’ll keep a few strong warriors of each type of demon. Let’s see how the result turns out." After speaking, Vritra called out all the Soul Wraiths.
The cave darkened as more than a hundred thousand Soul Wraiths appeared, covering a large distance. They arranged themselves under Vritra’s command and stood in their own groups.
"Now go ahead and start devouring each other. The victors will be rewarded later." Vritra spoke in a thundering voice.

In the next moment, the whole death canopy was filled with the loud roars of all the Soul Wraiths. Under his order, they began to devour one another. With each swallow, their aura grew intense, and their strength increased rapidly.
Whether it be goblins or the demon giants, all of them were going wild. Although they had little intelligence, the only two thoughts in their minds were kill and devour.
Vritra observed the brutal scene for a while. It was definitely going to take quite some time before they would be done. He was quite interested in seeing the final Soul Wraiths.
Turning around, Vritra pulled out a table and chair from his inventory and sat down on the chair before pulling out the mysterious black box.
"Hmmm, Yasmine, do you have any idea how we could open this thing? Can it be done forcefully?" Vritra asked while observing the puzzle.

"I really have no idea, not to mention that I don’t know this ancient language. Even if one knows, this puzzle is extremely difficult to solve. As for opening it forcefully, that’s highly unlikely. That is why I am sure it holds something very valuable." Yasmine said in a pondering tone.

"Yeah, this box alone is so strange. So to open this box, either I have to first learn the language or find someone who does. The second option is not possible. I don’t want to reveal its content to others, so I have to learn it somehow." Vritra mumbled while tapping at the box.
"Yes, so I don’t think we will be able to open it anytime soon." Yasmine sighed. If it was so easy to open, then it wouldn’t have remained like that for so long in the temple.
"..." Vritra remained silent for over ten minutes, then he extended his right hand, and a knife appeared in his hand.
It was made of gold and diamonds. Vritra took it only because it looked good and expensive.
"I told you, you can’t open it forcefully, especially not with a flimsy knife. What are you planning?" Yasmine stared curiously at her strange husband, who was completely unpredictable.
And true to this remark, Vritra raised the knife and then put the tip on his chest, right in front of his heart.

"W- Wait, what are you doing? Are you hypnotized by someone? But there is no one here! You don’t have to hurt yourself just because you couldn’t open it!" Yasmine spoke hastily, worry filling her voice.
Ignoring her, Vritra kept the knife in front of his heart and spoke: "I know, you can see and hear everything and are aware of every detail in my surroundings.

Isn’t it your duty to let me adapt to the environment around me so that I can survive? Yes, Mutamorphis, I am talking to you. So give me a skill right now so I can read this, or I am going to pierce my heart through this knife."
Yasmine: "..."
[Mutamorphis: ...]
Vritra had a serious look on his face as he tightly held the knife. This skill helps him whenever he is in difficulty, and now this was his last chance to open the black box.
The beautiful white dragon was frozen in the air with her mouth wide open. She couldn’t believe that he had really just blackmailed a skill of his own.

"A- Are you serious? Put that knife away. We can find a way to open it later somehow. Don’t joke around." Yasmine spoke desperately. She didn’t want to become a widow soul just after a month of getting married, all because her man wanted to open a box.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 44: Divine Sin Wheel
paragraphs: "THREE!!" Vritra counted, he slightly pushed the knife forward as the tip pierced through his skin, as blood trickled down his chest.
Even with his high level of defence, it couldn’t withstand his strength that was even higher.
Yasmine was truly freaking out now, he didn’t look like he was joking at all, neither was he listening to her nor could she push the knife away forcefully.
Even though they were now married the bond they had formed at the beginning gave a certain amount of control over her to Vritra though not equivalent to Diana’s.
[MutaMorphis: ...]
"TWO!!" Vritra counted and pushed the knife even further into his body as blood spluttered out, drenching his clothes.
[MutaMorphis: ... *SWEAT**SWEAT*]
He only furrowed his brows a bit when feeling that pain, and showed no other reaction, even his hand wasn’t shaking a bit.

"Stop stop, let’s just try some other way to open it. What if it is just useless? Please stop..." Yasmine was pleading, she was starting to feel terrible now, from her expression it seemed she was the one feeling all that pain.
But Vritra ignored her completely and continued to push the knife forward, he didn’t expect her to show such a strong reaction.
But it was also understandable, they were a family now and if he was doing the same in front of Vanessa she would go mad too, not to mention he was the last person she could now call family.
She didn’t even know whom among the dragons to trust.
"ONE!!" Vritra shouted and his expression hardened as he closed his eyes and was ready to pull the knife and pierce his heart.
[M- Mutamorphis Activated.]
[Analysing body condition...]
[Analysing the environment and nearby threats...]
[Automatic Morphological Adaptation Triggered...]
These messages poured out in his mind so rapidly as if his dear skill was afraid of being just a bit late, and finally Vritra’s hand paused and he opened his eyes with a smile.
Yasmine gently lay on the table behind the box feeling exhausted, he just gave her such a bad scare but now seeing him smiling she was sure he had achieved his goal.
But she could also tell that he might really have pushed that knife forward if those messages didn’t pop at the right moment, she didn’t even have words to speak to him.
She felt angry and tired, so she just lay there in her small form.
Finally the message Vritra wanted to see so badly appeared.
[You have acquired the passive skill: Language Mastery.]
[Language Mastery]:
(Skill Description): Allows you to understand and write any properly established language in the world.

"I got it." Finally he averted his gaze from the message and put the knife away then looked up but didn’t find his wife floating in the air, he looked forward and saw the white dragon sprawled on the table.
"Oh sorry about that, this was the only way I could think of." He apologized and didn’t give her time to vent her anger as he focussed all his concentration on the box.
Much to his joy, he could perfectly understand all the letters and words of this language, the skill was working perfectly.
Even though he could now understand it, but just as Yasmine had said it wasn’t very easy to decode.
While the soul wraiths were busy with their tasks and Yasmine was resting, Vritra focussed completely on solving the puzzle.
Several hours had passed, the more Vritra solved the more complicated the puzzle seemed, it didn’t make any sense, so many words were just there to confuse him.
And how was he supposed to know which words are useless.
After more than ten hours had passed, Vritra arranged the tiles as they formed a sentence which made the most sense according to him, there were too many possibilities.
CLICK
The lid of the black box opened finally and a dense fog was released before the object inside it finally came to view.
Yasmine noticed it too, and she instantly became excited, she flew towards him and put her head over his shoulder and curiously observed it.
The tiles on the top of the box reshuffled and formed three words in the same ancient language.
"What does it say?" She asked, already forgiving him for his earlier act.
"DIVINE SIN WHEEL!!"
Soon a circular disc that was black in colour and had golden words written on it ends was revealed there was even a metallic needle at the centre.
It looked like some kind of roulette wheel.
"Don’t tell me it is some kind of game that people played in ancient times." Vritra didn’t want to lose the hope, especially after seeing it name so he picked it up.
He held the wheel from the back, there was a small holder on its back. He touched the needles that was pointing towards the right, it wouldn’t move.
Then he rotated the wheel lightly, slowly losing hope in this game like thing.
The black wheel began to rotate, instead of slowing down its speed kept increasing. It rotated faster and faster, at one point a blinding light was emitted from it as Vritra closed his eyes.
When he looked around the wheel had disappeared from his hand, instead a new message appeared in front of him.
[Would you like to form a bond with the Divine Sin Wheel?]
"... Yes." Vritra didn’t see any harm, even Yasmine didn’t stop him this time.
[Forming a bond with the Divine Sin Wheel started...]
[Congratulations you have formed a bond with the Divine Sin Wheel.]
Instantly the image of an ethereal wheel that looked exactly like the small one appeared in his mind, though it was several times bigger, looking at least six to seven feet tall.
He couldn’t understand the golden letters written on the wheel, but it has a majestic presence no less special than the MutaMorphis skill.
Before Vritra could understand anything more messages popped.
[You have obtained 10 free Sin Keys to inset in the Divine Sin Wheel.]
[The probability of winning with the free Sin Keys has increased by 50%]
’A Gacha...?’
Vritra mind was confused and excited at the same time, he decided not to think about the reasons for now and go along with it.
In his status window another section had appeared, which was empty except for that headline: Diving Sin Wheel.
"Should I try it?" He asked, barely holding himself back, completely ignoring the soul wraiths behind.
"Sure go ahead, I don’t sense any kind of danger." Yasmine said, she had seen such a thing for the first time as well.
Taking a deep breath, Vritra focussed on the wheel in his mind and willed it to rotate.
[Used 1 free Sin Key, Sin Keys left: 9]
The wheel rotated, flashing a brilliant light and as it came to a stop a message popped in front of him.
[Better luck next time.]
"..." Vritra released the breath he was holding, he was still smiling.
It’s okay this was just the first time, even if the original rate of winning is very low but with 50% increment it should be above 50, he was sure he would win at least once.
Thanks for reading...

sentences.text: "THREE!!" Vritra counted, he slightly pushed the knife forward as the tip pierced through his skin, as blood trickled down his chest.
Even with his high level of defence, it couldn’t withstand his strength that was even higher.
Yasmine was truly freaking out now, he didn’t look like he was joking at all, neither was he listening to her nor could she push the knife away forcefully.
Even though they were now married the bond they had formed at the beginning gave a certain amount of control over her to Vritra though not equivalent to Diana’s.
[MutaMorphis: ...]
"TWO!!" Vritra counted and pushed the knife even further into his body as blood spluttered out, drenching his clothes.
[MutaMorphis: ... *SWEAT**SWEAT*]
He only furrowed his brows a bit when feeling that pain, and showed no other reaction, even his hand wasn’t shaking a bit.
"Stop stop, let’s just try some other way to open it.
What if it is just useless?
Please stop..." Yasmine was pleading, she was starting to feel terrible now, from her expression it seemed she was the one feeling all that pain.
But Vritra ignored her completely and continued to push the knife forward, he didn’t expect her to show such a strong reaction.
But it was also understandable, they were a family now and if he was doing the same in front of Vanessa she would go mad too, not to mention he was the last person she could now call family.
She didn’t even know whom among the dragons to trust.
"ONE!!" Vritra shouted and his expression hardened as he closed his eyes and was ready to pull the knife and pierce his heart.
[M- Mutamorphis Activated.]
[Analysing body condition...]
[Analysing the environment and nearby threats...]
[Automatic Morphological Adaptation Triggered...]
These messages poured out in his mind so rapidly as if his dear skill was afraid of being just a bit late, and finally Vritra’s hand paused and he opened his eyes with a smile.
Yasmine gently lay on the table behind the box feeling exhausted, he just gave her such a bad scare but now seeing him smiling she was sure he had achieved his goal.
But she could also tell that he might really have pushed that knife forward if those messages didn’t pop at the right moment, she didn’t even have words to speak to him.
She felt angry and tired, so she just lay there in her small form.
Finally the message Vritra wanted to see so badly appeared.
[You have acquired the passive skill: Language Mastery.]
[Language Mastery]:
(Skill Description): Allows you to understand and write any properly established language in the world.

"I got it." Finally he averted his gaze from the message and put the knife away then looked up but didn’t find his wife floating in the air, he looked forward and saw the white dragon sprawled on the table.
"Oh sorry about that, this was the only way I could think of." He apologized and didn’t give her time to vent her anger as he focussed all his concentration on the box.
Much to his joy, he could perfectly understand all the letters and words of this language, the skill was working perfectly.
Even though he could now understand it, but just as Yasmine had said it wasn’t very easy to decode.
While the soul wraiths were busy with their tasks and Yasmine was resting, Vritra focussed completely on solving the puzzle.
Several hours had passed, the more Vritra solved the more complicated the puzzle seemed, it didn’t make any sense, so many words were just there to confuse him.
And how was he supposed to know which words are useless.
After more than ten hours had passed, Vritra arranged the tiles as they formed a sentence which made the most sense according to him, there were too many possibilities.
CLICK
The lid of the black box opened finally and a dense fog was released before the object inside it finally came to view.
Yasmine noticed it too, and she instantly became excited, she flew towards him and put her head over his shoulder and curiously observed it.
The tiles on the top of the box reshuffled and formed three words in the same ancient language.
"What does it say?" She asked, already forgiving him for his earlier act.
"DIVINE SIN WHEEL!!"
Soon a circular disc that was black in colour and had golden words written on it ends was revealed there was even a metallic needle at the centre.
It looked like some kind of roulette wheel.
"Don’t tell me it is some kind of game that people played in ancient times." Vritra didn’t want to lose the hope, especially after seeing it name so he picked it up.
He held the wheel from the back, there was a small holder on its back.
He touched the needles that was pointing towards the right, it wouldn’t move.
Then he rotated the wheel lightly, slowly losing hope in this game like thing.
The black wheel began to rotate, instead of slowing down its speed kept increasing.
It rotated faster and faster, at one point a blinding light was emitted from it as Vritra closed his eyes.
When he looked around the wheel had disappeared from his hand, instead a new message appeared in front of him.
[Would you like to form a bond with the Divine Sin Wheel?]
Yes." Vritra didn’t see any harm, even Yasmine didn’t stop him this time.
[Forming a bond with the Divine Sin Wheel started...]
[Congratulations you have formed a bond with the Divine Sin Wheel.]
Instantly the image of an ethereal wheel that looked exactly like the small one appeared in his mind, though it was several times bigger, looking at least six to seven feet tall.
He couldn’t understand the golden letters written on the wheel, but it has a majestic presence no less special than the MutaMorphis skill.
Before Vritra could understand anything more messages popped.
[You have obtained 10 free Sin Keys to inset in the Divine Sin Wheel.]
[The probability of winning with the free Sin Keys has increased by 50%]
’A Gacha...?’
Vritra mind was confused and excited at the same time, he decided not to think about the reasons for now and go along with it.

chapters.title: Chapter 45: He has gone mad!!
paragraphs: Vritra stood up, looked around, then walked to a clean corner with his chair and sat down. As he felt the luck pouring in, he used another key.
[Used 1 free Sin Key, Sin Keys left: 8]
The wheel rotated and again...
{Better luck next time.}

"Damn, am I that unlucky? No, this place is just filled with negativity. Hoo, it’s alright, there are still eight chances. But how do I get more luck?" Vritra pondered and looked around. Soon, his gaze landed on the white dragon lady who had silently followed along with him.
"Aren’t dragons supposed to bring good luck? My dear wife, will you use your divine abilities and bring me a lot of good luck?" Vritra spoke in an eager tone.
"But many people even believe that dragons bring bad luck..." Yasmine replied, wondering how she could bring good luck for him. But she couldn’t withstand those sparkling eyes.

After pondering for a moment, she slowly descended and gently landed over his shoulder. Her small body coiled around his neck, with her head resting on his shoulder. Even though she was in her soul form, if she wished, she could still be touched.
"Are you ready?" Vritra asked.
Yasmine didn’t know what being ready meant here, but she nodded nonetheless. Then, taking a deep breath, Vritra muttered:
"HALLELUJAH!!"
Then he inserted another key into the wheel as it began to rotate.
{Used 1 free Sin Key, Sin Keys left: 7}
INHALE
EXHALE
After a few deep breaths, Vritra looked at the new messages.
{An active skill acquired: Fourth Dimension!!}
"Woah, I got a new skill! You really are lucky for me." Vritra almost wanted to hold and kiss Yasmine, but he stopped himself in time. Still, he patted her head lovingly.
Not wanting to waste this high luck, he hastily inserted another key into the Divine Sin Wheel as it began to rotate rapidly.
{Used 1 free Sin Key, Sin Keys left: 6}
{Better luck next time.}
"Damn, did the luck already end? My lovely wifey, you are letting the luck escape; try to tighten around me a little and hold the luck in place." Vritra said in a serious tone.
Yasmine: "..."
She was seriously wondering if this was really the person who survived in that impossible condition—the handsome and brave warrior, her fearless and awesome husband.

But she complied with his wishes. Her long body that was hanging loosely circled around his chest, and she slightly tightened her body around him, not enough to hurt him, while her head still rested over his shoulder.
"Here we go again. Please, just one more time, give something good." He again inserted the key.
{Used 1 free Sin Key, Sin Keys left: 5}
{Better luck next time.}
"Tch, wifey, you aren’t trying your best. Try to tighten a little more." Vritra put all the blame on Yasmine.
’Is he developing strange fetishes after marrying a dragon? How is this going to bring luck?’ Yasmine questioned in her mind but tightened her grip around his body.
COUGH
All the air escaped from his lungs and his face began to turn red, but Vritra persevered and inserted another key.
{Used 1 free Sin Key, Sin Keys left: 4}
And then...
{You have acquired two Universal Treasure Maps.}

"I k- knew it—COUGH COUGHYasmine, you are the best, I love you so much. Marrying you was the best mistak- cough accident of my life." Vritra said excitedly while barely able to breathe. He caressed her smooth body, then added another key, and another, and another.
{Used 1 free Sin Key, Sin Keys left: 3}
{Used 1 free Sin Key, Sin Keys left: 2}
{Used 1 free Sin Key, Sin Keys left: 1}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
{Better luck next time.}
Vritra: "..."

"M- More... ughh, tighten a bit more—cough." Vritra almost coughed out blood as he spoke. Yasmine definitely was quite strong even now. A little of her strength had returned after drinking those soul potions.

’CRAZY, don’t tell me there is something wrong with that wheel. I can’t choke my husband to death—sigh, where is his switch off button?’ Yasmine sighed and tightened just a bit more, as the crackling sound of his bones being on the verge of breaking sounded.
Vritra held his breath, his face as red as a tomato and body shaking, then inserted the final key into the wheel and it began to rotate rapidly.
{Used 1 free Sin Key, Sin Keys left: 0}
One breath...
Two breaths...
Three breaths...
Then finally, a wonderful message appeared in front of him.
{A hybrid skill acquired: Shift!!}
"WE DID IT!!!" Vritra shouted in joy as he held Yasmine’s head and kissed her forehead. Her body finally softened and he was able to breathe.
He noticed that the pain disappeared almost instantly—a rate several times faster than even his lesser healing skill.
"Are you alright? I- I think you need rest. Can you recognise me? Are you possessed?" Yasmine finally floated into the air and asked with worry.

"I am perfectly fine! Look what I have obtained. The Divine Sin Wheel is definitely a great treasure. We obtained three—wait, four great things. Now let’s check them out." Vritra spoke while rubbing his palms together, a wide grin spreading across his face.
"Oh? What did you get?" Yasmine forgot all about the earlier madness and moved closer to him. Then her gaze focussed on his status window, which she could see since he allowed her to.
Now the new section seemed a little filled, but first, he focussed on the imaginary objects that had appeared in his mind.
[UNIVERSAL TREASURE MAP]:
(QUANTITY):2
DESCRIPTION:The universal treasure map gives you the detailed location of the greatest treasures present closest to you.
"Nice, a great thing indeed." Vritra nodded in great satisfaction. These maps alone were priceless. If he wasn’t wrong, he might even be able to find treasures at the level of Mythic Halos.
Feeling even more excited, he finally looked at the first skill in his status window’s new section.
{DIVINE SIN WHEEL}:
[1 SIN KEY: 10,000 sin points.]
(Sin Keys available: 0)
(Special Note:A certain percentage of obtaining something depends on your luck value. So current possibility of obtaining a reward = Luck value + Divine Sin Wheel’s Odds = 1.5%)
[ACTIVE SKILLS]:
{Fourth Dimension}
(Skill Description):A single space isn’t enough to accommodate you, so disappear.

Vritra began to read from the beginning of the new section. First, he saw the cost of 1 Sin Key, but since he wasn’t sure how Sin Points were acquired, he didn’t know if that 10,000 was very high or not.
Anyway, right now that wasn’t important. His gaze quickly shifted toward his new skill, whose name alone sounded quite cool. He read the description but couldn’t understand anything.
"Is it explaining something or trying to mock me?" Vritra wondered.
"Give it a try, I want to see what it does." Yasmine was even more excited than him. She circled on his shoulder and almost squeezed his neck in her curiosity and excitement.
"Alright, get ready." Vritra spoke and used the new skill.
[Fourth Dimension Activated!!]
And in the next moment, Vritra disappeared from existence.
Thanks for reading...
You can check character’s images on discord.

chapters.title: Chapter 46: Too awesome!!
paragraphs: Yasmine almost fell down as Vritra disappeared. She was startled as she sensed her surroundings but couldn’t locate him anywhere; his scent, aura, Vritra’s very presence had completely disappeared.
She could still feel her bond with him, which meant he was still alive, but nowhere near her. It was really like a different space had swallowed him.
"H-Husband? Are you there?" she called out. She had experienced so much just for one day, and she no longer wanted to play with him for today.
On the other hand, Vritra was even more panicked; as soon as the skill was activated, he really disappeared from the real world and entered a separate space where only emptiness existed.

He could still hear and see the real world but couldn’t touch anything. As the land under his feet disappeared, Vritra began to fall down and couldn’t hold onto anything. He saw Yasmine’s face for a moment before he disappeared into the ground and continued to plummet.
"What the hell? Yasmine?" he shouted, but his voice couldn’t be heard in the real world, and Vritra had no idea how to go up.

By the time he came to his senses, his vision was only filled with mud as he kept falling. The only choice he had was to deactivate this skill, but Vritra hesitated. He was under the land; if he deactivated it now, he was afraid he would be embedded in the mud and end up dying.
But there was no other choice. Just as he was about to deactivate it, a few messages appeared in front of him.
[Mutamorphis Activated.]
[Analysing body condition...]
[Analysing the environment and nearby threats...]
[Automatic Morphological Adaptation Triggered...]
[You have acquired the active skill: Fly.]
Finally, Vritra was able to stop and float freely in the air. He finally had a chance to observe this new skill calmly.

First, he flew upward and arrived back into the death canopy, where Yasmine was still looking for him. He floated in front of her, but she still couldn’t sense him. Vritra simply passed through her; it seemed aside from two of his senses, he really didn’t exist in the real world at all.

’Then isn’t this a great defensive and spying skill? I wonder if there is a time limit. Will the attack pass through my body as well?’ he wondered and deactivated the skill, appearing exactly in front of Yasmine.
"You are back!! Oh, you can fly now? So the skill is exactly as its name says. Were you able to hear and see the real world?" Yasmine asked once he became visible.
"Yes, in that state I can watch and see everything around me," Vritra answered.
Then the two decided to do a few experiments.

After staying for around twenty or so minutes in that state, all of Vritra’s mana ran out, and he was back to reality. Aside from the high mana consumption there was no short coming of this great skill.
Also, his fear was for naught. If his skill was deactivated in the ground, it would have simply pushed the mud away, and he would be stuck there.
"This is a great skill, but it won’t be so useful against opponents who are too strong that they could break space or those that could control the space attribute," Yasmine spoke after observing it.
"With this skill, didn’t my defense become much stronger? If I were to face Diana now, she won’t even be able to touch me." Vritra laughed, very much satisfied with Fourth Dimension.
Now it was time to see the next skill. Hopefully, it would be just as good. Hybrid... does that mean it is both active and passive? While pondering, Vritra looked at the status window again.
[HYBRID SKILLS]:
{Shift}
(Skill Description):

When one isn’t enough, take two. When strength or agility or defence is lacking just borrow from the other, be careful what you choose. Healing, mana regeneration, mental recovery will automatically support one another, two could be added to the third.
"Hmm, is it what I think it is?" Vritra wondered.
"I think so, give it a try," Yasmine encouraged him.
After thinking for a moment, Vritra activated the new skill.
Strength: 1151Agility: 672
[Shift Activated.]
[Strength→ Agility]
Strength: 10Agility: 1813
Immediately, Vritra felt extremely weak, but his reaction speed, thinking speed, raw speed—all of them had increased by several times.

Vritra moved forward and in an instant covered more than a hundred meters. He kept the skill activated for a while, and there was no consumption of any energy. This was an even more incredible skill that had directly increased Vritra’s strength greatly.
Not to mention, his healing and mana regeneration had increased. As for mental recovery, he didn’t know the effect yet, but the passive section was also great.

"So I can just add however much of the stat of one attribute to the other I want, and it also works passively, letting two regenerations support the third, that is incredible," Vritra exclaimed, since mana regeneration has increased then the Shift will also support the Fourth Dimension skill, letting it last even longer.

Now one of his great worries was finally resolved. He always felt that his agility was lacking behind, and before adding allocation points, he had to think a lot and wait for the situation, but now there was no need to worry.

"..." Yasmine was baffled by such a godly skill. She was the one to tell him that at lower level, even with high stats, it gets increasingly difficult to defeat higher-level opponents, but with such a skill, he could easily cross that limit of levels.
It is already so powerful, but once his level increases to a very high number, then once this skill is used, won’t Vritra’s poor enemies be slaughtered without any idea how they died?

Leaving his dragon wife to her thoughts, Vritra, who was overjoyed by the two skills, decided to check out the treasure maps. He focussed on the two scrolls in his mind and inserted some form of energy into them.

The two scrolls unfurled and, on their surface, thousands of lines began to flash as if they had started to search for the treasures. A few seconds passed in silence, and finally, the two maps showed extremely detailed locations of two different treasures. He read their names and opened his eyes.
Yasmine, who was back to her senses after being shocked for a while, looked at Vritra and asked:
"So, which treasures did they display?"
"The first is the Inheritance of the Scarlet Couple," Vritra answered, wondering if she would know something about it.
"Oh that..." Yasmine didn’t seem surprised. After a moment, she nodded and spoke: "That is indeed a great treasure, of the level of top ten Mythic Halos, but there is a problem."
"What problem?" Vritra asked. He knew getting such treasures wasn’t an easy task.

"The location of that inheritance is already known by the world, and hence the people that will come there will be extremely strong. When the inheritance ground opens, that place will be extremely chaotic.
Even when I was at my peak, I would think twice before going there." Yasmine warned.
Thanks for reading...

After staying for around twenty or so minutes in that state, all of Vritra’s mana ran out, and he was back to reality.
Aside from the high mana consumption there was no short coming of this great skill.
Also, his fear was for naught.
If his skill was deactivated in the ground, it would have simply pushed the mud away, and he would be stuck there.
"This is a great skill, but it won’t be so useful against opponents who are too strong that they could break space or those that could control the space attribute," Yasmine spoke after observing it.
"With this skill, didn’t my defense become much stronger?
If I were to face Diana now, she won’t even be able to touch me." Vritra laughed, very much satisfied with Fourth Dimension.
Now it was time to see the next skill.
Hopefully, it would be just as good.
Hybrid... does that mean it is both active and passive?
While pondering, Vritra looked at the status window again.
[HYBRID SKILLS]:
{Shift}
(Skill Description):
When one isn’t enough, take two.
When strength or agility or defence is lacking just borrow from the other, be careful what you choose.
Healing, mana regeneration, mental recovery will automatically support one another, two could be added to the third.
"Hmm, is it what I think it is?" Vritra wondered.
"I think so, give it a try," Yasmine encouraged him.
After thinking for a moment, Vritra activated the new skill.
Strength: 1151Agility: 672
[Shift Activated.]
[Strength→ Agility]
Strength: 10Agility: 1813
Immediately, Vritra felt extremely weak, but his reaction speed, thinking speed, raw speed—all of them had increased by several times.
Vritra moved forward and in an instant covered more than a hundred meters.
He kept the skill activated for a while, and there was no consumption of any energy.
This was an even more incredible skill that had directly increased Vritra’s strength greatly.
Not to mention, his healing and mana regeneration had increased.
As for mental recovery, he didn’t know the effect yet, but the passive section was also great.

"So I can just add however much of the stat of one attribute to the other I want, and it also works passively, letting two regenerations support the third, that is incredible," Vritra exclaimed, since mana regeneration has increased then the Shift will also support the Fourth Dimension skill, letting it last even longer.
Now one of his great worries was finally resolved.
He always felt that his agility was lacking behind, and before adding allocation points, he had to think a lot and wait for the situation, but now there was no need to worry.
"..." Yasmine was baffled by such a godly skill.

She was the one to tell him that at lower level, even with high stats, it gets increasingly difficult to defeat higher-level opponents, but with such a skill, he could easily cross that limit of levels.
It is already so powerful, but once his level increases to a very high number, then once this skill is used, won’t Vritra’s poor enemies be slaughtered without any idea how they died?
Leaving his dragon wife to her thoughts, Vritra, who was overjoyed by the two skills, decided to check out the treasure maps.
He focussed on the two scrolls in his mind and inserted some form of energy into them.
The two scrolls unfurled and, on their surface, thousands of lines began to flash as if they had started to search for the treasures.
A few seconds passed in silence, and finally, the two maps showed extremely detailed locations of two different treasures.
He read their names and opened his eyes.
Yasmine, who was back to her senses after being shocked for a while, looked at Vritra and asked:
"So, which treasures did they display?"
"The first is the Inheritance of the Scarlet Couple," Vritra answered, wondering if she would know something about it.
"Oh that..." Yasmine didn’t seem surprised.
After a moment, she nodded and spoke: "That is indeed a great treasure, of the level of top ten Mythic Halos, but there is a problem."
"What problem?" Vritra asked.
He knew getting such treasures wasn’t an easy task.
"The location of that inheritance is already known by the world, and hence the people that will come there will be extremely strong.
When the inheritance ground opens, that place will be extremely chaotic.
Even when I was at my peak, I would think twice before going there." Yasmine warned.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 47: Abominations
paragraphs: "Even when I was at my peak, I would think twice before going there... it is just too dangerous. The people of my level, even demon lords, might arrive there. The treasure will undoubtedly be great, yes, but so will be the danger.
Even with these new skills and your increasing strength, you wouldn’t last there for more than a few minutes, so let’s give up on that, it’s just too dangerous." Yasmine advised.
Then asked: "So what is the second treasure?"

"Heh, in the same kingdom as the Scarlet couple inheritance, the blue kingdom is where the second treasure is located as well. The 20th ranked Mythic Halo, Misty Essence, is located there in some nameless inheritance." Vritra answered.
He wasn’t discouraged since he couldn’t get the first treasure, he didn’t want to throw his life away because of overconfidence so he completely disregarded the 1st treasure map.
"Misty Essence?!! It is located in the blue kingdom? Even I have never heard of this news, then surely that thing is hidden from everyone. This is great, we will head to the Blue kingdom next.

Even though that Mythic Halo is ranked at the last, it is solely because it couldn’t deal any damage directly, but if it is used correctly then it could bring disasters." Yasmine’s emotions were like the graph of sine, constantly going up and down.
"Yes, there is still quite some time before these inheritances open and both of them will open at the same time. Our next destination is Blue kingdom." Vritra said, then he remembered another thing.
’How do I earn those Sin points to get more such skills?’ While he was pondering, he looked at the messages that he had ignored earlier.
{Sin Point Gained: Awestruck +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +1}
"!!!" He saw several such messages and then looked at the lower section of his status menu and immediately understood the method to earn Sin points.
{Sin points: 11}

’So it is based on the reactions of people around me to all of my actions. Won’t that take too long to earn the Sin points—wait, if there are a lot of people then it would be no problem.’ He pondered. All of these points had come from Yasmine.

He decided to worry about this later and focus on clearing the Death Canopy. Finally, he closed his status window and stretched his arm. He had gained a lot, now it was time to clear the rest of the waves.
Just as he turned around, Vritra was reminded that he had asked the Soul Wraiths to devour each other and had forgotten to stop them. Now only six terrifying-looking demons remained in front of him.

"Sigh. I was planning to keep a few of each type. Anyway, let’s see how it turned out." Vritra mumbled. Just by appearance, all of them looked a lot stronger and deadlier. Even the single goblin who had a height of over 6 feet looked burly and buffed out.

First he looked at the levels of all his Soul Wraiths. Yasmine had told him that devouring gives the wraiths more EXP than just killing others, and the EXP required for these Soul Wraiths is several times lower than him, so leveling up is much easier for them—several times at that.
So he expected them to reach high levels, but upon looking at these Soul Wraiths, he was completely baffled and just stared at them with a dumbfounded expression.
Name: Goblin King
Level: 399
Name: Orc King
Level: 440
Name: Troll King
Level: 481
Name: Lava Hound King
Level: 514
Name: Minotaur King
Level: 540
Name: Demon Giant King
Level: 620
Vritra was truly speechless.

They weren’t just Soul Wraiths, they were literal abominations. All six of the menacing figures stood side by side, just their presence alone darkened the surrounding area, and the air was filled with thick killing intent.
Their bodies were covered by fog, making them look even more terrifying with their eyes glowing. Each of the Soul Wraiths had developed greatly. He peeked at the stats of his strongest warrior.
Name: Demon Giant King
Level: 620
Stats:
• Strength: 1064
• Agility: 734
• Endurance: 994
• Intelligence: 464
• Mana: 679

"Damn, is this normal? Its stats have surpassed mine in several areas, how disgustingly terrifying." Vritra muttered, but Yasmine remained calm. She was aware of the greatness of the Nihil-Anima, so she knew there would be such a huge jump.

"Yes, raising Soul Wraith is indeed as big a cheat as your other abilities. Just feed them strong souls and they will level up quickly." Yasmine said. His growth rate was increasing at a chilling rate.

Vritra smiled as his shock left. No wonder Nihil-Anima challenged the 2nd-ranked Mythic Halo and even fought one of the Demon Gods. Its army alone is so dangerous. Excited about adding four more warriors to this matchup, he looked at Yasmine and said:
"Let’s start the next wave."

"Yes, now you will also be able to use these guys to fight along with you. Your killing efficiency will increase greatly, so the number of high-level demons you kill will increase greatly. Which means more levels and stronger Soul Wraiths. Hmm hmm, indeed it’s too disturbing." Yasmine instantly called for the next wave.
Now Vritra wasn’t planning to stop until he had killed all the demons in the Death Canopy.
[Quest: Survive the Seventh Wave.]
[Reward: 40 Allocation Points and the title: The Cursed Hunter (Level 7)!!]
[Penalty: None]
Then came the endless wave of demons. This time there was no invisible wall. As soon as the demons appeared, Vritra and his six shadows pounced at them and began the slaughter.
[Activating Appraisal.]
Race: Wyrm
Level: 211
Class: Demonic Serpent
Vitality: 100%
Stats:
• Strength: 320
• Agility: 368
• Endurance: 280
• Intelligence: 150
• Mana: 262

Each serpent was more than ten feet long. They charged forward just as madly, but the pitiful beings were slaughtered at an alarming speed by the seven demons in front of them. Messages poured like crazy in front of Vritra.
[You have killed a Level 220 Wyrm.]
[You have killed a Level 228 Wyrm.]
[You have killed a Level 238 Wyrm.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[You have levelled up!]
[You have levelled up!]
[You have levelled up!]
[You have levelled up!]
[All Stats Increased by 1.]
[You have gained 1 Allocation Point.]
Just like that, an entire month had passed.
[You have survived for a total of thirty days.]
[Quest Progress: 0 days remaining. (100%)]
[Quest: Survive the Seventh Wave Completed.]
[You have received 40 Allocation Points.]
[You have received the title: The Cursed Hunter (Level 7)!!]
[All stats have increased by 2.]

Normally, Vritra’s rate of killing would decrease with the increase in the level of demons, but this time, he had killed far more demons because of the Soul Wraiths and his skillShiftplusFourth Dimension.
The final levels of the Wyrms were near level 255. The total Soul Wraiths he collected this time was even more absurd.
SOUL WRAITH INVENTORY:
Wyrms: 29,658
Then came the process of creating a new warrior, and then attacking the next wave. Vritra’s leveling speed increased even more, his stats were increasing rapidly.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 48: Overwhelming
paragraphs: Name:Vritra Arclis
Titles:The Cursed Hunter (Level 7)
Class:Dust Lord (Rank: C) [SSS+(?)]
Stats:
•Strength: 1241 (+100)
• Endurance: 960 (+100)
• Intelligence: 571 (+100)
• Luck: 44
[Allocation points: 222]
The seventh wave passed like a breeze. This time Vritra’s challenge wasn’t just to kill all the demons without getting injured at all but also to kill more Demonic Wyrms than any of the Soul Wraiths.

Those things became a killing machine in this wave. Even though the opponents were much stronger, Vritra successfully killed nearly 30,000 Demonic Wyrms, some of which he kept as emergency rations and some for corpse explosions.
But he used most for raising an ultimate Soul Wraith, which was even stronger than the previous ones. Devouring was truly magical, letting the Soul Wraiths grow at such incredible speed.
After the new monster was born and he had finished upgrading his Axes of Chaos to an even more destructive level, Vritra faced the 8th wave of demons.
Either he was slaughtering the demons and talking to Yasmine, or eating the demons and talking to Yasmine. He didn’t rest much and gave all his time to grind up levels.

The demonic energy in his body was increasing constantly but now it was gathered in the core. For now he could only use it to summon that purple flame, but Vritra felt that in the future that Essence Core might be even more useful.
Soon the eighth round began and another round of slaughter took place; it was too one-sided. The other side stood absolutely no chance of winning.
[Quest: Survive the Eighth Wave.]
[Reward: 45 Allocation Points and the title: The Cursed Hunter (Level 8)!!]
[Penalty: None]
This time he faced a new type of demons, the mages who had strong spells but weak defence. Although their combat strength had increased greatly, if they couldn’t hit Vritra then it was useless.
Race:Hellmancer
Level:288
Class:Demonic Mage
With their weak defences and low strength, they were even weaker than Wyrms and killing them was easier, though dodging their attacks was a bit difficult for his Soul Wraiths.

Not to mention the debuffs, so the efficiency decreased by a bit. Yet in the end, Vritra managed to kill more than 20,000 Hellmancers. He followed the same regimen and kept some corpses for explosion and used the others to create another abomination.
After a month-long battle, the eighth wave finally ended and the familiar messages poured in front of Vritra.
[Quest: Survive the Eighth Wave Completed.]
[You have received 45 Allocation Points.]
[You have received the title: The Cursed Hunter (Level 8)!!]
[All stats have increased by 2.]
But there was one big change this month, a new message had finally appeared that Vritra was badly waiting for.
[Your skill has Levelled Up]
[Dust Manipulation has advanced to Level 5.]
[Granular Solidification has now transformed into ElementalTransmutation.]

"Elemental Transmutation, so basically it allows me to infuse dust with elemental energies. With enough mana I can now create large cyclones, make erupting volcanoes or even turn everything into Iceland." Vritra pondered after reading the description of his new skill. It was truly becoming SSS+ from a trash skill.
His control over dust had increased by a lot and the skill itself had gotten quite strong. He was now able to kill the demons using Dust Manipulation.
The ninth and tenth waves passed. Yasmine watched as he became much more monstrous than those pitiful demons. His level kept increasing rapidly, and those Soul Wraiths kept getting stronger.

In the last two waves, Vritra first faced Golems that were made of almost indestructible flesh. Their defence was extremely high and they were quite difficult to kill. Their strength had increased greatly.

And at last Vritra faced Chimeras. They were disgusting-looking creatures that were made from dead bodies of demons and possessed random abilities. Killing them was quite tricky since all of them were different.
When he obtained the final level of the title "Cursed Hunter," he was rewarded an additional 100 Allocation Points and ten Luck points, which was a great gift.

After he was finally done killing all ten of the waves, Vritra sat calmly on a chair in a new set of clothes and looked completely clean without any blood on his body. His current appearance was simply dazzling.

Yasmine was coiled around his body while her head rested comfortably on his lap. Vritra was caressing her head as she lay there with her eyes closed and released contented sighs every once in a while. After months together, they had gotten very close.

Vritra looked at everything that he had gained after this trip. He had already added all his Allocation Points to Agility, since it increases his reaction speed too, and with Shift he could adjust at any time.

Vritra had removed the five previous Soul Wraiths since their levels were too low for his current use and he allowed the new five to devour them, letting them become even stronger.

Just those Soul Wraiths had increased Vritra’s strength exponentially, not to mention all his other gains. It wouldn’t be wrong to say this trip back into the labyrinth had increased his strength more than ten times.
And now he was finally done with all the work he needed to do here.

"Haa, that was a long but fun time. With your current strength, you could have easily beaten Diana to a pulp. Her holy powers could be annoying but she would still be no match for you," Yasmine spoke as she looked at his status window with half-opened eyes, enjoying his caress.

"Yeah, we are finally done with this wretched but great place. Now it is time to return," Vritra spoke, as the five monsters disappeared into his shadows. Zengis and Axes of Chaos returned to his inventory.
Thanks for reading...

Yasmine was coiled around his body while her head rested comfortably on his lap.
Vritra was caressing her head as she lay there with her eyes closed and released contented sighs every once in a while.
After months together, they had gotten very close.
Vritra looked at everything that he had gained after this trip.
He had already added all his Allocation Points to Agility, since it increases his reaction speed too, and with Shift he could adjust at any time.

chapters.title: Chapter 49: The Return
paragraphs: Vritra finally stepped out of the labyrinth after more than five months, he bathed in the warm sunlight and heard the sound of nearby people and distant beasts, this time he didn’t cause a big commotion as he could perfectly control his killing intent.

"Haa so refreshing, I entered the labyrinth with the single status and leaving with the married status, based on the time spent here I should be nineteen now." Vritra mumbled, as he stood at the entrance of the labyrinth.
Yasmine had returned to his body, it wouldn’t be good if anyone were to notice her, it would put both of them in danger.

"What is even more surprising is that you had literally grown to this extent in mere two months. Now that both of our strength had grown quite a bit, it is time to wreak havoc in the Dunshire kingdom, all those people would have to pay for trying to kill my Hubby, won’t I have died single had they succeeded." Yasmine said, her tone both affectionate and slightly angry.
The two had already formed an evil plan to punish them all, the couple shared a devilish laugh when they planned it out.
"Yes yes, they will certainly pay... not just them but the demons too, let’s go." As Vritra spoke, he looked into the direction of the capital and then his figure blurred.
[Shift Activated.]
[Endurance→ Agility]
Agility: 2912

Vritra’s speed had increased to a great extent, in no time he had returned to the boundary of the capital, his body remained a blur as he ran at full speed while dodging the obstacles, this skill was truly too much of a cheat.

Vritra stood outside the gates and entered while walking normally, everything seemed just as he had left it; the thing he was most excited about was meeting Vanessa again, he wanted to share the news of his progress with her.
But he didn’t know that he was in for a great surprise.

He walked in the bustling market while looking around casually; just based on his appearance he was attracting the gazes of all the people in his surroundings, especially women and one after another message kept flashing.
{Sin Points Gained: Tempted +26}
{Sin Points Gained: Watched +44}
{Sin Points Gained: Charmed +31}
{Sin Points Gained: Envied +39}
Just by walking normally, he was getting tons of Sin points; Vritra had planned to find a place with lots of people later and draw something great from the Gacha again.

He walked like that while smiling at a few women who had instantly fallen so deeply in love with him, his current charms had also increased just like the stats of all his attributes, if he were to return to Earth he would easily be the most handsome person.
(Sin Points: 1133)
"Heh that’s a nice way of levelling, just walk around and you get a brand new cheat skill, won’t you get even more points if we were to walk together, hand in hand, imagine the flood of points."
Yasmine chuckled, now she really wanted to get her physical body back just to spend proper time with him.
"Yeah, I would get thousands of points just because of the men who would be jealous of me, especially the dragons, I stole their Queen." he replied.
After walking for a couple of hours and collecting quite a bit of Sin points while walking through the crowd, Vritra had finally arrived in front of the castle.
Like before one of the guards walked in front of him, after looking at him jealously he asked the same question: "Who are you? Why do you wish to enter?"
"I am Vritra." A simple reply came, and he didn’t add anything further.
"You are Vritra?" the guard asked in surprise and doubt.

’Here it comes again, the legendary question. I wonder how many people will ask me this today.’ He sighed in his mind and nodded, what the poor Vritra didn’t know was that very soon he would be the one who would be repeating a single word again and again.
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +1}

The guard had seen Vritra enter the castle the last time in his ragged appearance and also when he left the castle, he did look handsome then but now, he was like a different person and much more handsome.

After staring at his face for a while the guard did notice some familiarities, so Vritra took out a ring from his inventory that was given to him by Diana although without her consent, it would allow him to easily go anywhere even in the castle.
"Ah this, was this given to you by the goddess?" the guard asked in surprise as he took a step back and became more respectful.
"Yes, can I enter now?" Vritra asked and placed the ring away.
"Y- Yes, please enter." The guard bowed.

Without giving him a second glance, Vritra entered and then began to walk towards the castle, he directly wanted to go and meet his mother, soon they will be able to leave the castle together and stay at a safer place.

While ignoring the gazes of all the people, Vritra made his way into the castle and soon arrived in front of Vanessa’s room, after looking himself over and making sure he was completely presentable without any smell of blood, he knocked on the door and called out:
"Mom."
First there was silence then the sound of something falling to the ground, with Vritra’s senses he could tell that it was a book, then came the sound of hurried footsteps.

The door opened, a woman with long and shiny black hair, hourglass figure and extremely beautiful face was revealed, she wore a black dress which when matched with her creamy white skin gave her a devilish look, she literally looked like a Succubus.

Those seductive black eyes, her baby-like soft and rosy cheeks and the pink and ripe lips... she looked like a femme fatale, her beauty was no less when compared to the goddess but her curves; her breasts jiggled with each step she took and her whole body looked so soft and creamy that one would want to take a bite.
"Mom?" Vritra mumbled in confusion, from her face she did resemble Vanessa but she seemed to have changed a lot in a positive way, even her hair had turned from green to black.
"Honey?" Vanessa was just as surprised, she paused for a moment and observed him up and down, and after a few seconds she was completely sure it was her Vritra and no one else.
"Yes, it is me." Her glistening lips curved into a beautiful almost dazzling smile, her eyes narrowing slightly as she leaned forward, squeezing her soft and supple boobs between her arms.
"Mom!!" After the two were sure of each other’s identities, they both looked at each other with love, happiness and affection, though one side felt a few additional emotions.

Vritra spread his arms as he stepped forward, wanting to embrace his mother who looked a bit younger but more beautiful and hotter, he was so happy to see that she was perfectly fine and even seemed to have grown a little stronger.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Seduced +1}
But Vritra didn’t notice it, he was about to receive the warmest welcome of his life.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 50: A Warm Welcome~
paragraphs: Vanessa took a couple of steps forward until she was exactly in front of Vritra, then in a fluid motion her hands moved towards his face as she cupped his cheeks gently and stood on tiptoes, then she closed her eyes and her lips parted slightly.
In the next moment, Vanessa pressed her soft and warm lips lightly against his; her lips fused to his in a kiss that felt anything but innocent.
Her tender and moist lips felt incredibly soft, that melded into his creating a burning feeling between their bodies, that were pressed tightly.
Vanessa didn’t make any further movement but a fiery, almost burning sensation spread between their mouths; as their lips remained gently pressed together.
As Vritra’s lips touched his mother’s, the moment he felt those pink, plump lips melt into his, a shock ran through his body.
Both his mind and body froze; his arms remained stretched and suspended in the air as he stared dazedly at the stunning face that was pressing against his face.
The only thought that came into his mind as he tasted the warmth of her moisturized, tender lips was... soft. Achingly, deliciously soft.

Seconds passed like slow fire, stretching endlessly, until Vanessa finally began to pull back. As her slightly wet lips clung to his for just a moment longer—sticky and burning—before they popped back with a soft, moist sound.
"M- Mom?" Vritra’s eyes were wide open, he couldn’t think of anything but the soft, moist sensation on his lips lingered for a long time, he even wondered if this was some imposter.
Vanessa smiled warmly, her cheeks tinged with a slight flush, as she spoke in a sweet voice:
"Welcome back, honey."
After a few seconds, Vritra finally came back to his senses, he blinked his eyes and looked at the gorgeous woman before asking:
"Mom, w- what was that? You just kissed me..." Vritra didn’t really care much about his first kiss but he never imagined that it would be stolen by his mother.
"Hmm, what is wrong with that? Isn’t that our usual greeting manner?" Vanessa spoke, an innocent and confused expression on her bewitching face.
{Sin Point gained: Hypnotized +1}
A sweet and intoxicating scent drifted towards Vritra as he inherited Vanessa’s scent, his mind became muddy, slow and infatuated for a moment.
He was completely captivated by the dazzling and enchanting sight in front of him.
{Sin Point gained: Got Entranced +1}
"Yes, why did I react like that? That is indeed the way we greet each other." Vritra mumbled in a daze, but he came back to his senses almost instantly.
Shaking his head, he stared at his mother in disbelief, she was still giving him a sweet and innocent smile.
"No way it is normal, mom tell me, is something wrong? What is going on exactly?" Vritra asked, he could feel something was definitely wrong.
Even with such high intelligence stat he was dazed for a moment, the intelligence stat represents mental strength and energy, so it was surprising that he was still charmed.
Finally, Vanessa’s expression changed as if she had just realised something, her mouth opened wide as she covered her mouth with her palm, her eyes wide open.
"Oh I- I am so sorry honey, I didn’t know what happened to me just now, I just... Was that your first kiss?" she asked with a meek expression, her face filled with self-blame and worry.
"Yes it was, but that isn’t important right now. You have been acting strange from the beginning, you are hiding something from me right?" Vritra questioned in a solemn tone.
"Sigh yes, there is something I couldn’t tell you before, let’s talk inside." After speaking Vanessa walked back into the room and sat on the bed.
Vritra took a deep breath and closed the door behind him before sitting beside his mother and looking at her face while waiting for her explanation.

"Actually, I had lied to you... I am sure you had your doubts but my skill is not related to cooking. What I obtained was the bloodline and physique of a Succubus Queen, you can understand why I was hesitant to tell you about it.

I was fine before but after you left, the goddess helped me a lot, bringing strong demons who were on the verge of death each and every day, after I delivered the final blow my levels increased rapidly." Vanessa paused and looked at Vritra, only after he nodded did she continue.
’So Diana carried out her mission perfectly, I guess she needs a reward.’ Vritra thought and then focused on his mother’s words.

"After my level increased, my body began to change as you can see but it wasn’t just in appearance, I have these sudden urges and I feel very strange, it was still tolerable before but after you came back, I didn’t even know what I was doing when I k- kissed you.

I think I am sick, my mind and body are behaving very strangely, will you help me? It must be because of my physique and bloodline that I am experiencing these changes, I don’t even know what might happen in the future."

Vanessa’s eyes were filled with tears as she looked at Vritra with a pitiful expression. Vritra felt that it was finally making sense, he knew what nature a succubus has; and since her level had just grown so he understood that these might be side effects.
"It’s alright mom, I will take care of you." Vritra embraced Vanessa, patting her back in a relaxing manner as she buried her face into his chest.
’Tch tch. My poor hubby and her pitiful mother, isn’t my mother-in-law too interesting.’ Yasmine watched the show in amusement.

’Sigh I am sorry, I have finally told you the truth but with a small lie, it is too hard for me to do all that so I will have to make you take the initiative.’ Vanessa thought, she planned to slowly seduce her own son until they could help each other become strong.
’It is all just to protect the two of us with no other motive, I know this is wrong but just let your mother protect you from now on even if it is in this shameful manner.’

"Oh right!!" Vritra suddenly remembered something as he pulled back and looked at her beautiful face, he asked: "If your ability isn’t food-related then what about the food that I ate before? I still received experience points from it and that milk—"
But before he could finish, Vanessa interrupted him in a hurry, asking a question of her own.

"How come you have changed so much in just one month? For me, it was because of leveling up and my physique effects, though I changed my hair colour to match yours it could be changed easily." While speaking she touched her long black hair that matched Vritra’s.

"Well similar to you, it is the effect of leveling up and my physique..." Vritra showed her his status window, of course hiding a few secrets that would put her in danger like the Mythic Halo, Divine Sin Wheel and a few more things.
"Whoa level 534?!! You have become incredibly powerful, even though the goddess was sending me lots of demons to kill I was only able to reach level 89." Vanessa spoke.
Thanks for reading...
